The Lands of Always Winter.summary:
The Land of Always Winter, also called the Lands of Always Winter, is the northernmost known part of [Westeros](Westeros), far [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall). The [Frostfangs](Frostfangs) and several large lakes separate them from the [haunted forest](Haunted_forest).

The Land of Always Winter is permanently locked in winter and perpetually frozen. Mostly unexplored, it is near the [Thenn](Thenn_%28valley%29) valley. It is believed that the [Others](Others) come from this region.

Thenn.summary:
Thenn is a high mountain valley located in the northernmost area [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall), hidden in the peaks of the northern [Frostfangs](Frostfangs).

Its inhabitants, the [Thenns](Thenns), consider themselves the last of the [First Men](First_Men). [Cave dwellers](Cave_dwellers), [hornfoots](Hornfoots), [giants](Giants) and [ice-river clans](Ice-river_clans) live in the lands surrounding the valley.

Giant's Stair.summary: The Giant's Stair is one of the ways to enter the [Frostfangs](Frostfangs).

The Haunted Forest.summary: The haunted forest is a vast forest [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall) in northern [Westeros](Westeros). Located beyond the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), it is inhabited by the [free folk](Free_folk) and is bounded to the west by the [Frostfangs](Frostfangs) and to the east by the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea) and the [Bay of Seals](Bay_of_Seals). North of the haunted forest is the unmapped [Land of Always Winter](Land_of_Always_Winter).

The Frozen Shore.summary: The Frozen Shore or frozen shore is the western shore of the lands [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall), with the [Bay of Ice](Bay_of_Ice) and [Bear Island](Bear_Island) to the south. An unnamed river with tributaries flows south through the region to the Bay of Ice and the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea).

Lorn Point.summary: Lorn Point is a site on the [Frozen Shore](Frozen_Shore) [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall).

Bay of Ice.summary:
The Bay of Ice is a large bay along the shores of northwestern [Westeros](Westeros). It is bordered by the [Frozen Shore](Frozen_Shore) to the north, the foothills of the [northern mountains](Northern_mountains) to the east, the [wolfswood](Wolfswood) and [Sea Dragon Point](Sea_Dragon_Point) to the south, and the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea) to the west. [Bear Island](Bear_Island) sits within the bay. The eastern extremity of the Bay of Ice reaches the [Gorge](Gorge) near the [Wall](Wall).

Bear Island.summary: Bear Island is a remote island in the [north](North) that is home to [House Mormont](House_Mormont). It lies within the [Bay of Ice](Bay_of_Ice), north of [Deepwood Motte](Deepwood_Motte) and south of the [Frozen Shore](Frozen_Shore). The Mormonts live in a [hall built of huge logs and surrounded by an earthen palisade](Hall_of_the_Mormonts).

Skirling Pass.summary: The Skirling Pass is a series of passes into the [Frostfangs](Frostfangs), located [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall). The path is named for the keening sound the wind makes as it blows through it.

The Gorge.summary: The Gorge is a large, deep gorge that separates the [Wall](Wall) from the [Bay of Ice](Bay_of_Ice). [Wildling](Free_folk) raiders from [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall) descend into the dark Gorge to bypass the Wall and enter the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms).

Shadow Tower.summary:
The Shadow Tower is one of three castles along the [Wall](Wall) that are still inhabited by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). It is located next to the [northern mountains](Northern_mountains) at the western end of the Wall. It lies west of [Sentinel Stand](Sentinel_Stand) and east of [Westwatch-by-the-Bridge](Westwatch-by-the-Bridge), both abandoned castles.

The [commander](Commander_%28Night's_Watch%29) of the Shadow Tower is Ser [Denys Mallister](Denys_Mallister), and its [maester](Maesters) is [Mullin](Mullin). Two hundred men of the Watch are stationed at the Shadow Tower. Most wear leather and fur, although some are armored with [bronze](Bronze) or [steel](Steel). Some are armed with longaxes and eight-foot spears. [Free folk](Free_folk) sometimes descend into the [Gorge](Gorge) to bypass the Shadow Tower.

The Nightfort.summary: The Nightfort was the first of the abandoned castles of the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch) along the [Wall](Wall), the only one whose steps up the side of the Wall were carved into the ice. It sits between [Icemark](Icemark) to the west and [Deep Lake](Deep_Lake) to the east. The Nightfort figures in some of [Old Nan](Old_Nan)'s scariest stories.

Castle Black.summary:
Castle Black is the main stronghold of the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch) and the seat of their [Lord Commander](Lord_Commander_of_the_Night's_Watch). The castle is situated along the [Wall](Wall) between [Queensgate](Queensgate) to the west and [Oakenshield](Oakenshield_%28Wall%29) to the east, near the center of the Wall, at the northern end of the [kingsroad](Kingsroad). The village of [Mole's Town](Mole's_Town) is located half a league to the south along the kingsroad.

Despite there being nineteen strongholds along the Wall, Castle Black is one of only three still manned by the Night's Watch, the others being the [Shadow Tower](Shadow_Tower) and [Eastwatch-by-the-Sea](Eastwatch-by-the-Sea).

Eastwatch-by-the-Sea.summary:
Eastwatch-by-the-Sea is the easternmost castle of the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch) along the [Wall](Wall), located on a grey, windswept shore by the [Bay of Seals](Bay_of_Seals). To the west lies [Greenguard](Greenguard), an abandoned castle. Some fisherfolk live near Eastwatch.

The [commander](Commander_%28Night's_Watch%29) of Eastwatch is [Cotter Pyke](Cotter_Pyke), while its [maester](Maesters) is [Harmune](Harmune). [Iron Emmett](Emmett) is a promising young [ranger](Rangers).

The Night's Watch keeps several [galleys](Watercraft) at Eastwatch, including larger vessels capable of crossing the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea), and lean fighting vessels. The galleys patrol the [Bay of Seals](Bay_of_Seals), and sometimes catch smugglers who trade weapons to the [free folk](Free_folk). Ships stationed at Eastwatch include [Talon](Talon), [Blackbird](Blackbird), and [Storm Crow](Storm_Crow).

Some free folk trade with the Night's Watch at Eastwatch; wildlings prefer it to [Castle Black](Castle_Black), because trading ships visit from across the narrow sea. Sure-footed [mules](Mule) that can handle the ice of the Wall are bred and specially trained by the Watch at Eastwatch.

The Wall.summary:
The Wall is a massive barrier of mostly ice stretching across the [northern](North) border of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), separating it from the [wild lands beyond](Beyond_the_Wall). The Wall is one hundred leagues long (three hundred miles) and reaches over seven hundred feet at his highest point, although some foundation blocks in hilly regions, such as near [Greyguard](Greyguard), send it nine hundred feet in the air.

One of [Lomas Longstrider](Lomas_Longstrider)'s nine [Wonders Made by Man](Wonders_Made_by_Man), the Wall is defended and held by the Sworn Brothers of the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch), who patrol and guard nineteen castles from the [Frostfangs](Frostfangs) mountain range in the west to the [Bay of Seals](Bay_of_Seals) in the east. Only the [Shadow Tower](Shadow_Tower), [Castle Black](Castle_Black), and [Eastwatch-by-the-Sea](Eastwatch-by-the-Sea) are garrisoned at the start of [A Song of Ice and Fire](A_Song_of_Ice_and_Fire). Those who join the Watch in order to avoid another punishment can be referred to as sent to the Wall.

Mole's Town.summary: Mole's Town is a village or town close to [Castle Black](Castle_Black). It lies along the [kingsroad](Kingsroad) in [Brandon's Gift](Gift), half a league south of the [Wall](Wall). [Jon Snow](Jon_Snow) refers to the village's [smallfolk](Smallfolk) as [moles](Mole).

Whitetree.summary: Whitetree is a small [free folk](Free_folk) village located northwest of [Castle Black](Castle_Black), [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall). Its name comes from the giant [weirwood](Weirwood) tree that is located in its midst.

Brandon's Gift.summary: The Gift, consisting of Brandon's Gift and the New Gift, is the area in the [north](North) stretching fifty leagues south from the [Wall](Wall), land given to the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch) in perpetuity to support and aid the Watch. It is under the protection of both the Watch and [Winterfell](Winterfell). The eastern lands of the Gift consist of large rolling plans that reach the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea), while the western regions, which end at the [Bay of Ice](Bay_of_Ice), are increasingly forested and [mountainous](Northern_mountains).

It is under the protection of both the Watch and [Winterfell](Winterfell). The eastern lands of the Gift consist of large rolling plans that reach the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea), while the western regions, which end at the [Bay of Ice](Bay_of_Ice), are increasingly forested and [mountainous](Northern_mountains).

Queenscrown.summary: Queenscrown is an abandoned tower [holdfast](Holdfast) with a village in the [New Gift](Gift). It is located west of the [kingsroad](Kingsroad) and south of the [Wall](Wall).

Hardhome.summary: Hardhome is an abandoned [free folk](Free_folk) settlement that lies north [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall). It is on the tip of the peninsula [Storrold's Point](Storrold's_Point) on the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea).

Storrold's Point.summary: Storrold's Point is a peninsula [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall) on the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). At its tip is [Hardhome](Hardhome), a ruined [free folk](Free_folk) settlement. [Crab](Crab) gods are worshiped by some tribes who live along Storrold's Point.

Craster's Keep.summary: Craster's Keep is the home of [Craster](Craster), an ornery [wildling](Free_folk) [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall) who is a friend to the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). It is not an actual [keep](Keep), but is only given that title by members of the Watch.

Fist of the First Men.summary: The Fist of the First Men is a hill found [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall) in the [haunted forest](Haunted_forest).

Skane.summary: Skane is an isle in the [north](North), located north of the island of [Skagos](Skagos) and the [Bay of Seals](Bay_of_Seals). It has windswept hills and stony shores.

captions: Skagos by Juan Carlos Barquet © Fantasy Flight Games
Skagos.summary:
Skagos is a large island in the mouth of the [Bay of Seals](Bay_of_Seals). In theory, the island is part of the [north](North) and subject to [House Stark](House_Stark) of [Winterfell](Winterfell). However, the island has little contact with mainland [Westeros](Westeros) and the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), and in practice the [Skagosi](Skagosi) rule themselves. The island's name means "stone" in the [Old Tongue](Old_Tongue).

Maester [Balder](Balder)'s [The Edge of the World](The_Edge_of_the_World) is the largest collection of tales regarding the island. It is believed that [unicorns](Unicorn) live on Skagos. The island has a dread reputation; even the hardened sailor [Roro Uhoris](Roro_Uhoris) feared to go there.

Deepdown.summary: Deepdown is the seat of [House Crowl](House_Crowl) on the island of [Skagos](Skagos) in the [north](North).

Driftwood Hall.summary: Driftwood Hall is the seat of [House Stane](House_Stane) on the island of [Skagos](Skagos) in the [north](North).

captions: Westwatch-by-the-Bridge by Marc Simonetti © Fantasy Flight Games
Westwatch-by-the-Bridge.summary:
Westwatch-by-the-Bridge is the westernmost castle of the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch), located near the [Gorge](Gorge) and the [Bridge of Skulls](Bridge_of_Skulls). East of the abandoned castle is the [Shadow Tower](Shadow_Tower), the westernmost of the inhabited castles of the Watch.

[A Dance with Dragons](A_Dance_with_Dragons) places Westwatch north of the Gorge and west of the [Wall](Wall). [The Lands of Ice and Fire](The_Lands_of_Ice_and_Fire) depicts Westwatch south of the Gorge and just east of the Bridge of Skulls, where the Wall ends.

Sentinel Stand.summary: Sentinel Stand is an abandoned castle along the [Wall](Wall) belonging to the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). It lies west of the [Shadow Tower](Shadow_Tower) and east of [Greyguard](Greyguard).

Greyguard.summary: Greyguard is a castle along the [Wall](Wall) abandoned by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). It lies west of [Stonedoor](Stonedoor) and east of [Sentinel Stand](Sentinel_Stand).

Stonedoor.summary: Stonedoor is a castle along the [Wall](Wall), abandoned by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). To the west lies [Greyguard](Greyguard) and to the east [Hoarfrost Hill](Hoarfrost_Hill). The landscape near Stonedoor is hilly.

Hoarfrost Hill.summary: Hoarfrost Hill is a castle along the [Wall](Wall) abandoned by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). It is located between [Stonedoor](Stonedoor) to the west and [Icemark](Icemark) to the east.

Icemark.summary: Icemark is a castle along the [Wall](Wall) that has been abandoned by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). To the west lies [Hoarfrost Hill](Hoarfrost_Hill) and to the east, the [Nightfort](Nightfort).

Deep Lake.summary:
Deep Lake is a [castle](Castle) along the [Wall](Wall). The castle was abandoned some time ago by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch) due to the order's manpower shortages. To the east of Deep Lake sits [Queensgate](Queensgate) and to the west is the [Nightfort](Nightfort).

The castle is located seven miles east of the [Nightfort](Nightfort) where the Wall curves around the southern shore of a beautiful green lake; a tributary flows west to the [Milkwater](Milkwater).

Queensgate.summary: Queensgate, once known as Snowgate, is an abandoned castle along the [Wall](Wall). It was formerly manned by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch) but was abandoned as the Watch shrank. To the west lies [Deep Lake](Deep_Lake) and to the east [Castle Black](Castle_Black).

Oakenshield.summary: Oakenshield is one of the [Shield Islands](Shield_Islands) in the [Reach](Reach). The easternmost of the four isles, it lies near the mouth of the river [Mander](Mander). [Lord Hewett's Town](Lord_Hewett's_Town), the seat of [House Hewett](House_Hewett), is found on the island.

Oakenshield (castle).summary: Oakenshield is an abandoned castle along the [Wall](Wall) belonging to the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). [Castle Black](Castle_Black) lies to its west, while to the east is [Woodswatch-by-the-Pool](Woodswatch-by-the-Pool).

Woodswatch-by-the-Pool.summary: Woodswatch-by-the-Pool is a castle along the [Wall](Wall). It was abandoned by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). It is situated along the Wall between [Oakenshield](Oakenshield_%28Wall%29) to the west and [Sable Hall](Sable_Hall) to the east.

Sable Hall.summary: Sable Hall is a castle along the [Wall](Wall) abandoned by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). It is located between [Woodswatch-by-the-Pool](Woodswatch-by-the-Pool) to the west and [Rimegate](Rimegate) to the east.

Rimegate.summary: Rimegate is a castle along the [Wall](Wall) abandoned by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). It is located between [Sable Hall](Sable_Hall) to the west and the [Long Barrow](Long_Barrow) to the east.

Long Barrow.summary: Long Barrow, also called the Long Barrow, is a castle along the [Wall](Wall), abandoned by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). It is situated along the Wall between [Rimegate](Rimegate) to west and the [Torches](Torches) to the east.

The Torches.summary: The Torches is a castle along the [Wall](Wall) abandoned by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). It is located between the [Long Barrow](Long_Barrow) to the west and [Greenguard](Greenguard) to the east.

Greenguard.summary: Greenguard is a castle along the [Wall](Wall) abandoned by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). It is located between the [Torches](Torches) to the west and [Eastwatch-by-the-Sea](Eastwatch-by-the-Sea) to the east.

Bridge of Skulls.summary: The Bridge of Skulls is a bridge which traverses the [Gorge](Gorge), located west of the [Wall](Wall) in northern [Westeros](Westeros). It is a dangerous route named for the bones in the Gorge below.

Kingshouse (Skagos).summary: Kingshouse is the seat of [House Magnar](House_Magnar) on the island [Skagos](Skagos) in the [north](North).

Bay of Seals.summary: The Bay of Seals is a bay in the [north](North) that extends from [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall) to the shores that fall under the domain of [House Umber](House_Umber). The [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch) have a castle astride it, [Eastwatch-by-the-Sea](Eastwatch-by-the-Sea). Isles of the bay, which is named after the [animal](Seal), include [Skagos](Skagos) and [Skane](Skane).

Sea Dragon Point.summary: Sea Dragon Point is a forested peninsula west of the [wolfswood](Wolfswood) in the [north](North). It juts out into [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea), near the [Bay of Ice](Bay_of_Ice) and [Bear Island](Bear_Island).

Deepwood Motte.summary: Deepwood Motte, also called simply Deepwood, is the seat of [House Glover](House_Glover) in the [north](North). The wooden motte-and-bailey castle lies in the northern [wolfswood](Wolfswood), east of [Sea Dragon Point](Sea_Dragon_Point).

Breakstone Hill.summary: Breakstone Hill is the seat of [House Flint of Breakstone Hill](House_Flint_of_Breakstone_Hill), who ruled as [First Men](First_Men) kings until being defeated by the [Kings of Winter](King_in_the_North), [House Stark](House_Stark) of [Winterfell](Winterfell). If the Breakstone Flints are the same as [House Flint of the mountains](House_Flint_of_the_mountains), Breakstone is probably located in the [northern mountains](Northern_mountains).

The Northern Mountains.summary: The Northern mountains or northern hills are a range of mountains and hills inhabited by [clans](Northern_mountain_clans) in the northwestern part of the [north](North).

Tumbledown Tower.summary: Tumbledown Tower is [Bran Stark](Bran_Stark)'s name for an abandoned watchtower in the [north](North).

Castle Cerwyn.summary: Castle Cerwyn, or simply Cerwyn, is the seat of [House Cerwyn](House_Cerwyn) in the [north](North). It is located by the western branch of the [White Knife](White_Knife). Because of the closeness of their castles, the Cerwyns often visit the [Starks](House_Stark), as they are only half a day's ride from [Winterfell](Winterfell).

Last Hearth.summary: Last Hearth, sometimes called the Last Hearth, is the seat of [House Umber](House_Umber) in the [north](North). It lies close to the [Gift](Gift) in a forest east of the [kingsroad](Kingsroad). The castle is north of the [Last River](Last_River), northeast of [Long Lake](Long_Lake), and west of the [Bay of Seals](Bay_of_Seals). With the exception of the castles of the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch), Last Hearth is the northernmost major castle of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms).

Karhold.summary: Karhold is the seat of [House Karstark](House_Karstark) in the [north](North). It is located along a forested river in the eastern half of the north, south of the [Bay of Seals](Bay_of_Seals). Further to the east are the [Grey Cliffs](Grey_Cliffs).

Grey Cliffs.summary: The Grey Cliffs are a series of cliffs in the [north](North). They lie along the shore of the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea), east of [Karhold](Karhold). The waters near the cliffs have rich fishing grounds.

The Lonely Hills.summary: The Lonely Hills are a series of hills controlled by [House Umber](House_Umber) in the [north](North). They lie east of [Long Lake](Long_Lake), south of the [Last River](Last_River) and the [Last Hearth](Last_Hearth), and northwest of the [Dreadfort](Dreadfort).

captions: The Last River by Franz Miklis © Fantasy Flight Games
The Last River.summary:
The Last River is a river found in the most northern part of the [north](North), nearer to the [Wall](Wall) than to [Winterfell](Winterfell). Much of the land on either side of the river is ruled by [House Umber](House_Umber).

The Last River's headwaters are a number of streams in the [northern mountains](Northern_mountains). It flows east past the [kingsroad](Kingsroad) and through the Umber forest containing [Last Hearth](Last_Hearth). The river then continues southeast between the [Dreadfort](Dreadfort) and [Karhold](Karhold) to the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). There is ice fishing on the northern rivers.

Located on the northern bank of the [Weeping Water](Weeping_Water), the fortress is southeast of the [Lonely Hills](Lonely_Hills) and north of the [Sheepshead Hills](Sheepshead_Hills). The Dreadfort is north of [Hornwood](Hornwood), south of [Last Hearth](Last_Hearth), and southwest of [Karhold](Karhold).

The North.summary:
The north, also called the North, is one of the constituent regions of [Westeros](Westeros) and was a sovereign nation ruled by [Kings in the North](King_in_the_North) before [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest). The largest region of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), the dominion of [House Stark](House_Stark) extends from the border of the [New Gift](<Gift.md#New Gift>), which is controlled by the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch), to the southern edge of the [Neck](Neck) far to the south.

The north has been ruled by the Starks for thousands of years from the castle known as [Winterfell](Winterfell). The only city in the region is [White Harbor](White_Harbor), while the most prominent northern towns are the [winter town](Winter_town) and [Barrowton](Barrowton). Notable bannermen of the region include [Bolton](House_Bolton), [Cerwyn](House_Cerwyn), [Dustin](House_Dustin), [Flint](House_Flint), [Glover](House_Glover), [Hornwood](House_Hornwood), [Karstark](House_Karstark), [Manderly](House_Manderly), [Mormont](House_Mormont), [Reed](House_Reed), [Ryswell](House_Ryswell), [Tallhart](House_Tallhart), and [Umber](House_Umber). [Bastards](Bastardy) of noble origin raised in the north are given the surname Snow.

The Sheepshead Hills.summary:
The Sheepshead Hills are a series of hills located in the eastern lands of the [north](North). They lie south of the [Weeping Water](Weeping_Water), northwest of [Ramsgate](Ramsgate), northeast of [White Harbor](White_Harbor), and east of the [White Knife](White_Knife). The headwaters of the [Broken Branch](Broken_Branch) begin in the Sheepshead Hills.

According to a semi-canon source, the Sheepshead Hills are located within the dominion of [House Manderly](House_Manderly). [Hornwood](Hornwood), the seat of [House Hornwood](House_Hornwood), is located near the northwestern edge of the hills.

captions: Weeping Water by Franz Miklis © Fantasy Flight Games
The Weeping Water.summary: The Weeping Water is a river between the [Last River](Last_River), the [Lonely Hills](Lonely_Hills), and the [Sheepshead Hills](Sheepshead_Hills) in the [north](North). The [Dreadfort](Dreadfort), the seat of [House Bolton](House_Bolton), lies along the river, which flows southeast into the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea).

Hornwood.summary:
Hornwood is the semi-canonical name for the seat of [House Hornwood](House_Hornwood) in the north. It is one of the castles of the family.

The Hornwood lands neighbor those of [House Bolton](House_Bolton) to the north. The location of their seat has not been published in [A Song of Ice and Fire](A_Song_of_Ice_and_Fire), but according to a semi-canon source, the castle is located in the [Hornwood forest](Hornwood_%28forest%29) near the northwestern edge of the [Sheepshead Hills](Sheepshead_Hills), which are within the dominion of [House Manderly](House_Manderly).

Torrhen's Square.summary: Torrhen's Square is a castle in the [north](North) and the seat of [House Tallhart](House_Tallhart). It is south of the [wolfswood](Wolfswood), southwest of [Winterfell](Winterfell), and north of [Barrowton](Barrowton), on the northern shore of a large lake. A river from the lake leads south to the [Saltspear](Saltspear).

The Stony Shore.summary: The Stony Shore, also called the stony shore, is a region along the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea) on the western coast of the [north](North).

The Rills.summary: The Rills is an area in the [north](North) ruled by [House Ryswell](House_Ryswell). It is located southeast of the [Stony Shore](Stony_Shore), north of [Blazewater Bay](Blazewater_Bay), and west of the [barrowlands](Barrowlands). The area's name suggests it has numerous streams and brooks.

The Barrowlands.summary: The barrowlands is an area of extensive plains between [Winterfell](Winterfell) and [Moat Cailin](Moat_Cailin) in the [north](North).

Barrowton.summary: Barrowton, occasionally called Barrowtown, is a prominent town in the [north](North) which contains [Barrow Hall](Barrow_Hall), the seat of [House Dustin](House_Dustin). It lies in the [barrowlands](Barrowlands) at or near the confluence of two rivers which flow south to the [Saltspear](Saltspear).

White Harbor.summary:
White Harbor is a harbor city in the [north](North) which contains the [New Castle](New_Castle), the seat of [House Manderly](House_Manderly). Located southeast of [Winterfell](Winterfell), it is the largest settlement north of the [Neck](Neck), but the smallest among the five major cities of [Westeros](Westeros). White Harbor is the north's primary trade port. Its location on the mouth of the [White Knife](White_Knife) provides opportunities for trade further north.

Due to its location, White Harbor has more contact with southern Westeros and has a mixed population, and there are more [knights](Knight) and followers of the [Faith of the Seven](Faith_of_the_Seven) in the city than anywhere else in the north. There are some followers of the [old gods](Old_gods) in White Harbor, but most follow the Seven.

The Kingsroad.summary: The kingsroad is the main overland route in the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), extending for almost two thousand miles from [Storm's End](Storm's_End) through [King's Landing](King's_Landing) to the [Wall](Wall). It is not as impressive as the great [Valyrian roads](Valyrian_roads) of the past, but overall it increases mobility and speeds of travel.

Ramsgate.summary: Ramsgate is a castle in the [north](North) located at the mouth of the [Broken Branch](Broken_Branch), possibly along the northeastern [Bite](Bite). The castle is west of [Widow's Watch](Widow's_Watch) and east of [White Harbor](White_Harbor). According to a semi-canon source, Ramsgate owes allegiance to [House Manderly](House_Manderly).

Widow's Watch.summary: Widow's Watch is the seat of [House Flint of Widow's Watch](House_Flint_of_Widow's_Watch) in the [north](North). It is located at the end of a peninsula between the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea) and the [Bite](Bite), east of [Ramsgate](Ramsgate) and the [Broken Branch](Broken_Branch).

Moat Cailin.summary:
Moat Cailin, sometimes called the Moat, is an ancient stronghold of the [First Men](First_Men) on the northern edge of the great swamp known as the [Neck](Neck), in the south of the [north](North). It is less than twenty miles from the headwaters of the [Fever River](Fever_River). Moat Cailin is one of the north's most important strongholds, though much of the castle now stands in ruins. It commands the [causeway](Causeway), the safe route for armies to travel through the swamps of the Neck.

Moat Cailin is an effective natural choke point which has protected the north from [southron](Southron) invasion for thousands of years. The [crannogmen](Crannogmen) of the Neck know unmapped routes through the swamps, such as narrow trails between the bogs and wet roads through the reeds that only boats can follow.

Oldcastle.summary: Oldcastle is the seat of [House Locke](House_Locke) in the [north](North). It lies on the northern shore of the [Bite](Bite), southeast of [White Harbor](White_Harbor) and north of the [Three Sisters](Three_Sisters).

Blazewater Bay.summary:
Blazewater Bay is a large bay of the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea) along the western coast of the [north](North). It sits north of [Cape Kraken](Cape_Kraken) and south of the [Rills](Rills). It extends east into the [Saltspear](Saltspear), which is fed by the [Fever River](Fever_River). [Flint's Finger](Flint's_Finger) is located along Blazewater Bay.

The Saltspear.summary: Saltspear, also called the Saltspear, is a long inlet of [Blazewater Bay](Blazewater_Bay) in the [north](North).

The Neck.summary:
The Neck is one of the southernmost regions of the [north](North). Covered in swamp and bog, it divides the north from the rest of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms). West of the Neck is a large forest and a peninsula containing [Flint's Finger](Flint's_Finger), the [Flint Cliffs](Flint_Cliffs), and [Cape Kraken](Cape_Kraken), while to the east is the [Bite](Bite). North of the Neck are the [barrowlands](Barrowlands), while to the south are the [Twins](Twins), [Seagard](Seagard), and the [Cape of Eagles](Cape_of_Eagles) in the [riverlands](Riverlands). The [Green Fork](Green_Fork) of the [Trident](Trident) originates in the Neck.

The Neck, which is inhabited by [crannogmen](Crannogmen) and contains the ruins of [Moat Cailin](Moat_Cailin), is considered the key to any assault on the north.

Greywater Watch.summary: Greywater Watch, also known as Greywater, is the seat of [House Reed](House_Reed) in the [north](North).

Flint's Finger.summary: Flint's Finger is the seat of [House Flint of Flint's Finger](House_Flint_of_Flint's_Finger) in the [north](North). It is located on the southern shore of [Blazewater Bay](Blazewater_Bay), north of the [Flint Cliffs](Flint_Cliffs) and east of [Cape Kraken](Cape_Kraken).

Cape Kraken.summary: Cape Kraken is a cape in the southwestern part of the [north](North).

Flint Cliffs.summary: The Flint Cliffs are a series of cliffs in the [north](North) along the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea), east of [Cape Kraken](Cape_Kraken), west of the [Neck](Neck), and north of the [Iron Islands](Iron_Islands). The cliffs are named after [House Flint of Flint's Finger](House_Flint_of_Flint's_Finger).

Cape of Eagles.summary: The Cape of Eagles is a cape in the [riverlands](Riverlands) that juts out into [Ironman's Bay](Ironman's_Bay), pointing the way to the [Iron Islands](Iron_Islands). It is located west of [Seagard](Seagard) and is ruled by [House Mallister](House_Mallister).

Ironman's Bay.summary: Ironman's Bay is a bay of the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea) on the western coast of [Westeros](Westeros). It is named after the ironmen or [ironborn](Ironborn), the inhabitants of the nearby [Iron Islands](Iron_Islands).

The Twins.summary: The Twins, sometimes known as the Crossing, is the seat of [House Frey](House_Frey) in the northern [riverlands](Riverlands), located south of the bogs of the [Neck](Neck) and west of the [kingsroad](Kingsroad). A fortified crossing of the [Green Fork](Green_Fork) of the [Trident](Trident), the Twins consists of identical castles on each side of the river and a tower in the middle of the bridge which connects them. It is one of the most formidable strongholds of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms).

The Bite.summary: The Bite is a long bay of eastern [Westeros](Westeros), located between the [north](North) and the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn).

The Three Sisters.summary:
The Three Sisters are a group of three islands—[Sweetsister](Sweetsister), [Longsister](Longsister), and [Littlesister](Littlesister)—found in the [Bite](Bite), located south of [White Harbor](White_Harbor) and north of the [Mountains of the Moon](Mountains_of_the_Moon). The islands owe loose allegiance to [House Arryn](House_Arryn) of the [Vale](Vale_of_Arryn).

The islands are considered dens of avarice and sin by [septons](Septon). People from the Three Sisters are known as [Sistermen](Sistermen). Some have webbing between their hands and feet, which they call the mark.

Longsister.summary: Longsister is one of the [Three Sisters](Three_Sisters), a group of islands in the [Bite](Bite). It is the seat of [House Longthorpe](House_Longthorpe) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn).

Littlesister.summary: Littlesister is the seat of [House Torrent](House_Torrent) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). Located in the [Bite](Bite), it is the smallest and easternmost island of the [Three Sisters](Three_Sisters).

Sweetsister.summary: Sweetsister is an island of the [Three Sisters](Three_Sisters) in the [Bite](Bite). It is the seat of [House Borrell](House_Borrell), who are sworn to the [Arryns](House_Arryn) of the [Vale](Vale_of_Arryn). The town of [Sisterton](Sisterton) and [Breakwater Castle](Breakwater) are located on Sweetsister.

The Paps.summary: The Paps is an island to the northeast of the [Fingers](Fingers) in the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea). The seat of [House Elesham](House_Elesham), the Paps is considered part of the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn) and is sworn to the [Eyrie](Eyrie). It is named after a pair of large, stony hills that rise together on the island.

The Fingers.summary: The Fingers, or the Five Fingers, are narrow peninsulas of the northeastern [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn) which extend into the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea) and the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea).

Located on the western coast along [Ironman's Bay](Ironman's_Bay), Seagard is sheltered by the [Cape of Eagles](Cape_of_Eagles) and is nestled near the headwaters of the [Blue Fork](Blue_Fork). It is southwest of the [Twins](Twins) and northwest of [Oldstones](Oldstones).

Iron Islands.summary:
The Iron Islands, the Iron Isles, or the Kingdom of the Iron Isles, is one of the constituent regions of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms). The isles were historically ruled by [rock](Rock_king), [salt](Salt_king), and [High Kings](High_King_of_the_Iron_Islands) chosen in [kingsmoots](Kingsmoot), next by hereditary [Kings of the Iron Islands](King_of_the_Iron_Islands), and then briefly by [Kings of the Isles and the Rivers](King_of_the_Isles_and_the_Rivers). Since [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest), the region has been ruled by [House Greyjoy](House_Greyjoy), [Lords of the Iron Islands](Lord_of_the_Iron_Islands), from their castle of [Pyke](Pyke).

The Iron Islands are home to a fierce seafaring people who call themselves the [ironborn](Ironborn). While some say the archipelago is named after the abundant [iron](Iron) ore on the islands, the ironmen claim it is instead named after their own unyielding nature. It is often said that every captain is a king aboard his own ship, so the islands are also called "the land of ten thousand kings".

Notable houses have included [Blacktyde](House_Blacktyde), [Botley](House_Botley), [Drumm](House_Drumm), [Goodbrother](House_Goodbrother), [Greyiron](House_Greyiron), [Harlaw](House_Harlaw), [Hoare](House_Hoare), [Merlyn](House_Merlyn), [Stonehouse](House_Stonehouse), [Sunderly](House_Sunderly), [Tawney](House_Tawney), and [Wynch](House_Wynch). [Bastards](Bastardy) of noble origin from the Iron Islands receive the surname Pyke.

[Banefort](Banefort) in the [westerlands](Westerlands) is across [Ironman's Bay](Ironman's_Bay) to the south.

It is the seat of [House Greyjoy](House_Greyjoy), whose lord is known as the [Lord Reaper of Pyke](Lord_Reaper_of_Pyke). The Greyjoys have been [Lords of the Iron Islands](Lord_of_the_Iron_Islands) since [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest). The Greyjoys claim the island is named after the castle.

Lordsport.summary: Lordsport is the seat of [House Botley](House_Botley) on [Pyke](Pyke_%28island%29). Located on the central northern shore of the isle, it is the largest town in the [Iron Islands](Iron_Islands).

It is situated in the western [riverlands](Riverlands), at the confluence of the [Tumblestone](Tumblestone) and [Red Fork](Red_Fork) rivers. Harrenhal.summary:
Harrenhal, the largest castle in the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), is the seat of [House Whent](House_Whent) in the [riverlands](Riverlands), on the north shore of the [Gods Eye](Gods_Eye). Since the [burning of Harrenhal](Burning_of_Harrenhal) by [dragonfire](Dragonflame) in [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest), however, the castle has become a dark and ruinous place.

Harrenhal's holdings are some of the richest in [Westeros](Westeros), claiming vast tracts of green fertile land which reach as far as the hills of [House Wode](House_Wode) near the [crownlands](Crownlands). [Harrentown](Harrenton) is found near the castle. Lake roads along the eastern and western shores of the Gods Eye lead to Harrenhal.

Made of numerous smaller tributaries, it is one of the largest rivers on the continent of [Westeros](Westeros). It is a confluence of three main branches, the [Red Fork](Red_Fork), the [Green Fork](Green_Fork), and the [Blue Fork](Blue_Fork).

The Blue Fork.summary: The Blue Fork is one of the three main rivers of the [Trident](Trident) in the [riverlands](Riverlands), the other two being the [Green Fork](Green_Fork) and the [Red Fork](Red_Fork). The Blue Fork is named for the purity of its waters.

The Riverlands.summary:
The riverlands, historically the Kingdom of Rivers and Hills, are a central region of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms) of [Westeros](Westeros), consisting of the rich, fertile, and populous areas around the three forks of the [Trident](Trident) and the northern [Blackwater Rush](Blackwater_Rush). At the time of [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest) the riverlands and the [Iron Islands](Iron_Islands) were ruled by [House Hoare](House_Hoare), the [Kings of the Isles and the Rivers](King_of_the_Isles_and_the_Rivers), although native [river kings](King_of_the_Trident) ruled centuries earlier.

Because of their central position in Westeros and lack of natural boundaries, the riverlands have been a frequent battleground. The people of the riverlands are known as "[rivermen](Rivermen)" or occasionally "riverlanders", and they are a mixture of hardy warriors, peaceful fisherfolk, and devout [smallfolk](Smallfolk). Their lords have a reputation for being notoriously quarrelsome, and are referred to as "river lords". Noble [bastards](Bastardy) born in the riverlands are given the surname Rivers.

The riverlands are ruled from [Riverrun](Riverrun) by [House Tully](House_Tully), the [Lords Paramount of the Trident](Lord_Paramount_of_the_Trident). Notable houses of the region have included [Blackwood](House_Blackwood), [Bracken](House_Bracken), [Darry](House_Darry), [Frey](House_Frey), [Lothston](House_Lothston), [Mallister](House_Mallister), [Mooton](House_Mooton), [Mudd](House_Mudd), [Piper](House_Piper), [Ryger](House_Ryger), [Strong](House_Strong), [Vance](House_Vance), and [Whent](House_Whent).

Maidenpool.summary:
Maidenpool is a town in the eastern [riverlands](Riverlands) situated along the southern shore of the [Bay of Crabs](Bay_of_Crabs). It is the seat of [House Mooton](House_Mooton). The castle at Maidenpool sits on a hill, and the town is walled. East of Maidenpool are hills and [soldier pines](Soldier_pine).

There are two roads leading to [King's Landing](King's_Landing) from Maidenpool, one [a faster road](Duskendale_road) which goes through [Duskendale](Duskendale) and the other which travels along the coast.

Stoney Sept.summary:
Stoney Sept is a walled town in the southern [riverlands](Riverlands). It is located south of [Acorn Hall](Acorn_Hall), southeast of [Pinkmaiden](Pinkmaiden_Castle), and north of the [Goldroad](Goldroad). The headwaters of the [Blackwater Rush](Blackwater_Rush) are nearby.

A knight named Ser [Wilbert](Wilbert) is described as having some authority in Stoney Sept, but his House is not mentioned.

Pinkmaiden.summary: Pinkmaiden Castle, also known simply as Pinkmaiden, is the seat of [House Piper](House_Piper) in the southwestern [riverlands](Riverlands). The [castle](Castle) is located on the [Red Fork](Red_Fork) south of [Riverrun](Riverrun), southeast of [Acorn Hall](Acorn_Hall), northwest of [Stoney Sept](Stoney_Sept), and northeast of [Hornvale](Hornvale).

Stone Hedge.summary: Stone Hedge, sometimes called the Stone Hedge, is the seat of [House Bracken](House_Bracken) in the [riverlands](Riverlands).

The castle is located north of [Riverrun](Riverrun), southwest of [Oldstones](Oldstones), and west of [Fairmarket](Fairmarket). [Ironman's Bay](Ironman's_Bay) is to the northwest.

Whitewalls.summary: Whitewalls, nicknamed the Milkhouse, was the second castle of [House Butterwell](House_Butterwell). Its location on maps has not yet been published, but it was located in the [riverlands](Riverlands). The castle was built near the [Gods Eye](Gods_Eye), with the Butterwell lands on the eastern shore of the lake. Whitewalls was closer to [Maidenpool](Maidenpool) than to [King's Landing](King's_Landing).

It is sometimes called the Old Inn and was formerly named the Two Crowns, the Bellringer Inn, the Clanking Dragon, and the River Inn.

Fairmarket.summary: Fairmarket is a market town in the northern [riverlands](Riverlands). It is situated on the [Blue Fork](Blue_Fork) of the [Trident](Trident).

Antlers.summary: Antlers, also called the Antlers, is the seat of [House Buckwell](House_Buckwell) in the [crownlands](Crownlands). It is located southwest of [Maidenpool](Maidenpool), west of [Rook's Rest](Rook's_Rest), and northwest of [Duskendale](Duskendale) and [Rosby](Rosby).

The Eyrie.summary: The Eyrie is an ancient castle and seat of [House Arryn](House_Arryn), one of the oldest lines of [Andal](Andals) nobility, within the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). It is situated in the [Mountains of the Moon](Mountains_of_the_Moon) on a shoulder of the peak known as the [Giant's Lance](Giant's_Lance), several thousand feet above [the valley below](Vale_of_Arryn_%28valley%29). Although small compared to the seats of other [Great Houses](Great_houses) in Westeros, the Eyrie is considered impregnable to attack. During wintertime, the Arryns seek refuge against the cold in the [Gates of the Moon](Gates_of_the_Moon) at the base of the mountain.

The Vale of Arryn.summary:
The Vale of Arryn, the Vale, or the kingdom of Mountain and Vale, is one of the constituent regions of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms) of [Westeros](Westeros). It was formerly a sovereign nation ruled by the [Kings of Mountain and Vale](King_of_Mountain_and_Vale) before [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest). The [Mountains of the Moon](Mountains_of_the_Moon) surround the smaller [Vale proper](Vale_of_Arryn_%28valley%29), although the valley's name is often applied to all of [House Arryn](House_Arryn)'s realm.

The Vale is ruled by the Arryns from the castle known as the [Eyrie](Eyrie). Notable houses of this region include [Baelish](House_Baelish), [Belmore](House_Belmore), [Corbray](House_Corbray), [Egen](House_Egen), [Grafton](House_Grafton), [Hersy](House_Hersy), [Hunter](House_Hunter), [Melcolm](House_Melcolm), [Redfort](House_Redfort), [Royce](House_Royce), [Templeton](House_Templeton), and [Waynwood](House_Waynwood). [Bastards](Bastardy) of noble origin raised in the Vale are given the surname Stone.

Gulltown.summary:
Gulltown is the major port city of the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). It is located in a fine [natural harbor](Harbor_of_Gulltown) at the northern tip of the [Bay of Crabs](Bay_of_Crabs), southeast of the [Eyrie](Eyrie) and south of nearby [Runestone](Runestone). It is the largest settlement in the Vale, but is much smaller than [King's Landing](King's_Landing), [Lannisport](Lannisport), and [Oldtown](Oldtown).

Gulltown is ruled by [House Grafton](House_Grafton) and also contains a cadet branch of the Vale's rulers, [House Arryn of Gulltown](House_Arryn_of_Gulltown). According to semi-canon sources, there are branches of [House Shett](House_Shett) in or near the city. The demonym used for its inhabitants is "Gulltowner".

The Bloody Gate.summary: The Bloody Gate is a series of battlements in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). It is located along the [high road](High_road) which leads into the [Vale proper](Vale_of_Arryn_%28valley%29) from the [Mountains of the Moon](Mountains_of_the_Moon). It protects against [mountain clansmen](Vale_mountain_clans) and invading armies.

Runestone.summary: Runestone is the seat of [House Royce](House_Royce) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). The castle lies on a peninsula north of the [Bay of Crabs](Bay_of_Crabs), east of [Redfort](Redfort) and south of [Old Anchor](Old_Anchor). While Runestone is on the northern shore of the peninsula, the nearby city of [Gulltown](Gulltown) is on the southern shore.

Strongsong.summary: Strongsong is the seat of [House Belmore](House_Belmore) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). It is situated near a series of lakes within the [Mountains of the Moon](Mountains_of_the_Moon); a nearby river flows east through a valley to [Heart's Home](Heart's_Home). The [Eyrie](Eyrie) is to the southeast.

Ironoaks.summary: Ironoaks, also known as Ironoaks Castle, is the seat of [House Waynwood](House_Waynwood) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). The [castle](Castle) is located east of the [Eyrie](Eyrie) and west of [Old Anchor](Old_Anchor) and is situated by a lake. A river runs east from the lake to the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea).

Redfort.summary: Redfort, also called the Redfort, is the ancient seat of [House Redfort](House_Redfort) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). The [castle](Castle) is located in the south of [the valley](Vale_of_Arryn_%28valley%29) near the source of a river which flows northeast to the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea). Redfort is southeast of the [Eyrie](Eyrie), south of [Ironoaks](Ironoaks), and north of [Wickenden](Wickenden).

Longbow Hall.summary: Longbow Hall is the seat of [House Hunter](House_Hunter) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). It is located south of the [Fingers](Fingers), east of [Heart's Home](Heart's_Home), and north of [Old Anchor](Old_Anchor). It appears to be located in the foothills between a mountain range and the east of the valley. [Willamen](Willamen_Frey) is the [maester](Maesters) at Longbow Hall.

Old Anchor.summary: Old Anchor is the seat of [House Melcolm](House_Melcolm) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). It is located east of [Ironoaks](Ironoaks) where a river flows into the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea). [Longbow Hall](Longbow_Hall) is to the north and [Runestone](Runestone) is to the south across a bay of the narrow sea.

Coldwater.summary: Coldwater Burn or Coldwater is the seat of [House Coldwater](House_Coldwater) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). It is located near the mouth of a river west of the [Fingers](Fingers). The castle of [Snakewood](Snakewood) is nearby beyond a mountain range to the south.

Snakewood.summary: Snakewood is the seat of [House Lynderly](House_Lynderly) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). It sits on the southernmost of the [Fingers](Fingers), along the mountainous northern shore of a bay of the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea). Nearby castles are [Coldwater](Coldwater_Burn) to the north and [Heart's Home](Heart's_Home) to the southwest.

Sisterton.summary: Sisterton is a town located on [Sweetsister](Sweetsister), an island of the [Three Sisters](Three_Sisters), in the [Bite](Bite). The seat of [House Borrell](House_Borrell), Sisterton is known as a den for [smugglers](Smuggler).

Dragonstone.summary:
Dragonstone is a castle on [the island of the same name](Dragonstone_%28island%29) at the entrance to [Blackwater Bay](Blackwater_Bay), below the [Dragonmont](Dragonmont). It was the original seat of [House Targaryen](House_Targaryen) in [Westeros](Westeros), and had been colonized and fortified as the westernmost outpost of the [Valyrian Freehold](Valyrian_Freehold). Shaped from stone to look like [dragons](Dragon), the castle has a dark reputation.

After [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest) of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), Dragonstone in the newly-created [crownlands](Crownlands) served as the seat of their heir apparent, known as the [Prince of Dragonstone](Prince_of_Dragonstone). After [Robert Baratheon](Robert_I_Baratheon) overthrew the Targaryens in [Robert's Rebellion](Robert's_Rebellion), he gave the castle to his brother [Stannis](Stannis_Baratheon), creating [House Baratheon of Dragonstone](House_Baratheon_of_Dragonstone).

Dragonstone, though old and strong, commands the allegiance of only a few lesser lords whose islands are too thinly populated to provide any great numbers of troops, although they have some naval strength. A short distance west of Dragonstone is the island of [Driftmark](Driftmark), which is the seat of [House Velaryon](House_Velaryon), a Valyrian house and historically a naval power. Other houses sworn to Dragonstone include [Celtigar](House_Celtigar) of [Claw Isle](Claw_Isle), who are also of Valyrian descent, [Seaworth](House_Seaworth) of [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath), [Bar Emmon](House_Bar_Emmon) of [Sharp Point](Sharp_Point), and [Sunglass](House_Sunglass) of [Sweetport Sound](Sweetport_Sound).

Claw Isle.summary: Claw Isle is the island seat of [House Celtigar](House_Celtigar) in the [crownlands](Crownlands). It lies a few hours sail north from [Dragonstone](Dragonstone). The people of [Crackclaw Point](Crackclaw_Point) refer to the island as Crab Isle.

Driftmark.summary: Driftmark is an island west of [Dragonstone](Dragonstone_%28island%29) in [Blackwater Bay](Blackwater_Bay). The seat of [House Velaryon](House_Velaryon) in the [crownlands](Crownlands), it has a long point. The [Gullet](Gullet) separates Driftmark from [Massey's Hook](Massey's_Hook) to the south.

The Gullet.summary: The Gullet is the stretch of water in the [crownlands](Crownlands) between [Dragonstone](Dragonstone) and [Driftmark](Driftmark) to the north and [Massey's Hook](Massey's_Hook) to the south. [Blackwater Bay](Blackwater_Bay) opens into the Gullet, which connects with the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea).

Massey's Hook.summary:
Massey's Hook, sometimes simply called the Hook, is a peninsula in the [crownlands](Crownlands) that defines the eastern extent of [Blackwater Bay](Blackwater_Bay). Ships must sail around the Hook in order to get to [King's Landing](King's_Landing) from the south.

The [Gullet](Gullet) separates Massey's Hook from [Dragonstone](Dragonstone_%28island%29) and [Driftmark](Driftmark) to the north, while southwest of the peninsula are the [kingswood](Kingswood) and the [Wendwater](Wendwater).

[King's Landing](King's_Landing), the capital of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), sits where the [Blackwater Rush](Blackwater_Rush) pours into the bay. "Waters" is a common [bastard](Bastardy) name around Blackwater Bay.

Formerly ruled by the [Darklyns](House_Darklyn), it is now the seat of [House Rykker](House_Rykker).

The Crownlands.summary:
The crownlands are one of the nine constituent regions of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms) of [Westeros](Westeros). It was never a sovereign kingdom, instead being contested by [river kings](King_of_the_Trident), [Storm Kings](Storm_King), and local petty kings until [Aegon the Conqueror](Aegon_I_Targaryen) seized control of the area during his [Wars of Conquest](Wars_of_Conquest) and made it his primary foothold on the continent. Since then, the crownlands have been sworn directly to the [Iron Throne](Iron_Throne), held first by [House Targaryen](House_Targaryen) and then, after [Robert's Rebellion](Robert's_Rebellion), by [House Baratheon](House_Baratheon_of_King's_Landing).

Some notable houses of the crownlands include [Bar Emmon](House_Bar_Emmon), [Celtigar](House_Celtigar), [Massey](House_Massey), [Rosby](House_Rosby), [Rykker](House_Rykker), [Stokeworth](House_Stokeworth), [Sunglass](House_Sunglass), and [Velaryon](House_Velaryon). "Waters" is a common surname given to [bastards](Bastardy) of noble origin in the vicinity of [Blackwater Bay](Blackwater_Bay).

Rook's Rest.summary: Rook's Rest is the seat of [House Staunton](House_Staunton) in the [crownlands](Crownlands). It is located on the northern shore of [Blackwater Bay](Blackwater_Bay), west of [Crackclaw Point](Crackclaw_Point). The castle is northwest of [Driftmark](Driftmark), northeast of [Duskendale](Duskendale), and southeast of [Maidenpool](Maidenpool).

Sow's Horn.summary:
Sow's Horn is the seat of [House Hogg](House_Hogg) in the [crownlands](Crownlands). It consists of a [towerhouse](Towerhouse) made of stone whose walls are eight feet thick. It stands over land sworn to [House Hayford](House_Hayford). Sow's Horn sits near the border between the crownlands and the [riverlands](Riverlands) and is near the lands of [House Wode](House_Wode).

Sharp Point.summary: Sharp Point is the seat of [House Bar Emmon](House_Bar_Emmon) in the [crownlands](Crownlands). The [castle](Castle) is located along the [Gullet](Gullet) at the northern end of [Massey's Hook](Massey's_Hook), north of [Stonedance](Stonedance).

Stonedance.summary: Stonedance is the seat of [House Massey](House_Massey) in the [crownlands](Crownlands). It is located on the eastern shore of [Massey's Hook](Massey's_Hook) along the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea), south of [Sharp Point](Sharp_Point).

Dyre Den.summary:
The Dyre Den is the seat of [House Brune of the Dyre Den](House_Brune_of_the_Dyre_Den) in the [crownlands](Crownlands). It is located in [Crackclaw Point](Crackclaw_Point) along the southern shore of the [Bay of Crabs](Bay_of_Crabs).

Brownhollow.summary: Brownhollow is the seat of [House Brune of Brownhollow](House_Brune_of_Brownhollow) in [Crackclaw Point](Crackclaw_Point) within the [crownlands](Crownlands).

Celtigar Keep.summary: Claw Isle is the island seat of [House Celtigar](House_Celtigar) in the [crownlands](Crownlands). It lies a few hours sail north from [Dragonstone](Dragonstone). The people of [Crackclaw Point](Crackclaw_Point) refer to the island as Crab Isle.

Lannisport.summary:
Lannisport is a walled city in the [westerlands](Westerlands) located less than a mile south of [Casterly Rock](Casterly_Rock), the seat of [House Lannister](House_Lannister). Lannisport is located along the coast of the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea) where the [river road](River_road), the [gold road](Goldroad), and the [ocean road](Ocean_Road) meet. It is one of the major ports of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms) and is the largest settlement in the westerlands. Lannisport is smaller than [King's Landing](King's_Landing) or [Oldtown](Oldtown), but larger than [Gulltown](Gulltown) or [White Harbor](White_Harbor).

According to a semi-canon source Lannisport may be ruled by [House Lannister of Lannisport](House_Lannister_of_Lannisport), a branch of [House Lannister](House_Lannister) of nearby Casterly Rock. [Tywin Lannister](Tywin_Lannister), the Lord of Casterly Rock and [Warden of the West](Warden_of_the_West), includes "[Shield of Lannisport](Shield_of_Lannisport)" amongst his titles. Besides the Lannisters of Lannisport, other distant kin living in the city are [Lannys](House_Lanny), [Lannetts](House_Lannett), and [Lantells](House_Lantell), many of whom are yellow of hair.

Casterly Rock.summary:
Casterly Rock, also known as the Casterly Rock or simply the Rock, is a castle and the seat of [House Lannister](House_Lannister). The capital of the [westerlands](Westerlands), it is on the [ocean road](Ocean_Road) and overlooks the harbor of [Lannisport](Lannisport) and the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea). Nearby strongholds include [Kayce](Kayce) and [Feastfires](Feastfires) to the west, [Sarsfield](Sarsfield) to the north, and [Cornfield](Cornfield) and [Clegane's Keep](Clegane's_Keep) to the south.

The household of Casterly Rock includes Maester [Creylen](Creylen), [Vylarr](Vylarr), Ser [Benedict Broom](Benedict_Broom), and [Whitesmile Wat](Whitesmile_Wat).

Faircastle.summary: Faircastle is the seat of [House Farman](House_Farman) in the [westerlands](Westerlands). It is located on [Fair Isle](Fair_Isle), just off the western coast of [Westeros](Westeros).

Fair Isle.summary: Fair Isle is an island in the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea), separated from the rest of the [westerlands](Westerlands) by the [Straits of Fair Isle](Straits_of_Fair_Isle). The island is controlled by [House Farman](House_Farman), whose seat [Faircastle](Faircastle) sits on it. The [Crag](Crag) is northeast of Fair Isle, while a peninsula containing [Kayce](Kayce) and [Feastfires](Feastfires) is south of the island. Fair Isle has inland hills and a dockside district.

The Crag.summary: The Crag is the seat of [House Westerling](House_Westerling) in the [westerlands](Westerlands). It sits along the coast of the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea), south of [Banefort](Banefort), northwest of [Ashemark](Ashemark), and northeast of [Fair Isle](Fair_Isle).

Banefort.summary: Banefort is the seat of [House Banefort](House_Banefort) in the northwestern [westerlands](Westerlands). It is situated along the coast of the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea) north of the [Crag](Crag), near the [Iron Islands](Iron_Islands), and is only two days' sail from [Pyke](Pyke).

The Pendric Hills.summary: The Pendric Hills are the site of a [gold](Gold) mine in the [westerlands](Westerlands). Their exact location has not been published.

The Westerlands.summary:
The westerlands or westlands, historically the Kingdom of the Rock, are a region in the west of the continent of [Westeros](Westeros). Before [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest), it was ruled by the [Kings of the Rock](King_of_the_Rock). People from the westerlands are known as [westermen](Westermen). The customary surname of [bastards](Bastardy) of noble origin born in the westerlands is Hill.

The westerlands are ruled from [Casterly Rock](Casterly_Rock) by [House Lannister](House_Lannister). Notable bannermen have included [Banefort](House_Banefort), [Brax](House_Brax), [Broom](House_Broom), [Clegane](House_Clegane), [Crakehall](House_Crakehall), [Farman](House_Farman), [Lefford](House_Lefford), [Lydden](House_Lydden), [Marbrand](House_Marbrand), [Payne](House_Payne), [Prester](House_Prester), [Reyne](House_Reyne), [Serrett](House_Serrett), [Swyft](House_Swyft), [Tarbeck](House_Tarbeck), and [Westerling](House_Westerling).

Golden Tooth vaults by Jonny Klein © Fantasy Flight Games

Golden Tooth.summary: The Golden Tooth, also called the Tooth, is the seat of [House Lefford](House_Lefford) in the [westerlands](Westerlands). It is located along the [river road](River_road) and is east of [Ashemark](Ashemark) and [Sarsfield](Sarsfield), west of [Riverrun](Riverrun) and [Pinkmaiden](Pinkmaiden_Castle), and north of [Hornvale](Hornvale).

captions: Ashemark - by Alfred Khamidullin © Fantasy Flight Games
Ashemark.summary: Ashemark is the [castle](Castle) of [House Marbrand](House_Marbrand) in the [westerlands](Westerlands). Located in hilly terrain, the castle is situated southeast of the [Crag](Crag), northwest of the [Golden Tooth](Golden_Tooth), and north of [Sarsfield](Sarsfield).

Sarsfield.summary: Sarsfield is the seat of [House Sarsfield](House_Sarsfield) in the [westerlands](Westerlands). It is situated along the [River Road](River_road), northeast of [Casterly Rock](Casterly_Rock) and southwest of the [Golden Tooth](Golden_Tooth).

captions: The drowning of Lord Roger Reyne, by Fuderiki
Castamere.summary: Castamere is a ruined [castle](Castle) located south of the [Crag](Crag) and west of [Ashemark](Ashemark) in the northwestern [westerlands](Westerlands); also nearby is [Tarbeck Hall](Tarbeck_Hall). The former seat of [House Reyne](House_Reyne), Castamere contains [gold](Gold) and [silver](Silver) mines.

Tarbeck Hall.summary: Tarbeck Hall is a ruined [castle](Castle) in the [westerlands](Westerlands), located near [Castamere](Castamere) and the [Crag](Crag). It was the seat of [House Tarbeck](House_Tarbeck).

captions: A merchant from Kayce, by Gabriela Birchal © Fantasy Flight Games
Kayce.summary: Kayce is the seat of [House Kenning of Kayce](House_Kenning_of_Kayce) in the [westerlands](Westerlands). The castle and walled town are located along the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea) on a peninsula south of [Fair Isle](Fair_Isle) and west of [Casterly Rock](Casterly_Rock). [Feastfires](Feastfires) is located nearby to the southwest.
facts: by [Gundor Goodbrother](Gundor_Goodbrother) during the [Age of Heroes](Age_of_Heroes)

Feastfires.summary: Feastfires is the seat of [House Prester](House_Prester) in the [westerlands](Westerlands). It is located at the southwestern tip of a peninsula in the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea). The peninsula is west of [Lannisport](Lannisport) and south of [Fair Isle](Fair_Isle). Feastfires is southwest of nearby [Kayce](Kayce).

Crakehall.summary: Crakehall, or Crakehall Castle, is the seat of [House Crakehall](House_Crakehall) in the southwestern [westerlands](Westerlands). It is located on the [Searoad](Ocean_Road) along the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea), south of [Lannisport](Lannisport) and north of [Old Oak](Old_Oak). [Cornfield](Cornfield) and [Red Lake](Red_Lake) are east of Crakehall. There is a large forest in the vicinity of the [castle](Castle).

Clegane's Keep.summary: Clegane's Keep, also called Gregor's keep, is the semi-canonical name for the seat of [House Clegane](House_Clegane) in the [westerlands](Westerlands). It is located southeast of [Lannisport](Lannisport).

Silverhill.summary: Silverhill is the seat of [House Serrett](House_Serrett) in the [Westerlands](Westerlands). It is located in hilly and mountainous terrain south of [Deep Den](Deep_Den) and northeast of [Cornfield](Cornfield). A nearby river flows south past [Goldengrove](Goldengrove) to the [Mander](Mander).

captions: Hornvale by Franz Miklis © Fantasy Flight Games
Hornvale.summary:
Hornvale is the seat of [House Brax](House_Brax) in the eastern [westerlands](Westerlands). It is situated in hilly and mountainous terrain near the headwaters of the [Red Fork](Red_Fork), south of the [Golden Tooth](Golden_Tooth) and north of [Deep Den](Deep_Den) and the [Goldroad](Goldroad).

Hornvale by Franz Miklis © Fantasy Flight Games

captions: Deep Den, by Franz Miklis © Fantasy Flight Games
Deep Den.summary:
The Deep Den is the seat of [House Lydden](House_Lydden) in the eastern [westerlands](Westerlands). It is located in hilly and mountainous terrain east of [Lannisport](Lannisport), with [Hornvale](Hornvale) to the north and [Silverhill](Silverhill) to the south. The [Goldroad](Goldroad) passes nearby.

Deep Den, by Franz Miklis © Fantasy Flight Games

Cornfield.summary: Cornfield is the seat of [House Swyft](House_Swyft) in the [westerlands](Westerlands). The [castle](Castle) is located southeast of [Casterly Rock](Casterly_Rock), east of [Crakehall](Crakehall), and northwest of [Red Lake](Red_Lake). The head of House Swyft, a [landed knight](Landed_knight), is known as the [Knight of Cornfield](Knight_of_Cornfield).

The Ocean Road.summary: The Ocean Road, ocean road, or Searoad, is a road in southern [Westeros](Westeros) that connects the [westerlands](Westerlands) and the [Reach](Reach). Most of its course is along the coast of the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea).

The Gold Road.summary: The Goldroad or goldroad, also called the gold road, is a major road in southern [Westeros](Westeros).

The Reach.summary:
The Reach, historically the Kingdom of the Reach or the Green Realm, is one of the constituent regions of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms) on the continent of [Westeros](Westeros). It was formerly a sovereign nation ruled by the [Kings of the Reach](King_of_the_Reach) before [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest). It is the second-largest of the kingdoms behind the [north](North) and is considered the most fertile and heavily-populated part of Westeros.

The Reach is considered the home of [chivalry](Knight) in Westeros. It is the place where knighthood is looked upon with the greatest reverence and esteemed the most. It is also the place where the rules for [tourneys](Tourney) are the most stringent and managed.

The Reach is ruled from the castle of [Highgarden](Highgarden) by [House Tyrell](House_Tyrell). Notable houses have included [Ashford](House_Ashford), [Caswell](House_Caswell), [Crane](House_Crane), [Florent](House_Florent), [Fossoway](House_Fossoway), [Gardener](House_Gardener), [Hightower](House_Hightower), [Merryweather](House_Merryweather), [Mullendore](House_Mullendore), [Oakheart](House_Oakheart), [Redwyne](House_Redwyne), [Rowan](House_Rowan), [Tarly](House_Tarly), and [Vyrwel](House_Vyrwel). Noble [bastards](Bastardy) born in the Reach are given the surname Flowers.

The Stormlands.summary:
The stormlands, historically the Kingdom of the Storm, are one of the constituent regions of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms) on the continent of [Westeros](Westeros). The Kingdom of the Storm was a sovereign nation until [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest), in which the last [Storm King](Storm_King) was slain. The region is so-named for the savage and frequent [autumn](Seasons) storms that batter the coast after beginning in the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea).

The stormlands are ruled from the castle of [Storm's End](Storm's_End) by [House Baratheon](House_Baratheon). Notable bannermen of the region include [Buckler](House_Buckler), [Caron](House_Caron), [Connington](House_Connington), [Dondarrion](House_Dondarrion), [Errol](House_Errol), [Estermont](House_Estermont), [Penrose](House_Penrose), [Selmy](House_Selmy), [Staedmon](House_Staedmon), [Swann](House_Swann), [Tarth](House_Tarth), and [Wylde](House_Wylde). Noble [bastards](Bastardy) raised in the stormlands are given the surname Storm.

The Kingswood.summary: The kingswood is a large forest that lies across the [Blackwater Rush](Blackwater_Rush) from [King's Landing](King's_Landing). It is in the southern [crownlands](Crownlands) and the northern [stormlands](Stormlands) and is traversed by the [kingsroad](Kingsroad).

Storm's End.summary:
Storm's End is the seat of [House Baratheon](House_Baratheon), the [Lords Paramount of the Stormlands](Lord_Paramount_of_the_Stormlands). The castle is located at [Durran's Point](Durran's_Point) on the northern coast of [Shipbreaker Bay](Shipbreaker_Bay), south of [Bronzegate](Bronzegate) and northeast of [Griffin's Roost](Griffin's_Roost). The [kingsroad](Kingsroad) runs north from Storm's End through the [stormlands](Stormlands) to [King's Landing](King's_Landing), the capital of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms).

One of the strongest castles in the realm, Storm's End was once the ancestral seat of the [Storm Kings](Storm_King) of [House Durrandon](House_Durrandon) extending back many thousands of years. The castle is said to be protected by spells woven into its very walls that prevent [magic](Magic) from affecting it or passing through it.

The Wendwater.summary: The Wendwater is a river located in the southeastern [crownlands](Crownlands) and northeastern [stormlands](Stormlands), marking a border between the two regions within the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms). It is the largest river in the [kingswood](Kingswood).

The Blueburn.summary: The Blueburn is a river in the [Reach](Reach). It flows from the border with the [stormlands](Stormlands) in the east into the [Mander](Mander) at [Longtable](Longtable). [Grassy Vale](Grassy_Vale) sits along its shores.

The Mander.summary: The Mander is a river in the [Reach](Reach) which flows past [Highgarden](Highgarden), the seat of [House Tyrell](House_Tyrell). It is the longest and broadest river in the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms). The Tyrells include [Lord Paramount of the Mander](Lord_Paramount_of_the_Mander) among their titles.

The Roseroad.summary: The roseroad or Roseroad is a major road in southern [Westeros](Westeros) which begins near [King's Landing](King's_Landing) and extends southwest through the [Reach](Reach) to [Highgarden](Highgarden) and [Oldtown](Oldtown).

captions: Shield Islands dromon engages an ironborn vessel, by Ben Zweifel © Fantasy Flight Games
Shield Islands.summary: The Shield Islands, commonly called the Shields or Four Shields, are four islands of the [Reach](Reach). They are located in the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea) west of [Highgarden](Highgarden) and protect the [Mander](Mander) from the [Iron Islands](Iron_Islands). The ruling houses are [House Chester](House_Chester) of [Greenshield](Greenshield), [House Grimm](House_Grimm) of [Greyshield](Greyshield), [House Hewett](House_Hewett) of [Oakenshield](Oakenshield), and [House Serry](House_Serry) of [Southshield](Southshield).

Bitterbridge.summary: Bitterbridge, formerly known as Stonebridge, is the seat of [House Caswell](House_Caswell) in the [Reach](Reach).

Longtable.summary: Longtable is the seat of [House Merryweather](House_Merryweather) in the [Reach](Reach). It sits along the [Mander](Mander) near its confluence with the [Blueburn](Blueburn). It is located some thirty leagues to the southwest of [Bitterbridge](Bitterbridge).

Tumbleton.summary: Tumbleton is a market town in the [Reach](Reach) and is the seat of [House Footly](House_Footly). It is located sixty [leagues](League) southwest of [King's Landing](King's_Landing), near the Reach's northeastern border with the [crownlands](Crownlands). Tumbleton is found at the headwaters of the [Mander](Mander).

Goldengrove.summary: Goldengrove, or Castle Goldengrove, is the seat of [House Rowan](House_Rowan). It is east of [Red Lake](Red_Lake) in the northern part of the [Reach](Reach). Goldengrove is on a river which flows from the hills near [Silverhill](Silverhill) south to [Highgarden](Highgarden).

Old Oak.summary: Old Oak is the seat of [House Oakheart](House_Oakheart). It is located in the west of the [Reach](Reach) near the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea), along the [Ocean Road](Ocean_Road) which links [Highgarden](Highgarden) and [Lannisport](Lannisport). Old Oak's maester is [Omer](Omer_Florent).

Greenshield.summary: Greenshield is one of the [Shield Islands](Shield_Islands) in the [Reach](Reach). The northernmost of the four isles, it lies near the mouth of the river [Mander](Mander). It is the seat of [House Chester](House_Chester).

Haystack Hall.summary: Haystack Hall is the seat of [House Errol](House_Errol) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). It is located east of the [kingsroad](Kingsroad), northeast of [Bronzegate](Bronzegate), and south of the [kingswood](Kingswood).

Bronzegate.summary: Bronzegate is the seat of [House Buckler](House_Buckler) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). The castle is located on the [kingsroad](Kingsroad) between the [Wendwater](Wendwater) and [Storm's End](Storm's_End). [Felwood](Felwood) is to the west and [Haystack Hall](Haystack_Hall) is to the northeast.

Felwood.summary: Felwood is the seat of [House Fell](House_Fell) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). It is located northwest of [Storm's End](Storm's_End) at the southern edge of the [kingswood](Kingswood), south of the [Wendwater](Wendwater).

Wendwater Bridge.summary: The Battle of Wendwater Bridge was the decisive battle along the [Wendwater](Wendwater) during the [Fourth Blackfyre Rebellion](Fourth_Blackfyre_Rebellion).

Highgarden.summary: Highgarden is a castle which serves as the seat of [House Tyrell](House_Tyrell), the regional capital of the [Reach](Reach), and the heart of chivalry in the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms). It lies on the [Mander](Mander) where the [ocean road](Ocean_Road) meets the [roseroad](Roseroad), making it an important crossroads.

Oldtown.summary:
Oldtown is a city located on [Whispering Sound](Whispering_Sound) on the southwestern coast of the [Reach](Reach). It was constructed around the [Hightower](Hightower), the seat of [House Hightower](House_Hightower) on [Battle Isle](Battle_Island). The [Citadel](Citadel), home to [maesters](Maesters) and their [Conclave](Conclave), is located in Oldtown, and the city also contains the [Starry Sept](Starry_Sept), formerly the seat of the [High Septon](High_Septon) of the [Faith of the Seven](Faith_of_the_Seven).

Built by the [First Men](First_Men) before the [coming of the Andals](Coming_of_the_Andals), Oldtown is the largest and richest city in the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), although the capital, [King's Landing](King's_Landing), is now more populous. The demonym used for its inhabitants is "Oldtowner".

Arbor Knight, by Carlos Palma Cruchaga © Fantasy Flight Games
The Arbor.summary: The Arbor is a golden island off the southwestern-most part of [Westeros](Westeros), ruled by [House Redwyne](House_Redwyne). It is considered part of the [Reach](Reach), and is separated from the mainland by the [Redwyne Straits](Redwyne_Straits). It is protected by the [Redwyne fleet](Redwyne_fleet), the largest [fleet](Watercraft) of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms).

captions: The Redwyne Straits © FFG
The Redwyne Straits.summary: The Redwyne Straits is the body of water that lies between the [Arbor](Arbor) and the mainland [Reach](Reach). One must cross the straits to get from [Oldtown](Oldtown) to the Arbor. Towns such as [Vinetown](Vinetown), [Starfish Harbor](Starfish_Harbor) and [Ryamsport](Ryamsport) sit alongside it.

Whispering Sound.summary: Whispering Sound is a large bay that lies on the southwestern coast of the [Reach](Reach). West of the sound is the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea), and to the south are the [Redwyne Straits](Redwyne_Straits) and then the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea).

captions: The Honeywine, by Juan Carlos Barquet © Fantasy Flight Games
Honeywine.summary: The Honeywine is a large river in the [Reach](Reach). According to a semi-canon source, its valley is the agricultural capital of the Reach.

Starfall, by Eddie Mendoza for the A Song of Ice and Fire Calendar © Bantam Books
Starfall.summary: Starfall is the ancestral castle of [House Dayne](House_Dayne) in [Dorne](Dorne).

Sunhouse.summary: Sunhouse is the seat of [House Cuy](House_Cuy) in the [Reach](Reach). The [castle](Castle) is located on the southern coast of the Reach, east of the [Redwyne Straits](Redwyne_Straits) and southeast of [Oldtown](Oldtown). According to a semi-canon source, the town of [Cuy](Cuy) is located outside of Sunhouse's walls.

The Dornish Marches.summary: The Dornish Marches, or simply the Marches, are an area of southern [Westeros](Westeros) in the border region north of [Dorne](Dorne). The marches are predominantly in the southwestern [stormlands](Stormlands) and extend east to the [Sea of Dorne](Sea_of_Dorne), although much of the [western marches](Western_marches) are within the [Reach](Reach). People from the region are known as marchers, and they are ruled by [marcher lords](Marcher_lords).

The Red Mountains.summary: The Red Mountains or red mountains is a mountain range extending over much of southern [Westeros](Westeros). The range divides [Dorne](Dorne) in the south from the [stormlands](Stormlands) and the [Reach](Reach) to the north. The peaks can appear scarlet and crimson at sunset, though it is said by some that the Red Mountains are named after the blood which has been spilled in the contested terrain.

Dorne.summary:
Dorne is the large peninsula which makes up the southernmost part of [Westeros](Westeros), and is one of the constituent regions of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms). The lords of the ruling [House Nymeros Martell](House_Martell) style themselves "[Prince](Prince_of_Dorne)" and "Princess" in the [Rhoynish](Rhoynar) fashion.

The Martells rule from their capital, [Sunspear](Sunspear), outside of which sprawls the [shadow city](Shadow_city). Notable houses include [Allyrion](House_Allyrion), [Blackmont](House_Blackmont), [Dayne](House_Dayne), [Fowler](House_Fowler), [Jordayne](House_Jordayne), [Qorgyle](House_Qorgyle), [Santagar](House_Santagar), [Toland](House_Toland), [Uller](House_Uller), [Vaith](House_Vaith), [Wyl](House_Wyl), and [Yronwood](House_Yronwood).

Sunspear.summary: Sunspear, also known as the [Old Palace](Old_Palace), is the seat of [House Nymeros Martell](House_Martell) and the capital of [Dorne](Dorne). The castle is located on the [Broken Arm](Broken_Arm), north of the [Greenblood](Greenblood) on the far southeastern coast of [Westeros](Westeros) and is surrounded on three sides by the sea, and by the [shadow city](Shadow_city) on the fourth side. The palace of the [Water Gardens](Water_Gardens) lies three leagues away on the coastal road.

Planky Town.summary: The Planky Town is a trading town that lies at the mouth of the [Greenblood](Greenblood) in [Dorne](Dorne), near [Lemonwood](Lemonwood). The largest and most populous settlement in Dorne, the Planky Town has a harbor that sees trading vessels.

Yronwood.summary: Yronwood is the seat of [House Yronwood](House_Yronwood) in northern [Dorne](Dorne).

captions: Skyreach looming above the Prince's Pass
Skyreach.summary: Skyreach is the seat of [House Fowler](House_Fowler) in [Dorne](Dorne). It is located at the southern end of the [Prince's Pass](Prince's_Pass), south of [Kingsgrave](Kingsgrave) and near a river that flows east to [Yronwood](Yronwood).

Kingsgrave.summary: Kingsgrave is the seat of [House Manwoody](House_Manwoody) in [Dorne](Dorne). The castle is located in the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains) approximately halfway through the [Prince's Pass](Prince's_Pass), north of [Skyreach](Skyreach) and south of the [tower of joy](Tower_of_joy).

Blackmont.summary: Blackmont is the seat of [House Blackmont](House_Blackmont) in [Dorne](Dorne). It is near the confluence of two rivers which form the [Torentine](Torrentine), north of [High Hermitage](High_Hermitage) and [Starfall](Starfall) in the western [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains).

captions: Knights of House Qorgyle leading the charge - by Tomasz Jedruszek © Fantasy Flight Games
Sandstone.summary: Sandstone is the seat of [House Qorgyle](House_Qorgyle). It lies west of the [Hellholt](Hellholt) and the [Brimstone](Brimstone) in the western desert of [Dorne](Dorne).
