Hellholt Docks by Simon Dominic © Fantasy Flight Games
Hellholt.summary: Hellholt, also called the Hellholt, is the seat of [House Uller](House_Uller) in southern [Dorne](Dorne). The castle is located near the source of the river [Brimstone](Brimstone), east of [Sandstone](Sandstone) and west of [Vaith](Vaith).

Lemonwood.summary: Lemonwood is the seat of [House Dalt](House_Dalt) in [Dorne](Dorne). It lies just south of the mouth of the [Greenblood](Greenblood), near [Planky Town](Planky_Town).

Godsgrace.summary: Godsgrace is the seat of [House Allyrion](House_Allyrion) in [Dorne](Dorne). It is found on the northern shore of the [Greenblood](Greenblood), near the confluence of the [Vaith](Vaith_%28river%29) and the [Scourge](Scourge).

captions: Art by Cris Urdiales
Vaith.summary: Vaith is the seat of [House Vaith](House_Vaith) in [Dorne](Dorne).
houses: House Vaith of the Red Dunes

Salt Shore.summary: Salt Shore is the seat of [House Gargalen](House_Gargalen) in [Dorne](Dorne). It lies on the southern coast along the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea).

captions: Ghost Hill
Ghost Hill.summary: Ghost Hill is the seat of [House Toland](House_Toland) in [Dorne](Dorne). It lies on the southern shore of the [Sea of Dorne](Sea_of_Dorne), near the [Broken Arm](Broken_Arm).

The Tor.summary: The Tor is the seat of [House Jordayne](House_Jordayne) in [Dorne](Dorne). It is located on the southern shore of the [Sea of Dorne](Sea_of_Dorne), north of the [Scourge](Scourge).

Spottswood.summary: Spottswood is the seat of [House Santagar](House_Santagar) in [Dorne](Dorne). It appears to be in eastern Dorne, near the [Planky Town](Planky_Town), [Lemonwood](Lemonwood), [Stinkwater](Stinkwater), and the shadow city of [Sunspear](Sunspear).

Shandystone.summary: Shandystone is an abandoned [holdfast](Holdfast) in southeastern [Dorne](Dorne).

captions: Ghaston Grey by Ignacio Bazan Lazcano © Fantasy Flight Games
Ghaston Grey.summary: Ghaston Grey is a [Dornish](Dorne) prison located on a bleak island in the [Sea of Dorne](Sea_of_Dorne). It been used by [House Martell](House_Martell) as a prison for the vilest of criminals and [traitors](Treason), who are sent there to waste away.

captions: The Tower of Joy, by Henning Ludvigsen © FFG
Tower of Joy.summary: The tower of joy or Tower of Joy was a round tower in the northern edge of the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains) of [Dorne](Dorne). It was located at the north end of the [Prince's Pass](Prince's_Pass), with [Kingsgrave](Kingsgrave) to the south and [Nightsong](Nightsong) to the north.

Summerhall.summary:
Summerhall is a ruined castle in the [stormlands](Stormlands). Formerly a lightly fortified castle used by [House Targaryen](House_Targaryen) as a summer palace and royal residence, it was [destroyed](Tragedy_at_Summerhall) in a great fire in [259 AC](259_AC). While the heir apparent to the [Iron Throne](Iron_Throne) was known as the [Prince of Dragonstone](Prince_of_Dragonstone), a younger son could be titled the [Prince of Summerhall](Prince_of_Summerhall).

Located in or near the foothills of the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains), the ruins of Summerhall are close to the stormlands' border with the [Reach](Reach), east of the [Cockleswhent](Cockleswent) and southeast of the [Blueburn](Blueburn). The [Boneway](Boneway) runs south from Summerhall through the [Dornish Marches](Dornish_Marches) to [Yronwood](Yronwood) in [Dorne](Dorne).

Blackhaven.summary: Blackhaven is the seat of [House Dondarrion](House_Dondarrion) in the southwestern [stormlands](Stormlands). Part of the [Dornish Marches](Dornish_Marches), it is located in the northern [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains) near the [Dornish](Dorne) border, north of the [Wyl](Wyl_%28river%29) and south of the [Cockleswhent](Cockleswent).

captions: Ser Rolland Storm, the Bastard of Nightsong, by Igor Kieryluk © Fantasy Flight Games
Nightsong.summary: Nightsong is the seat of [House Caron](House_Caron) in the southwestern [stormlands](Stormlands). The formidable [castle](Castle) is located in the [Dornish Marches](Dornish_Marches), north of the [Prince's Pass](Prince's_Pass) and the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains).

The Scourge.summary:
The Scourge is a river in southern [Dorne](Dorne). It meets the [Vaith](Vaith_%28river%29) in the Dornish eastern mountains to form the [Greenblood](Greenblood) near [Godsgrace](Godsgrace).

The Greenblood.summary: The Greenblood is a river in southern [Dorne](Dorne). It takes its name from its murky green waters which are slow-moving and shallow.

The Vaith.summary: Vaith is the seat of [House Vaith](House_Vaith) in [Dorne](Dorne).
houses: House Vaith of the Red Dunes

The Brimstone.summary: The Brimstone is a river in southern [Dorne](Dorne) known for its sulfurous waters.

The Broken Arm.summary: The Broken Arm, also known as the Broken Arm of Dorne, is a region in eastern [Dorne](Dorne) where the Dornish peninsula juts into the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea). East of the jagged coastline are the islands of the [Stepstones](Stepstones).

The Sea of Dorne.summary: The Sea of Dorne or sea of Dorne is a large sea along the southeastern coast of [Westeros](Westeros). It is bordered to the north by [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath) in the [stormlands](Stormlands), to the west and south by [Dorne](Dorne), and to the east by the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea). The rivers [Wyl](Wyl_%28river%29) and [Slayne](Slayne) flow into the sea, which has deep blue waters. Another river whose name is unknown enters the Sea of Dorne near [Yronwood](Yronwood).

The Rainwood.summary: The rainwood is a large forest that lies on [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath) in the [stormlands](Stormlands).

Cape Wrath.summary: Cape Wrath, or the Cape of Wrath, is a large peninsula of the [stormlands](Stormlands) that juts out into the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea), bordered to the north by [Shipbreaker Bay](Shipbreaker_Bay), to the east by [Estermont](Estermont) in the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea), and to the south by the [Sea of Dorne](Sea_of_Dorne).

Estermont.summary: Estermont is an island in the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea) east of [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). [Greenstone](Greenstone), the seat of [House Estermont](House_Estermont), is located on the island.

Shipbreaker Bay.summary: Shipbreaker Bay is a large bay in the [stormlands](Stormlands) along the eastern coast of [Westeros](Westeros). Rocky and frequented by storms, it is named after the large number of ships that have been destroyed in its waters.

The Sunset Sea.summary: The Sunset Sea or sunset sea is a sea to the west of [Westeros](Westeros). It borders the [Reach](Reach), the [westerlands](Westerlands), the [Iron Islands](Iron_Islands), the [riverlands](Riverlands), the [north](North), and the lands [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall).

The Narrow Sea.summary:
The narrow sea is the sea between the continents of [Westeros](Westeros) to its west and [Essos](Essos) to its east. The sea is relatively narrow and easy to cross, but large enough to make large-scale invasions and military incursions between the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms) and the [Free Cities](Free_Cities) difficult. There is regular trade across the narrow sea between the two continents and the [Port of Ibben](Port_of_Ibben). Westerosi nobles are sometimes fostered or seek refuge in the cities across the water.

### Storms

The narrow sea can be rough in [autumn](Seasons), when [storms](Storm) are common. In [winter](Seasons), the storms are worse but less frequent. The [stormlands](Stormlands) are especially hit hard by storms which develop in the warmer waters of the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) to the south. It is suggested that a journey from the [Shield Islands](Shield_Islands) to the far side of the narrow sea is so hazardous in autumn that two-thirds of a fleet might be lost in the attempt. [Trading galleys](Watercraft) are sometimes better off crossing in the safety of the [Stepstones](Stepstones).

Cockleswhent.summary: The Cockleswent or Cockleswhent is a vassal stream of the river [Mander](Mander) in the [Reach](Reach). It meets the Mander at [Cider Hall](Cider_Hall). [Ashford](Ashford) lies along the tributary, while [Harvest Hall](Harvest_Hall) is located to its south.

Oakenshield (island).summary: Oakenshield is one of the [Shield Islands](Shield_Islands) in the [Reach](Reach). The easternmost of the four isles, it lies near the mouth of the river [Mander](Mander). [Lord Hewett's Town](Lord_Hewett's_Town), the seat of [House Hewett](House_Hewett), is found on the island.

Green Shield.summary: Greenshield is one of the [Shield Islands](Shield_Islands) in the [Reach](Reach). The northernmost of the four isles, it lies near the mouth of the river [Mander](Mander). It is the seat of [House Chester](House_Chester).

Grey Shield.summary: Greyshield is one of the [Shield Islands](Shield_Islands) in the [Reach](Reach). The westernmost of the four isles, it lies near the mouth of the river [Mander](Mander). It is the site of [Grimston](Grimston), the seat of [House Grimm](House_Grimm).

South Shield.summary: Southshield is an island of the [Shield Islands](Shield_Islands) in the [Reach](Reach). The southernmost of the four isles, it lies near the mouth of the river [Mander](Mander). It is the seat of [House Serry](House_Serry).

The Prince's Pass.summary: The Prince's Pass, historically called the Wide Way, is one of the principal overland routes from the [Reach](Reach) and the [stormlands](Stormlands) to [Dorne](Dorne). It is a gateway through the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains) of Dorne.

The Boneway.summary: The Boneway is a treacherous pass that runs through the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains), connecting [Dorne](Dorne) and the [stormlands](Stormlands). The name is a colloquial name, with the Stone Way being its official name.

Tarth.summary: Tarth, called the Sapphire Isle, is an island ruled by [House Tarth](House_Tarth) of [Evenfall Hall](Evenfall_Hall). Considered part of the [stormlands](Stormlands), Tarth is sworn to [Storm's End](Storm's_End).

Bloodstone.summary: Bloodstone is one of the islands that make up the [Stepstones](Stepstones). It is the largest of the islands, lying the furthest to the northwest and north of [Grey Gallows](Grey_Gallows).

River Road.summary: The river road or River Road is a major road which begins in [Casterly Rock](Casterly_Rock) and extends northeast through the [westerlands](Westerlands) past [Sarsfield](Sarsfield) and the [Golden Tooth](Golden_Tooth) to [Riverrun](Riverrun) in the [riverlands](Riverlands). It then runs east along the [Red Fork](Red_Fork) of the [Trident](Trident) to the [inn at the crossroads](Inn_at_the_crossroads), where it meets the [kingsroad](Kingsroad), which runs north and south, and the [high road](High_road), which runs east to the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn).

Braavos.summary: Braavos is the wealthiest and likely the most powerful of the [Free Cities](Free_Cities). It is located in the [Great Lagoon](Great_Lagoon) on the northwestern end of [Essos](Essos), where the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea) and the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea) meet. Braavos is also known as Braavos of the Hundred Isles and the Secret City, a name also attributed to the city [Nefer](Nefer), the last remaining city of [N'ghai](N'ghai). Braavos is sometimes referred to as the "bastard daughter of Valyria".

The Nine Free Cities:
Lorath.summary: Lorath is one of the Nine [Free Cities](Free_Cities). It is in a group of islands in the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea), near the northern coast of [Essos](Essos).

Lorath Bay.summary: Lorath Bay is a large bay off the northwestern coast of [Essos](Essos), with [Lorath](Lorath) nearby to the north.

The Hills of Norvos.summary:
The Hills of Norvos are a series of rolling limestone hills across northwestern [Essos](Essos), stretching from [Andalos](Andalos) to the [Axe](Axe).

The city of [Norvos](Norvos) is located among the hills. The headwaters of the [Noyne](Noyne) and the [Darkwash](Darkwash) lie in the Hills of Norvos. Northwest of the hills is [Lorath Bay](Lorath_Bay).

Norvos.summary: Norvos, called Great Norvos by its people, is one of the nine [Free Cities](Free_Cities). It lies in the interior of [Essos](Essos), between [Pentos](Pentos) and [Qohor](Qohor).

The Axe.summary: The Axe is a peninsula on the northern coast of [Essos](Essos) that juts into the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). It is located southeast of [Lorath](Lorath), east of the [Hills of Norvos](Hills_of_Norvos), north of the [Darkwash](Darkwash), and northwest of the [Forest of Qohor](Forest_of_Qohor).

Qohor.summary: Qohor, also known as the City of Sorcerers, is the easternmost of the nine [Free Cities](Free_Cities) located in western [Essos](Essos).

The Forest of Qohor.summary: The Forest of Qohor is a large area of woodland and forest containing the [Free City](Free_Cities) of [Qohor](Qohor) in [Essos](Essos). The dark, primordial forest is the greatest wood of the continent.

Old Andalos.summary: Andalos, also called the Hills of Andalos, is an area of northwestern [Essos](Essos) which was the homeland of the [Andals](Andals). Due to migration and invasion, however, little is left of the original Andal culture.

The Braavosian Coastlands.summary: The Braavosian Coastland, Braavosian Coastlands, or Braavosian Coastline is hilly and coastal land claimed by [Braavos](Braavos) on the northwestern coast of [Essos](Essos), opposite the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn) along the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea).

The Velvet Hills.summary: The Velvet Hills are a series of low hills in [Andalos](Andalos) in western [Essos](Essos). They lie to the east of [Pentos](Pentos). The headwaters of the [Little Rhoyne](Little_Rhoyne) are found among the hills. Along the [Valyrian road](Valyrian_roads) to [Ghoyan Drohe](Ghoyan_Drohe), which sits among the Velvet Hills, there is a deep lake, a circle of standing stones some claim was raised by [giants](Giants), and a female [Valyrian sphinx](Sphinx), the male having been taken away by the [Dothraki](Dothraki).

The Little Rhoyne.summary: The Little Rhoyne is a river in western [Essos](Essos). Its headwaters lie in the [Velvet Hills](Velvet_Hills), and it is one of the tributaries of the river [Rhoyne](Rhoyne). [Ghoyan Drohe](Ghoyan_Drohe) lies along its banks. The Little Rhoyne is smaller and slower than each of the three forks of the [Trident](Trident).

The Upper Rhoyne.summary: The Upper Rhoyne is a river in western [Essos](Essos) whose headwaters lie in the hills south of [Braavos](Braavos). Flowing southeast, it meets the [Little Rhoyne](Little_Rhoyne) east of [Ghoyan Drohe](Ghoyan_Drohe), forming the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne). The Upper Rhoyne is full of snags and sawyers.

Ghoyan Drohe.summary: Ghoyan Drohe is a ruined city in the [Velvet Hills](Velvet_Hills) of [Essos](Essos), north of the [Flatlands](Flatlands) and east of [Pentos](Pentos). It lies on the banks of the [Little Rhoyne](Little_Rhoyne), west of its confluence with the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne).

Nine Free Cities on the continent of Essos:
Pentos.summary: Pentos is one of the [Free Cities](Free_Cities) of western [Essos](Essos). It is a port located on the eastern coast of the [Bay of Pentos](Bay_of_Pentos).

Bay of Pentos.summary:
The Bay of Pentos is a bay of the eastern [narrow sea](Narrow_sea), along the western coast of [Essos](Essos). There is a narrow entrance to the bay, which contains a few islands. The [Free City](Free_Cities) of [Pentos](Pentos) is located on the eastern shore. [Drogo's manse](Drogo's_manse) sits by the Bay of Pentos, and [Illyrio's manse](Illyrio's_manse) also has a view of the bay.

There are fishing boats on the bay and larger ships along the shore. Pentos is limited to a fleet of twenty warships according to a peace treaty with [Braavos](Braavos).

The Flatlands.summary: The Flatlands is part of southern [Andalos](Andalos) in western [Essos](Essos).

Ny Sar.summary: Ny Sar is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) at the confluence of the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne) and the [Noyne](Noyne) rivers. It contained the [palace](Palace) of Princess [Nymeria](Nymeria) but was destroyed by the [Valyrian Freehold](Valyrian_Freehold).
facts: ~ [700 BC](<Years_before_Aegon's_Conquest.md#~Year 700 Before the Conquest>), following the [Second Spice War](Second_Spice_War).

Ar Noy.summary: Ar Noy is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) on the banks of the [Qhoyne](Qhoyne), near its confluence with the [Darkwash](Darkwash). To the northeast is [Qohor](Qohor) and to the southwest, [Dagger Lake](Dagger_Lake).

The Golden Fields.summary: The Golden Fields are an area in western [Essos](Essos) bordered to the west by the river [Lhorulu](Lhorulu) and to the east by [Dagger Lake](Dagger_Lake) and the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne).

Dagger Lake.summary:
Dagger Lake is a large lake formed by the confluence of the rivers [Rhoyne](Rhoyne) and [Qhoyne](Qhoyne) in western [Essos](Essos). At Dagger Lake the Qhoyne comes rushing in, full of gold and amber from the [Axe](Axe) and pine-cones from the [Forest of Qohor](Forest_of_Qohor). Northeast of Dagger Lake are the ruins of [Ar Noy](Ar_Noy), while along its western banks are the [Golden Fields](Golden_Fields).

Dagger Lake is full of islands where [pirates](Pirates) lurk in hidden caves and secret strongholds, such as [Urho the Unwashed](Urho_the_Unwashed) and [Korra the Cruel](Korra) on [Hag's Teeth](Hag's_Teeth).

The Darkwash.summary: The Darkwash or Darkwater is a river in [Essos](Essos) whose headwaters lie in the [Hills of Norvos](Hills_of_Norvos) south of the [Axe](Axe). It flows into the [Qhoyne](Qhoyne) near the ruins of [Ar Noy](Ar_Noy), and the rivers north of Ar Noy are ruled by the [Free City](Free_Cities) of [Qohor](Qohor). East of the Darkwash is the [Forest of Qohor](Forest_of_Qohor).

Morosh.summary: Morosh is a city in northern [Essos](Essos) along the shore of the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). A fishing and mining colony of [Lorath](Lorath), Morosh is situated at the northern end of the [Sarne](Sarne) river delta. It is northeast of its trading partner [Saath](Saath) and northwest of the ruined [Vaes Graddakh](Vaes_Graddakh). [Braavos](Braavos) allows fisherfolk from Morosh to fish the Shivering Sea.

Saath.summary: Saath is a city in northern [Essos](Essos) at the western end of the [Sarne](Sarne) delta along the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). It is west of [Vaes Graddakh](Vaes_Graddakh) and southwest of [Morosh](Morosh). Saath is connected by a [Valyrian road](Valyrian_roads) to [Vaes Khadokh](Vaes_Khadokh) farther to the south.

Vaes Graddakh.summary: Vaes Graddakh is a ruined city in northern [Essos](Essos) along the shore of the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). It is situated at the eastern end of the [Sarne](Sarne) delta, southeast of [Morosh](Morosh) and east of [Saath](Saath). It was originally called Sarys, but it is now known by its [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) name, Vaes Graddakh, meaning "City of Filth".

The cities of Sarnor
Sarnor, from the TV map based on Martin's original sketch, before the river was accidentally erased (city names added).
The Fallen Kingdom of Sarnor.summary:
The Kingdom of Sarnor is a region of northern [Essos](Essos) along the shores of the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). The [Forest of Qohor](Forest_of_Qohor) and [Vaes Khadokh](Vaes_Khadokh) are to the west, while the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea) extends along the south. [Omber](Kingdom_of_Omber) is a peninsula to the northeast of Sarnor, while the [Kingdom of the Ifequevron](Kingdom_of_the_Ifequevron) is farther to the east.

Most of the grassland kingdom was destroyed by the [Dothraki](Dothraki) in the [Century of Blood](Century_of_Blood) after the [Doom of Valyria](Doom_of_Valyria), with the cities [Gornath](Vaes_Leqse), [Kasath](Vojjor_Samvi), [Sallosh](Vaes_Athjikhari), Sarnath, [Sarys](Vaes_Graddakh), and [Sathar](Yalli_Qamayi) left in ruins. The only surviving Sarnori settlement is [Saath](Saath).

Most histories regarding the Kingdom of Sarnor come from the [Summer and Winter Annals](Summer_and_Winter_Annals) and records of them from [Qarth](Qarth), [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay), and the [Free Cities](Free_Cities). The fall of the kingdom to the [Dothraki](Dothraki) is chronicled in works such as [Bello](Bello)'s [The End of the Tall Men](The_End_of_the_Tall_Men), [Maester](Maesters) [Illister](Illister)'s [Horse Tribes, Being a Study of the Nomads of the Eastern Plains of Essos](Horse_Tribes,_Being_a_Study_of_the_Nomads_of_the_Eastern_Plains_of_Essos), the eastern chapters and appendices of Maester [Joseth](Joseth_%28maester%29)'s [Battles and Sieges of the Century of Blood](Battles_and_Sieges_of_the_Century_of_Blood), and [Vaggoro](Vaggoro)'s definitive [Ruined Cities, Stolen Gods](Ruined_Cities,_Stolen_Gods).

Vaes Khadokh.summary: Vaes Khadokh is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos), east of the [Forest of Qohor](Forest_of_Qohor), north of the [Painted Mountains](Painted_Mountains), and west of the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea). It is connected by [Valyrian roads](Valyrian_roads) to [Qohor](Qohor) to the west, [Saath](Saath) to the north, and [Vaes Khewo](Vaes_Khewo) to the east. There are hills to the north and the south. It was originally called Essaria, but it is now known by its [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) name, Vaes Khadokh, meaning City of Corpses.

Vaes Khewo.summary: Vaes Khewo is a ruined city on the [Sarne](Sarne) in the western [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea), in the southern [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor). It is connected by a [Valyrian road](Valyrian_roads) to [Vaes Khadokh](Vaes_Khadokh). It was originally called Sarnath of the Tall Towers, but it is now known by its [Dothraki](Dothraki_language) name, Vaes Khewo, meaning "City of Worms".

captions: The Titan of Braavos, by Paolo Puggioni ©
The Shivering Sea.summary: The Shivering Sea is a frigid sea north of [Essos](Essos). It is bounded to the west by northeastern [Westeros](Westeros), to the south by the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea) and northern Essos, to the north by a vast frozen wilderness called the [White Waste](White_Waste), and to the east by lands and seas unknown, perhaps the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea).

Bitterweed Bay.summary: Bitterweed Bay is a large bay of the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea) located along the northern shore of [Essos](Essos), east of the [Axe](Axe) and west of the delta of the [Sarne](Sarne). It is known for its deep blue waters, [crabs](Crab), and numerous sunken ships.

Sarne Delta.summary: The Sarne is a river in northern [Essos](Essos) located east of the [Forest of Qohor](Forest_of_Qohor) and north of the [Painted Mountains](Painted_Mountains).

Witch Isle.summary: The Witch Isle is one of the threescore islands off the eastern and northern coasts of the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). It is the seat of [House Upcliff](House_Upcliff) and has a sinister reputation.

captions: Lorassyon is one of the islands of Lorath.
Lorassyon.summary: Lorassyon is the second largest of the [Lorathi](Lorath) isles.

The Sea of Myrth.summary: The Sea of Myrth is a small sea situated along the western coast of [Essos](Essos). To the north lies the [Flatlands](Flatlands), the south the [Disputed Lands](Disputed_Lands), and to the west, the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea). [Myr](Myr) sits along the eastern shore of the Sea of Myrth.

Nine Free Cities:
Myr.summary:
Myr is one of the [Free Cities](Free_Cities) of western [Essos](Essos). It is on the east shore of the [Sea of Myrth](Sea_of_Myrth).

Nine Free Cities:  
[Pentos](Pentos), [Braavos](Braavos), [Lys](Lys), [Qohor](Qohor), [Norvos](Norvos), Myr, [Tyrosh](Tyrosh), [Volantis](Volantis), [Lorath](Lorath)

captions: A Tyroshi merchant - by Magali Villeneuve ©
Tyrosh.summary: Tyrosh is a harbor city and one of the [Free Cities](Free_Cities). It is on an island to the north of the [Stepstones](Stepstones), just off the coast of the [Disputed Lands](Disputed_Lands) of [Essos](Essos).
facts: [Fountain of the Drunken God](Fountain_of_the_Drunken_God), [Temple of Trios](Temple_of_Trios), [Bleeding Tower](Bleeding_Tower)

The Disputed Lands.summary: The Disputed Lands is a region of southwestern [Essos](Essos). It has long been contested between the [Free Cities](Free_Cities) of [Lys](Lys), [Myr](Myr), and [Tyrosh](Tyrosh), often involving skirmishes and small wars.

The Stepstones.summary: The Stepstones are a chain of islands between the southern [narrow sea](Narrow_sea) and the northwestern [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea). The islands are east of [Dorne](Dorne) in [Westeros](Westeros) and west of the [Disputed Lands](Disputed_Lands) in [Essos](Essos). The Stepstones are notoriously filled with [pirate](Pirates) dens.

Grey Gallows.summary: Grey Gallows is one of the islands that make up the [Stepstones](Stepstones), a series of islands bridging from [Essos](Essos) to [Westeros](Westeros). It lies to the south of [Bloodstone](Bloodstone).

Lys.summary: Lys, known as Lys the Lovely, is one of the nine [Free Cities](Free_Cities) of [Essos](Essos). It is a small city clinging to rocks surrounded by stormy seas. The city lies off the coast of the [Disputed Lands](Disputed_Lands), to the southeast of [Tyrosh](Tyrosh) and to the west of [Volantis](Volantis). [George R. R. Martin](George_R._R._Martin) usually uses "Lyseni" as a noun, both singular and plural, and "Lysene" as an adjective.
facts: More populous than [Astapor](Astapor), and may be one of the most populous of the Free Cities

captions: Dockside Brothel in Selhorys - by Yoann Boissonnet ©
Selhorys.summary: Selhorys is a walled [Volantene](Volantis) town located at the confluence of the [Selhoru](Selhoru) and the lower [Rhoyne](Rhoyne) in western [Essos](Essos). It lies north of [Valysar](Valysar), northwest of [Volantis](Volantis), and south of [Chroyane](Chroyane).

Valysar.summary: Valysar is a walled [Volantene](Volantis) town in [Essos](Essos). It sits on the western bank of the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne), to the north of [Volon Therys](Volon_Therys) and to the south of [Selhorys](Selhorys).

Sar Mell.summary: Sar Mell is a ruined city of the [Rhoynar](Rhoynar) that sits on the eastern bank of the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne) to the north of [Volantis](Volantis) in western [Essos](Essos). Almost directly across the river to the west sits the city of [Volon Therys](Volon_Therys).

Volon Therys.summary: Volon Therys is a walled [Volantene](Volantis) town in [Essos](Essos) on the west bank of the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne). Almost directly across the river to the east lies the ruined [Rhoynar](Rhoynar) city [Sar Mell](Sar_Mell). To the north is [Valysar](Valysar), the [Orange Shore](Orange_Shore) is to the west, and Volantis is to the south along the Rhoyne.

Volantis.summary: Volantis, often called Old Volantis and the First Daughter, is a city in southwestern [Essos](Essos). Located at the mouth of the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne) on the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea), it is the oldest and the proudest of the Nine [Free Cities](Free_Cities). Volantis is one of the greatest, richest, and most powerful of these city-states, and despite depopulation by ancient wars it is still the most populous.
facts: [Black Walls](Black_Walls), [Long Bridge](Long_Bridge), [Temple of the Lord of Light](Temple_of_the_Lord_of_Light), [Merchant's House](Merchant's_House)

captions: The Shy Maid passing through the Sorrows - by Marc Simonetti ©
The Sorrows.summary: The Sorrows is a stretch of the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne) from south of [Dagger Lake](Dagger_Lake) to beyond the ruins of [Chroyane](Chroyane). It is full of fog and inhabited by [stone men](Stone_men) afflicted with [greyscale](Greyscale).

captions: Flow of the Rhoyne in western Essos
The Rhoyne.summary: The Rhoyne is one of the main rivers of the eastern continent, [Essos](Essos).

captions: The Lhorulu. © Fantasy Flight Games
The Lhorulu.summary: The Lhorulu is a river in western [Essos](Essos). The [Rhoynar](Rhoynar) consider it a daughter of the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne) and nickname it the Smiling Daughter. Its headwaters begin south of the [Flatlands](Flatlands) and the river flows southeast into the Rhoyne. The [Sorrows](Sorrows) sit at the confluence of the Lhorulu and the Rhoyne. Between the Lhorulu and [Dagger Lake](Dagger_Lake) are the [Golden Fields](Golden_Fields).

The Orange Shore.summary: The Orange Shore is a strip of shoreline along the southern coast of [Essos](Essos), found to the west of [Volantis](Volantis). It is controlled by the Volantenes.

The Volaena.summary: The Volaena is a river in western [Essos](Essos). It is the final tributary of the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne) before it reaches the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea). It lies to the northeast of [Volantis](Volantis) and reaches the Rhoyne between Volantis and [Volon Therys](Volon_Therys).

The Demon Road.summary: The demon road is a [Valyrian road](Valyrian_roads) in the southern [Painted Mountains](Painted_Mountains). It runs from [Volantis](Volantis) east through [Mantarys](Mantarys) and the ruins of [Bhorash](Bhorash) to [Meereen](Meereen). It is commonly known as the demon road because it is a dangerous route.

Mantarys.summary: Mantarys is a city to the north of the [Lands of the Long Summer](Lands_of_the_Long_Summer) on the north tip of the [Sea of Sighs](Sea_of_Sighs), where a river flows south from the [Painted Mountains](Painted_Mountains). It is connected by [Valyrian roads](Valyrian_roads) to the ruined cities of [Bhorash](Bhorash) and [Oros](Oros). The [demon road](Demon_road) passes through Mantarys. It has a sinister repute and is allegedly a city of monsters.
facts: North of the [Lands of the Long Summer](Lands_of_the_Long_Summer)

The Painted Mountains.summary: The Painted Mountains are a long range of low, rounded mountains to the north of the [Valyrian peninsula](Valyrian_peninsula). The mountains are naturally banded in various hues of stones, thus leading to the name.

Tolos.summary: Tolos is a port city in central [Essos](Essos).

Elyria.summary: Elyria is an island city of central [Essos](Essos). It is located on a small island east of the [Valyrian peninsula](Valyrian_peninsula) in [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay). To the east lies [Tolos](Tolos) and to the west the [Lands of the Long Summer](Lands_of_the_Long_Summer). Elyria is less infamous than [Mantarys](Mantarys).

The Sea of Sighs.summary: The Sea of Sighs is an inland sea in central [Essos](Essos). It is south of the [Painted Mountains](Painted_Mountains) and north of the [Lands of the Long Summer](Lands_of_the_Long_Summer). At its northeastern tip is the city of [Mantarys](Mantarys), where a mountain river flows into the sea. Its waters are colored red.

The Lands of the Long Summer.summary: The Lands of the Long Summer is a region located in the southern part of central [Essos](Essos). To the northwest is the [Sea of Sighs](Sea_of_Sighs). Directly to the north lie the city [Mantarys](Mantarys) and the Valyrian [demon road](Demon_road). To the south is the [Smoking Sea](Smoking_Sea) and the ruined [Valyrian peninsula](Valyrian_peninsula). A [Valyrian road](Valyrian_roads) runs through the Lands of the Long Summer, running south from Mantarys to the ruined city of [Oros](Oros), from where it runs westward along the coast past another ruined city back to the demon road.

Oros.summary: Oros is a ruined city that sits on the northern coast of the [Smoking Sea](Smoking_Sea) in [Essos](Essos), said to be second only in majesty to the city of [Valyria](Valyria) before the [Doom](Doom_of_Valyria). It lies to the south of the [Lands of the Long Summer](Lands_of_the_Long_Summer) and is connected by [Valyrian road](Valyrian_roads) to [Mantarys](Mantarys), while across the Smoking Sea lies [Tyria](Tyria).

The Smoking Sea.summary: The Smoking Sea is the place where the sea flooded into the shattered remnant of the [Valyrian peninsula](Valyrian_peninsula) after the [Doom of Valyria](Doom_of_Valyria). The sea is filled with volcanoes and smoking stacks of rock. It is said to boil and smoke, and to be haunted by [demons](Demons).

Topless towers of Valyria, from Game of Thrones
Valyria.summary: Valyria, also called Old Valyria, is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos). It is a long-dead city of wonderment, and was once the capital of a great empire called the [Valyrian Freehold](Valyrian_Freehold). It was destroyed by a cataclysmic event known as the [Doom of Valyria](Doom_of_Valyria) a century before [Aegon's Landing](Aegon's_Landing). It is the ancestral home of [House Targaryen](House_Targaryen), [House Celtigar](House_Celtigar), and [House Velaryon](House_Velaryon).
facts: At least five thousand years ago.

Tyria.summary: Tyria is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos). It lies across the [Smoking Sea](Smoking_Sea) from [Oros](Oros) and is connected by [Valyrian road](Valyrian_roads) to the city of [Valyria](Valyria), which lies to the south of the island.

Ghozai.summary: Ghozai is a ruined [slaver](Slavery) port city on the [Isle of Cedars](Isle_of_Cedars). It lies on the northern coast of the island, facing [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay).

Velos.summary: Velos is a ruined city on the [Isle of Cedars](Isle_of_Cedars). It sits on the southern tip of the [Isle of Cedars](Isle_of_Cedars) facing the [Gulf of Grief](Gulf_of_Grief).

The Isle of Cedars.summary: The Isle of Cedars is a large island that sits astride both [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay) and the [Gulf of Grief](Gulf_of_Grief). It was once known as the Isle of a Hundred Battles. There is pale sand on the southern shore. The water is a shimmering turquoise close to shore, and farther out a blue so deep that it is almost black.

Bhorash.summary: Bhorash is a ruined city on the northern coast of [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay) in [Essos](Essos). It lies south of the [Painted Mountains](Painted_Mountains) and northeast of the [Black Cliffs](Black_Cliffs). Bhorash is connected by [Valyrian roads](Valyrian_roads) to [Mantarys](Mantarys) and [Tolos](Tolos). It is unknown if Bhorash was founded by the [Valyrian Freehold](Valyrian_Freehold).

Slaver's Bay.summary: Slaver's Bay is a cultural and geographical region of central [Essos](Essos). Built from the ashes of the [Old Empire of Ghis](Old_Empire_of_Ghis), Slaver's Bay became a wealthy hub of the global [slave](Slavery) trade. It flows into the [Gulf of Grief](Gulf_of_Grief).

The Gulf of Grief.summary:
The Gulf of Grief is a large gulf that is fed by [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay) off the southern coast of [Essos](Essos) and in turn empties into the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) to the south. The [Isle of Cedars](Isle_of_Cedars) is located between the gulf and the bay.

Along the Gulf of Grief's western shore are the [Lands of the Long Summer](Lands_of_the_Long_Summer), the [Smoking Sea](Smoking_Sea), and the remnants of the [Valyrian peninsula](Valyrian_peninsula). Along its eastern shore is [Ghiscar](Ghiscar) with the ruined city of [Old Ghis](Old_Ghis). The [Ghiscari Strait](Ghiscari_Strait) separates Ghiscar from [Ghaen](Ghaen) and the island city of [New Ghis](New_Ghis).

The Fallen Valyrian Freehold.summary:
The Valyrian Freehold was a great territory that spanned much of the continent of [Essos](Essos), but has since fallen to ruin. It was destroyed approximately one hundred years before [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest), when it was brought down by a cataclysmic event known as the [Doom of Valyria](Doom_of_Valyria).

At its prime, the Valyrian Freehold encompassed most of the eastern continent and reached as far as the current [Free Cities](Free_Cities) and the island of [Dragonstone](Dragonstone_%28island%29) off the coast of [Westeros](Westeros). The Freehold was technically never an empire, however for ease of reference it tends to be referred to as one.

The Freehold was an advanced civilization, and the dominant military and cultural power of the known world. Its capital was the city [Valyria](Valyria). The Freehold was ruled by the [lords freeholder](Lords_freeholder), powerful noble families. The most powerful of these were the [dragonlords](Dragonlord).

Sarhoy.summary: Sarhoy is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) at one of the four mouths of the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne). It was destroyed by the [Volantenes](Volantis) and the [Valyrian Freehold](Valyrian_Freehold).

Torturer's Deep.summary: Torturer's Deep is a place in the [Stepstones](Stepstones).

captions: Flow of the Rhoyne in western Essos
The Mouths of the Rhoyne.summary: The Rhoyne is one of the main rivers of the eastern continent, [Essos](Essos).

Stone Head.summary: Stone Head is a small island in the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles). It is the northernmost of the Summer Isles. To its south is the town, [Last Lament](Last_Lament) on [Walano](Walano).

Walano.summary: Walano is the northernmost of the major islands in the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles).

Lotus Port.summary: Lotus Point is a city in the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles). It is located in southwestern [Walano](Walano), north of the island [Koj](Koj).

Isle of Women.summary: The Isle of Women, also known by the more ancient name Abulu, is a small island in the [Summer Isles](Summer_Isles). It is located north-east of central [Walano](Walano) in the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea).

Koj.summary:
Koj is a small island in the [Summer Isles](Summer_Isles). Koj separates the [Smiling Sea](Smiling_Sea) to its southeast from the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) to its west. Southeast of Koj are the [Isle of Birds](Isle_of_Birds) and [Omboru](Omboru), while [Lotus Port](Lotus_Point) on [Walano](Walano) is to its north. To the south and southeast are the [Isle of Love](Isle_of_Love) and the [Singing Stones](Singing_Stones).

Despite not being one of the three large main islands in the chain, three-quarters of all [swan ships](Swan_ship) in the Summer Isles are made by the famed shipbuilders of Koj. [Malthar the Mapmaker](Malthar_Xaq), a prince of Koj, is regarded as having been the greatest shipbuilder from the isles. Adventurers from Koj are rumored to have explored much of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos) and the Sunset Sea. The Princes of Koj reside at the [Pearl Palace](Pearl_Palace).

Tall Trees Town.summary: Tall Trees Town is a town in the [Summer Isles](Summer_Isles), located on the southwest coast of the island [Walano](Walano).

Isle of Birds.summary: The Isle of Birds is an island in the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles). It is located in the center of The [Smiling Sea](Smiling_Sea) west of [Koj](Koj). [Tall Trees Town](Tall_Trees_Town) on [Walano](Walano) is north of it. [Omboru](Omboru) is to the south and east of the Isle of Birds.

The Smiling Sea.summary: The Smiling Sea is a body of water in the [Summer Isles](Summer_Isles). It separates the islands of [Walano](Walano), to the north, from [Omboru](Omboru), to the south and east. In its center is the [Isle of Birds](Isle_of_Birds), that is south of [Tall Trees Town](Tall_Trees_Town). The island of [Koj](Koj) separates it from the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) on the west.

Omboru.summary: Omboru is the central of the three largest islands of the [Summer Isles](Summer_Isles). To its north is the [Smiling Sea](Smiling_Sea) and the islands of [Koj](Koj). South of it is the [Indigo Straits](Indigo_Straits) and then [Jhala](Jhala). To the west in the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) are the island [Isle of Love](Isle_of_Love), and the groups of small islands known as [The Singing Stones](Singing_Stones) and [The Three Exiles](Three_Exiles).

Isle of Love.summary: The Isle of Love is an island in the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles). It is located in the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) west of [Jhala](Jhala). To its south lies the [Moluu](Moluu), and to its west a group of islands called the [Three Exiles](Three_Exiles).

The Indigo Straits.summary: The Indigo Straits is a body of water in the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles). It separates the islands of [Omboru](Omboru), to the north, from [Jhala](Jhala), to the south.

Jhala.summary: Jhala is the southernmost of the three largest of the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles), and the largest overall - two hundred leagues from tip to tip - though not the most populated. [Walano](Walano) and [Omboru](Omboru) are each less than half the size of Jhala, though either of them is still larger than all the landmass of the [Stepstones](Stepstones) combined and together the three of them are home to more than nine-tenths of the people of the isles. As with the other two large islands in the chain, Jhala is large enough to support multiple rival princedoms.

Red Flower Vale.summary: The Red Flower Vale is a settled river valley located in eastern [Jhala](Jhala) in the [Summer Isles](Summer_Isles).

Lizard Head.summary: Lizard Head is a group of small islands in the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles). They are located north of the peninsular on the Island [Jhala](Jhala), [Golden Head](Golden_Head), They are the easternmost islands in the Summer Islands.

Golden Head.summary: Golden Head is a peninsula in southeast [Jhala](Jhala). To the north are the group of small islands called [Lizard Head](Lizard_Head) to the west is [Parrot Bay](Parrot_Bay) South and east is the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea).

Naath.summary: Naath, known to the ancients as the Isle of Butterflies, is an island in the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) off the northwestern coast of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos). The natives of the island are known as [Naathi](Naathi).

A map showing the location of the Basilisk Isles and Naath in blue.
Basilisk Isles.summary: The Basilisk Isles, also known as the Basilisk Islands and the Basilisks, are a group of islands off the northwestern coast of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos), in the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea).

Isle of Toads.summary: The Isle of Toads is one of the [Basilisk Isles](Basilisk_Isles), located in the bay off the northwestern coast of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos), northeast of the [Isle of Tears](Isle_of_Tears) and west of the [Zamoyos](Zamoyos) delta. It is home to the [Toad Stone](Toad_Stone).

Isle of Tears.summary: The Isle of Tears is the largest of the [Basilisk Isles](Basilisk_Isles), which are located off the northwestern coast of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos). To the west of the isle is [Basilisk Point](Basilisk_Point), to the north is the island of [Talon](Talon_%28island%29), and to the northeast is the [Isle of Toads](Isle_of_Toads). Steep-sided valleys and black bogs hide amongst the rugged flint hills and twisted, windswept rocks of this southern island.

Gogossos.summary: Gogossos, once known as Gorgai, is a ruined city on the [Isle of Tears](Isle_of_Tears), the largest of the [Basilisk Isles](Basilisk_Isles). It lies on the southern coast of the island, facing the continent of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos).

Basilisk Point.summary: Basilisk Point is a peninsula on the northern coast of the continent of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos). The [Isle of Tears](Isle_of_Tears) lies to the east of the point, while [Naath](Naath) lies to the west. To the north are the [Basilisk Isles](Basilisk_Isles). There are large numbers of [basilisks](Basilisk) in the vicinity.

Isle of Flies.summary: The Isle of Flies is one of the [Basilisk Isles](Basilisk_Isles), located on the western end of the archipelago.

Sweet Lotus Vale.summary: Sweet Lotus Vale is a settled river valley located in southwestern [Jhala](Jhala). The city of [Ebonhead](Ebonhead) is located at its mouth.

Ebonhead.summary: Ebonhead is a city at the mouth of [Sweet Lotus Vale](Sweet_Lotus_Vale) on [Jhala](Jhala) in the [Summer Isles](Summer_Isles). To the east of Ebonhead is the island of [Xon](Xon) and [Parrot Bay](Parrot_Bay).

Xon.summary: Xon is an island in the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles). It is in [Parrot Bay](Parrot_Bay) south of [Jhala](Jhala). The city of [Ebonhead](Ebonhead) is west of Xon. The group of small islands called [The Bones](Bones) are east of it and the island [Doquu](Doquu) is to the south.

Doquu.summary: Doquu is the southernmost island of the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles). It is located in the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) south of [Xon](Xon) and [Jhala](Jhala).

The Bones.summary: The Bones are a group of small islands in the [Summer Isles](Summer_Isles). The three islets are at the southern end of [Parrot Bay](Parrot_Bay). They are south of [Jhala](Jhala), east of [Xon](Xon), and northeast of [Doquu](Doquu).

Parrot Bay.summary: Parrot Bay is a body of water south of the island of [Jhala](Jhala) in the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles). At its southern end are the island [Xon](Xon) and the group of small islands called [the Bones](Bones).

The Summer Isles.summary:
The World of Ice & Fire: The Untold History of Westeros and the Game of Thrones is a companion volume to [A Song of Ice and Fire](A_Song_of_Ice_and_Fire), provisionally known as a "world book".

The book was written by [George R. R. Martin](George_R._R._Martin) in collaboration with [Elio Garcia](User:Ran) and [Linda Antonsson](User:Linda). In the United States the book was published by Bantam, in the United Kingdom by Harper Voyager.

The World of Ice & Fire was released on October 28th, 2014.
facts: Random House Publishing Group, Harper Voyager

The Singing Stones.summary: The Singing Stones are a group of islands in the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles). They are in the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) west of [Omboru](Omboru) and north of [The Three Exiles](Three_Exiles).

The Three Exiles.summary: The Three Exiles is a group of three islands in the [Summer Islands](Summer_Isles). They are located in the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) west of [Moluu](Moluu) and the [Isle of Love](Isle_of_Love) and south of the group of islands called [The Singing Stones](Singing_Stones). The Three Exiles are the westernmost islands in the Summer Isles.

Moluu.summary: Moluu is one of the [Summer Isles](Summer_Isles). It is west of [Jhala](Jhala) in the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea). To the north is the [Isle of Love](Isle_of_Love). To the west is a group of islands called [The Three Exiles](Three_Exiles).

Port of Ibben.summary: The Port of Ibben is the main city on [Ib](Ib) and is the largest city of [Ibben](Ibben). It is located on the southern coast of Ib.

Ib.summary:
Ib is the largest island of the island nation of [Ibben](Ibben), and the second largest island in the [Known World](Known_world), with only [Great Moraq](Great_Moraq), located between the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea) and [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea), being larger.

Most [Ibbenese](Ibbenese) live on Ib and the smaller islands surrounding it.

Ib Nor.summary: Ib Nor is an [Ibbenese](Ibben) city on the north coast of [Ib](Ib).

The Bay of Whales.summary: The Bay of Whales is a bay off the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea) on the southwestern coast of [Ib](Ib). Several smaller islands of [Ibben](Ibben) are located in the bay.

Far Ib.summary: Far Ib or Far Ibben is an island settled by the [Ibbenese](Ibbenese). The islands lies north of the [Krazaaj Zasqa](Krazaaj_Zasqa) and more than a hundred leagues southeast of [Ib](Ib).

Ib Sar.summary: Ib Sar is the only [Ibbenese](Ibben) town on [Far Ib](Far_Ib). It was originally a place of exile and punishment where the [Ibbenese](Ibbenese) of old sent their most notorious criminals, often after mutilating them so they might never return to [Ib](Ib) itself. Even though this practice ended with the fall of the [God-Kings](God-King_of_Ib), Ib Sar retains an unsavory reputation.

New Ibbish.summary: New Ibbish is an [Ibbenese](Ibbenese) town on the mainland of [Essos](Essos), on a forested peninsula north of the [Kingdom of the Ifequevron](Kingdom_of_the_Ifequevron). The [Bay of Whales](Bay_of_Whales) is to the north of the colony, while to the southeast are the ruins of Ibbish, now known by its [Dothraki](Dothraki_language) name, [Vaes Aresak](Vaes_Aresak).

Vaes Aresak.summary: Vaes Aresak, once called Ibbish, is a ruined city in northern [Essos](Essos) along the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). It is located in the great forest south of [Ib](Ib) which includes the [Kingdom of the Ifequevron](Kingdom_of_the_Ifequevron) to the west. East of Vaes Aresak is the [Realm of Jhogwin](Realm_of_the_Jhogwin).

Vaes Leisi.summary: Vaes Leisi is a ruined settlement in the forests of northern [Essos](Essos). It is located in the western [Kingdom of the Ifequevron](Kingdom_of_the_Ifequevron) on a small peninsula jutting into the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). East of Vaes Leisi are [New Ibbish](New_Ibbish) and the ruins of [Vaes Aresak](Vaes_Aresak).

The Kingdoms of the Ifequevron.summary: The Kingdom of the Ifequevron is a forested region of northern [Essos](Essos) along the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). [Omber](Kingdom_of_Omber) and the [Bay of Tusks](Bay_of_Tusks) are to the west, while the [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor) is to the southwest. East of the forest are the [Realm of Jhogwin](Realm_of_the_Jhogwin) and the [Krazaaj Zasqa](Krazaaj_Zasqa). The [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea) and [Vaes Dothrak](Vaes_Dothrak) are to the south; a river from the [Womb of the World](Womb_of_the_World) by Vaes Dothrak runs through the kingdom to the Shivering Sea. East of the forest are the [Ibbenese](Ibben) city [New Ibbish](New_Ibbish) and the ruins of [Vaes Aresak](Vaes_Aresak) (Ibbish).

The Bay of Tusks.summary: The Bay of Tusks is a bay of the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea) north of [Essos](Essos). The bay is bounded by [Omber](Kingdom_of_Omber) to the west and a peninsula near the [Kingdom of the Ifequevron](Kingdom_of_the_Ifequevron) to the east. A river with tributaries near [Vaes Athjhikhari](Vaes_Athjikhari) and [Vaes Leqse](Vaes_Leqse) flows into the Bay of Tusks.

Omber.summary:
The Kingdom of Omber is a peninsular region of northern [Essos](Essos) jutting into the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea), with the [Bay of Tusks](Bay_of_Tusks) along its eastern coast. Omber is northeast of the [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor) and west of the [Kingdoms of the Ifequevron](Kingdom_of_the_Ifequevron).

The kings and princes of this small pastoral kingdom pay the [Dothraki](Dothraki) [horselords](Dothraki) a yearly tribute of grain, gems, and girls in order to be left unmolested.

Vaes Athjikhari.summary: Vaes Athjikhari is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) in the eastern [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor), with [Omber](Kingdom_of_Omber) to the northwest and the [Kingdom of the Ifequevron](Kingdom_of_the_Ifequevron) to the northeast. Vaes Athjikhari is to the northeast of [Vaes Leqse](Vaes_Leqse). The ruined city is situated on the northeastern shore of [a lake](Silver_Shore), with a river running north to the [Bay of Tusks](Bay_of_Tusks). It was originally called Sallosh or Sallosh by the Silver Shore, but it is now known by its [Dothraki](Dothraki_language) name, Vaes Athjhikhari, meaning "City of Sickness".

Vaes Leqse.summary: Vaes Leqse is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) in the eastern [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor), bordering the central [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea). It is north of [Yalli Qamayi](Yalli_Qamayi), northeast of [Vojjor Samvi](Vojjor_Samvi), and southeast of [Vaes Athjikhari](Vaes_Athjikhari). Vaes Leqse is situated on the northeastern shore of a small lake, with a river running north to the [Bay of Tusks](Bay_of_Tusks). It was originally called Gornath, or Gornath by the Lake, but it is now known by its [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) name, Vaes Leqse, meaning "City of Rats".

Vojjor Samui.summary: Vojjor Samvi or Vojjor Samui is a ruined city located in [Essos](Essos), in the southeastern [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor) near the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea). [Vaes Khewo](Vaes_Khewo) is to the west, [Yalli Qamayi](Yalli_Qamayi) is to the southeast, and [Vaes Leqse](Vaes_Leqse) is to the northeast. It was originally called Kasath and the Sarnori called it the City of Caravans, but it is now known by its [Dothraki](Dothraki_language) name, Vojjor Samvi, meaning "The Broken Gods".

captions: The attack on Sathar - by Paolo Puggioni ©
Yalli Qamayi.summary: Yalli Qamayi is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) in the southeastern [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor), bordering the central [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea). Located at the confluence of two branches of the [Sarne](Sarne), it is east of [Vojjor Samvi](Vojjor_Samvi) and south of [Vaes Leqse](Vaes_Leqse). It was originally called Sathar, but it is now known by its [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) name, Yalli Qamayi, meaning "Wailing Children".

The Womb of the World.summary: The Womb of the World is a large lake that lies just west of [Vaes Dothrak](Vaes_Dothrak) and the [Mother of Mountains](Mother_of_Mountains) within the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea) of central [Essos](Essos). It is a holy place to the [Dothraki](Dothraki) people.

captions: The Mother of Mountains in Game of Thrones
The Mother of Mountains.summary: The Mother of Mountains is a mountain that lies within sight of [Vaes Dothrak](Vaes_Dothrak) in the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea). The peak is found on the eastern shore of the [Womb of the World](Womb_of_the_World), and the [godsway](Godsway) runs from Vaes Dothrak to the mountain.

Vaes Dothrak.summary:
Vaes Dothrak is the only city of the [Dothraki](Dothraki) people. It is located in the northeast of the vast [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea), beneath the [Mother of Mountains](Mother_of_Mountains) and near a lake, the [Womb of the World](Womb_of_the_World). Vaes Dothrak has no walls.

The city is ruled and inhabited by [slaves](Slavery) and the [dosh khaleen](Dosh_khaleen), the wives of all the [khals](Khal) who have come before. It is forbidden to wear a blade or shed a free man's blood within the confines of the city. The name Vaes Dothrak means City of Riders in the [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language).

The Dothraki Sea.summary: The Dothraki sea, also known as Great Grass Sea, the Haunted Lands, and the Great Desolation, is a vast inland region of the continent of [Essos](Essos), located east of the [Free Cities](Free_Cities), north of [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay), and west of the [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains). Its landscape of steppes and plains is home to the nomadic [Dothraki](Dothraki) equestrian people, who constantly battle each other and raid surrounding lands.

Vaes Efe.summary: Vaes Efe is a ruined [Ghiscari](Ghiscari) city in [Essos](Essos) in the southeastern [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea). It is located south of [Vaes Dothrak](Vaes_Dothrak) and north of the [Skahazadhan](Skahazadhan). Southwest of Vaes Efe are [Vaes Mejhah](Vaes_Mejhah) and [Krazaaj Has](Krazaaj_Has). Its [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) name means City of Shackles.

Vaes Diaf.summary: Vaes Diaf is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) in the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea), south of the [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor) and north of [Meereen](Meereen). It was originally called Hazdahn Mo, but it is now known by its [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) name, Vaes Diaf, meaning City of the Skull.

The Realm of Jhogwin.summary:
The Realm of the Jhogwin or Realm of Jhogwin is a mountainous region of northern [Essos](Essos), situated within the northernmost part of the [Krazaaj Zasqa](Krazaaj_Zasqa). It is roughly northeast of [Vaes Dothrak](Vaes_Dothrak) and east of the [Kingdom of the Ifequevron](Kingdom_of_the_Ifequevron), with the island of [Far Ib](Far_Ib) to the north. To the southeast are the [Howling Hills](Howling_Hills).

Its name in the [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) refers to the [Jhogwin](Jhogwin), the stone [giants](Giants) in [Dothraki](Dothraki) legends. Bones of the ancient Jhogwin can be found in the mountains.

Krazaaj Zasqa.summary:
The Krazaaj Zasqa, meaning "White Mountains" in the [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language), is what the [Dothraki](Dothraki) call the northern [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains) in central [Essos](Essos). The snow-capped range stretches longitudinally from the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea) and transitions southward into the rest of the Bones at the [Steel Road](Steel_Road).

The northern section of the Krazaaj Zasqa contains the [Realm of Jhogwin](Realm_of_the_Jhogwin). West of the mountains are the forested [Kingdom of the Ifequevron](Kingdom_of_the_Ifequevron) and the ruined city of [Vaes Aresak](Vaes_Aresak), while north across the Shivering Sea is found the island of [Far Ib](Far_Ib). East of the Krazaaj Zasqa are the [Howling Hills](Howling_Hills) and [Leviathan Sound](Leviathan_Sound), while the city of [Kayakayanaya](Kayakayanaya) and the [Great Sand Sea](Great_Sand_Sea) are situated to the southeast along the Steel Road.

Kayakayanaya.summary: Kayakayanaya is a city in [Essos](Essos), located on the [Steel Road](Steel_Road) on the eastern side of the [Krazaaj Zasqa](Krazaaj_Zasqa), part of the [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains).

The Bone Mountains.summary: The Bone Mountains, commonly called the Bones, are a colossal mountain range in central [Essos](Essos). The tallest mountains in the [known world](Known_world), they are a natural land barrier between the western part of Essos known to [Westerosi](Westeros) and the exotic, mysterious [Further East](Further_East) of the continent.

The Howling Hills.summary: The Howling Hills is a hilly region in far eastern [Essos](Essos).

The Fallen Kingdom of Hyrkoon.summary:
The Patrimony of Hyrkoon was an ancient nation that flourished to the east of the [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains) in [Essos](Essos). It was ruled by the [Patriarchs of Hyrkoon](Patriarchs_of_Hyrkoon). They founded the fortress cities of [Kayakayanaya](Kayakayanaya), [Shamyriana](Shamyriana) and [Bayasabhad](Bayasabhad).

The Patrimony is presumably connected with "Hyrkoon the Hero", another name for the legendary figure most commonly known as [Azor Ahai](Azor_Ahai). Its leaders appear to claim descent from him.

The Khyzai Pass.summary: The Khyzai Pass is a mountain pass in the sandstone mountains that allows travelers to travel between [Meereen](Meereen) and [Lhazar](Lhazar). It is south of the [Skahazadhan](Skahazadhan).

Meereen.summary:
Meereen is the northernmost and the largest of the three great [Slaver Cities](Slaver_Cities) of [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay). It is ruled by the [Great Masters](Great_Masters), the heads of Meereen's slaving families. Meereen is a rival of [Astapor](Astapor) and [Yunkai](Yunkai), but the cities are not enemies.

Like the other Slaver Cities, Meereen's emblem is the [harpy](Harpies).

Yunkai.summary:
Yunkai, also called the Yellow City, is one of the [Slaver Cities](Slaver_Cities) on the eastern coast of [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay) in central [Essos](Essos). Ruled by the [Wise Masters](Wise_Masters), Yunkai's main export is bed slaves. It is said to be a disreputable place. Yunkai is also referred to as the queen of cities, a title also claimed by [Qarth](Qarth). Yunkai is a rival of [Astapor](Astapor) and [Meereen](Meereen), but the cities are not enemies.

The Yunkish emblem is a variation on the [harpy](Harpies) of [Old Ghis](Old_Ghis): a woman's torso, wings of a [bat](Bat) instead of arms, legs of an [eagle](Eagle), and a [scorpion](Scorpion)'s tail. Its talons grasp a [whip](<Armament.md#Other Weapons>) and an [iron](Iron) collar.

Astapor.summary:
Astapor, dubbed the Red City, is the southernmost of the [Slaver Cities](Slaver_Cities) on [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay). The city is renowned for their training of the [Unsullied](Unsullied), eunuch slave soldiers. Astapor is a rival of [Yunkai](Yunkai) and [Meereen](Meereen), but the cities are not enemies.

The Astapori emblem is a variation on the harpy of [Old Ghis](Old_Ghis): a woman's torso, a [bat](Bat)'s wings instead of arms, an [eagle](Eagle)'s legs, and a [scorpion](Scorpion)'s tail. In its talons hangs a chain with open manacles at either end.

Yaros.summary: Yaros is an island in the east of [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay). To the northeast is [Yunkai](Yunkai) and to the south [Astapor](Astapor), both on the mainland.

Hesh.summary: Hesh is a city located in the [Lhazar](Lhazar) region of [Essos](Essos). It is northwest of [Lhazosh](Lhazosh) and west of [Kosrak](Kosrak). A trade route from Hesh extends through the [Khyzai Pass](Khyzai_Pass) to [Meereen](Meereen).

Kosrak.summary: Kosrak is a city located in the [Lhazar](Lhazar) region of [Essos](Essos). It lies on a tributary of the [Skahazadhan](Skahazadhan) river, to the east of [Hesh](Hesh) and to the northeast of [Lhazosh](Lhazosh). A trade route from Kosrak extends southeast through the [red waste](Red_waste) to the ruined city of [Vaes Tolorro](Vaes_Tolorro), while another route heads northeast to [Adakhakileki](Adakhakileki).

Lhazosh.summary: Lhazosh is a city in the [Lhazar](Lhazar) region of [Essos](Essos). It is located southeast of [Hesh](Hesh) and southwest of [Kosrak](Kosrak). A trade route from Lhazosh extends southeast through the [red waste](Red_waste) to the ruined cities of [Vaes Orvik](Vaes_Orvik) and [Vaes Shirosi](Vaes_Shirosi).

Lhazar.summary:
Lhazar is an area of the semi-arid lands south of the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea). A region of pastures and hills, it is inhabited by the [Lhazareen](Lhazareen), a people of [sheepherders](Sheep), and in the southern parts by [Ghiscari](Ghiscari). There are three cities in Lhazar, [Hesh](Hesh), [Lhazosh](Lhazosh), and [Kosrak](Kosrak). The [Skahazadhan](Skahazadhan) passes through northern Lhazar.

Lhazar borders the Dothraki sea to the north and [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay) to the south. It is connected to [Meereen](Meereen) via the [Khyzai Pass](Khyzai_Pass) in the sandstone mountains.

captions: Meereen by Martina Pilcerova © Fantasy Flight Games
The Skahazadhan.summary: The Skahazadhan is a major river of central [Essos](Essos).

Krazaaj Has.summary: Krazaaj Has is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) between the southeastern [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea) and [Lhazar](Lhazar). It is located on a tributary of the eastern [Skahazadhan](Skahazadhan), west of [Vaes Mejhah](Vaes_Mejhah) and east of [Meereen](Meereen). It was originally called Ghardaq, but was ruined by the [Dothraki](Dothraki) after the [Doom of Valyria](Doom_of_Valyria). It is now known by its [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) name, Krazaaj Has, meaning "Sharp Mountains" after its [Ghiscari](Ghiscari) pyramids.

Vaes Mejhah.summary: Vaes Mejhah is a ruined [Ghiscari](Old_Empire_of_Ghis) city in [Essos](Essos) between the southeastern [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea) and [Lhazar](Lhazar). It is located on a tributary of the eastern [Skahazadhan](Skahazadhan), between [Vaes Efe](Vaes_Efe) and [Krazaaj Has](Krazaaj_Has). It was ruined after the [Doom of Valyria](Doom_of_Valyria), and its [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) name means City of Whores.

The Black Cliffs.summary: The Black Cliffs are a series of cliffs that are situated on the northwest coast of [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay), south of the [Painted Mountains](Painted_Mountains). They lie between [Tolos](Tolos) and the ruined city of [Bhorash](Bhorash), south of the [Demon Road](Demon_road).

The Poison Sea.summary: The Poison Sea is a large inland saltwater sea at the northeastern edges of the [red waste](Red_waste). The ruined city of [Adakhakileki](Adakhakileki) lies at the northern tip of the sea. Northeast of the Poison Sea is [Vaes Jini](Vaes_Jini) and the [Stone Road](Stone_Road). The eastern side of the sea abuts part of the [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains). Many leagues south of the Poison Sea lies [Qarth](Qarth). The [Dothraki](Dothraki) consider the sea poisonous because their [horses](Horse) cannot drink the saltwater.

Adakhakileki.summary: Adakhakileki is a ruined city that lies at the northern edges of the [red waste](Red_waste) in [Essos](Essos), on the northernmost shore of the [Poison Sea](Poison_Sea), not distant from the [Stone Road](Stone_Road). [Vaes Jini](Vaes_Jini) is northeast of the city. Adakhakileki is located in the foothills of the western [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains). Little is known of its inhabitants, although its [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) name means "The Cannibals".

Vaes Jini.summary:
Vaes Jini is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos), located on the [Stone Road](Stone_Road) in the foothills of the western [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains). It was originally called Yinishar and was inhabited by people related to those of [Samyriana](Shamyriana), but it is now known by its [Dothraki](Dothraki_language) name, Vaes Jini, meaning "City of Goats". It was once located along the [Silk Road](Silk_Road).

Southwest of Vaes Jini is the ruined city of [Adakhakileki](Adakhakileki) and south is the [Poison Sea](Poison_Sea). To the northwest is the edge of the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea).

Samyriana.summary: Shamyriana or Samyriana is a fortified city in [Essos](Essos), located on the [Stone Road](Stone_Road) in the eastern [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains), near the [Great Sand Sea](Great_Sand_Sea).

Bayasabhad.summary: Bayasabhad, also known as the City of Serpents, is a fortified city in [Essos](Essos), located on the [Sand Road](Sand_Road) in the eastern [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains), near the [Great Sand Sea](Great_Sand_Sea).

captions: The red waste in Game of Thrones
The Red Waste.summary: The red waste or Red Waste, also called the red lands, is a region of [Essos](Essos) west of the [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains). The desert is a barren and unforgiving landscape of stunted trees, [devilgrass](Devilgrass), and ancient ruins.

The Dry Bones.summary: The Dry Bones is a name sometimes applied to the southern [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains), in central [Essos](Essos). Located east of the [red waste](Red_waste) and west of the [Great Sand Sea](Great_Sand_Sea), they are so-named because water is sparse there. They do not seem to have the snowcapped mountains of the northern Bones, which are called the White Mountains ([Krazaaj Zasqa](Krazaaj_Zasqa)) due to their snow cover. The Dry Bones are scoured by sandstorms (apparently from the red waste), which carve the mountains into strange shapes.

captions: Vaes Tolorro, the city of bones, by Victor Garcia © Fantasy Flight Games
Jorah Mormont gifts Daenerys Targaryen with a peach, by Dorota Pijewska ©
Vaes Tolorro.summary:
Vaes Tolorro is the name given by [Daenerys Targaryen](Daenerys_Targaryen) and her followers to an abandoned city in the [red waste](Red_waste) beyond the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea). Vaes Tolorro means "the city of bones" in the [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language).

The original name of Vaes Tolorro is unknown. It is possible this was one of the city-states established by the [Qaathi](Qaathi).

Vaes Shirosi.summary: Vaes Shirosi is a ruined town located in [Essos](Essos), north of [Qarkash](Qarkash) and [Port Yhos](Port_Yhos), in the southwestern portion of the [red waste](Red_waste). The [Qaathi](Qaathi) town was destroyed by the [Dothraki](Dothraki) during the [Century of Blood](Century_of_Blood). Its [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) name means City of Scorpions.

Vaes Qosar.summary: Vaes Qosar is a ruined [Qaathi](Qaathi) city located in [Essos](Essos), east of [Qarkash](Qarkash) and northwest of [Qarth](Qarth), in the southeastern portion of the [red waste](Red_waste). It was originally called Qolahn, but it is now known by its [Dothraki language](Dothraki_language) name, Vaes Qosar, meaning City of Spiders, after its destruction by the [Dothraki](Dothraki) during the [Century of Blood](Century_of_Blood).

Vaes Orvik.summary: Vaes Orvik is a ruined city located in [Essos](Essos), north of [Port Yhos](Port_Yhos), in the southwestern portion of the [red waste](Red_waste).

Port Yhos.summary: Port Yhos is a town in [Essos](Essos) located southeast of [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay) on the shores of the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea). The westernmost settlement controlled by [Qarth](Qarth), it is south of [Vaes Orvik](Vaes_Orvik) and southwest of the [red waste](Red_waste). [Qarkash](Qarkash) is to the east of Port Yhos.

Qarkash.summary: Qarkash is a [Qartheen](Qarth) town in [Essos](Essos), located east of [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay) on the shores of the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea). It is south of the [red waste](Red_waste) and west of [Qarth](Qarth) and the ruins of [Qolahn](Vaes_Qosar). [Port Yhos](Port_Yhos) is to the west of Qarkash.

Queen Daenerys Targaryen returns to Xaro Xhoan Daxos's palace after her audience with the Pureborn - by Mustamirri ©
Qarth in Game of Thrones
The walls of Qarth, as depicted in HBO's Game of Thrones
Qarth.summary: Qarth is an ancient port city located on the southern coast of [Essos](Essos). It has been referred to as the Queen of Cities, a title also claimed by [Yunkai](Yunkai) in [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay).
facts: [House of the Undying](House_of_the_Undying), [Hall of a Thousand Thrones](Hall_of_a_Thousand_Thrones), [Temple of Memory](Temple_of_Memory), [triple wall](Walls_of_Qarth), [port](Port_of_Qarth)

Qal.summary: Qal is an island in the east of the [Jade Gates](Jade_Gates), south of the [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains) of [Essos](Essos). Qal is fortified on its northwestern and southeastern coasts with [Qartheen](Qarth) harbor cities.

Asabhad.summary: Asabhad is a city at the western boundary of [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti) in [Essos](Essos) along the shores of the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea), east of the [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains). It is located at a forested river mouth. Situated on a trade route connecting [Qarth](Qarth) and [Yin](Yin), Asabhad is where many caravans begin their journey to the [Mountains of the Morn](Mountains_of_the_Morn).

Ghiscar.summary: Ghiscar is a region of southern [Essos](Essos) located on the eastern coast of the [Gulf of Grief](Gulf_of_Grief). [Old Ghis](Old_Ghis) is found within this region. [Astapor](Astapor) and the [Worm River](Worm) are north of the Ghiscari hills. South of Ghiscar are the [Ghiscari Strait](Ghiscari_Strait) and some islands, including the large island [Ghaen](Ghaen) and a small island with the city of [New Ghis](New_Ghis).

captions: The Fall of Old Ghis by Marc Simonetti ©
Fall of Ghis
The Harpy holding a thunderbolt, the emblem of Old Ghis
Old Ghis.summary: Old Ghis is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos). It is located in southwestern [Ghiscar](Ghiscar), east across the [Gulf of Grief](Gulf_of_Grief) from the [Valyrian peninsula](Valyrian_peninsula). It was the capital city of the [Old Empire of Ghis](Old_Empire_of_Ghis). The ancient city was one of the oldest known [cultures](Ghiscari) and nations in the world. Its founding and golden age predate that of its successor, [Valyria](Valyria), by thousands of years.

Ghaen.summary: Ghaen is an island in the [Gulf of Grief](Gulf_of_Grief). It borders the [Ghiscari Strait](Ghiscari_Strait) and lies off the southern coast of [Essos](Essos) near [Ghiscar](Ghiscar). South of it are two smaller islands, including [New Ghis](New_Ghis).

captions: New Ghis, by Franz Miklis © Fantasy Flight Games
New Ghis.summary: New Ghis is an island city in the [Gulf of Grief](Gulf_of_Grief), which borders on the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea). Its island lies south of [Ghaen](Ghaen). [Ghiscar](Ghiscar) and the ruins of [Old Ghis](Old_Ghis) are located to the north, past the [Ghiscari Strait](Ghiscari_Strait). A city dependent on [slavery](Slavery), New Ghis is a much smaller port than [Volantis](Volantis).

The Ghiscari Strait.summary: The Ghiscari Strait is a strait between [Ghiscar](Ghiscar) in southern [Essos](Essos) and the island of [Ghaen](Ghaen). It flows from the [Gulf of Grief](Gulf_of_Grief) into the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea).

Skull Island.summary:
Skull Island, also known as Skull Isle, is the northernmost of the [Basilisk Isles](Basilisk_Isles). It is located in the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) north of [Zamettar](Zamettar) in [Sothoryos](Sothoryos). The small isle is windswept and uninhabited.

Many of corsairs of the Basilisks decorate the hulls and masts of their ships with severed heads. When the flesh has rotted off them, the corsairs replace the heads with fresh ones, while the bare skulls are delivered to Skull Isle as an offering to some dark god. The shores of the island are lined with skulls.

Ax Isle.summary: Ax Isle is the easternmost island of the [Basilisk Isles](Basilisk_Isles), which are off the northern coast of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos). To the north lies [New Ghis](New_Ghis), across the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea).

Zamettar.summary: Zamettar is a ruined city on the northern coast of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos). It lies on a large delta, the mouth of the [Zamoyos](Zamoyos). To the north lies the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) and [Ax Isle](Ax_Isle), to the west the bulk of the [Basilisk Isles](Basilisk_Isles), and to the south, deep in the jungle, [Yeen](Yeen) and, beyond, the [Green Hell](Green_Hell).

captions: Yeen, art by Nutchapol Thi ©
Yeen.summary: Yeen is a ruined city on the [Zamoyos](Zamoyos) in the continent of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos). To the north is [Zamettar](Zamettar) at the river delta. Enormous apes are said to live in the forests south of Yeen.

Gorosh.summary: Gorosh is a ruined city on the northern coast of [Wyvern Point](Wyvern_Point) in [Sothoryos](Sothoryos).

Wyvern Point.summary: Wyvern Point is a peninsula located in eastern [Sothoryos](Sothoryos). Named after the [wyverns](Wyvern) that hunt above its jungles and swamps, it contains the ruined penal colony [Gorosh](Gorosh). Northeast of Wyvern Point is [Lesser Moraq](Lesser_Moraq).

Lesser Moraq.summary: Lesser Moraq is a forested island in the eastern [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea), west of [Great Moraq](Great_Moraq) and [Vahar](Vahar) and northeast of the [Cinnamon Straits](Cinnamon_Straits). Lesser Moraq is located northeast of [Wyvern Point](Wyvern_Point) in [Sothoryos](Sothoryos).

Great Moraq.summary: Great Moraq, the largest island in the [known world](Known_world), is located between the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) to the west and the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea) to the east.

Faros.summary: Faros is a city at the mouth of a river on the northern stretch of [Great Moraq](Great_Moraq)'s western coast. The inhabitants of the city worship the [Stone Cow](Stone_Cow_of_Faros).

Port Moraq.summary: Port Moraq is a port city on the southern coast of [Great Moraq](Great_Moraq), near the [Cinnamon Straits](Cinnamon_Straits). The land north of the city is a dense rain forest. South of Port Moraq is the [Isle of Elephants](Isle_of_Elephants). Traders often stop at the port when returning from the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea).

Vahar.summary: Vahar is a city on an island of the same name in the eastern [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea). Vahar, located between [Great Moraq](Great_Moraq) to the east and [Lesser Moraq](Lesser_Moraq) to the west, has become wealthy from the spice trade.

The Cinnamon Straits.summary: The Cinnamon Straits separate [Great Moraq](Great_Moraq) from several islands to the south and west. Along with the [Jade Gates](Jade_Gates) north of Great Moraq, the Cinnamon Straits divide the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) and the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea). [Vahar](Vahar) and [Lesser Moraq](Lesser_Moraq) are to the northwest of the Straits, while the [Isle of Elephants](Isle_of_Elephants) is to the southeast. It is named after the cinnamon harvested from its isles.

The Isle of Whips.summary: The Isle of Whips is a small, isolated island in the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea), largely barren and named for its role as a way station for [slavers](Slavery). It is situated off the southern coast of [Essos](Essos), east of [Great Moraq](Great_Moraq) and northwest of [Marahai](Marahai). Northeast of the Isle of Whips is [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti) in Essos.

The Isle of Elephants.summary:
The Isle of Elephants is an island in the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea) south of [Great Moraq](Great_Moraq) and [Port Moraq](Port_Moraq) and southeast of the [Cinnamon Straits](Cinnamon_Straits). The city of [Zabhad](Zabhad) is located on its northern shore and is the only known settlement on the island. Northeast of the Isle of Elephants is [Marahai](Marahai).

According to records set down by [Corlys Velaryon](Corlys_Velaryon) in his letters, the Isle of Elephants is ruled by a [shan](Shan), who rules from a [palace](Palace) made of [ivory](Ivory). The island has numerous [elephants](Elephant).

Zabhad.summary: Zabhad is a city on the northern shore of the [Isle of Elephants](Isle_of_Elephants) in the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea). It is the chief port of the island and is part of the trader's circle in the sea.

Sailing the Summer Sea by Igor Artyomenko © Fantasy Flight Games
Summer Sea by Trevor Cook © Fantasy Flight Games
The Summer Sea is located between Westeros, Essos, and Sothoryos.
The Summer Sea.summary: The Summer Sea is a body of water located south of [Westeros](Westeros) and [Essos](Essos). The southern sea has deep blue waters and is warm from the sun.

The Worm.summary: The Worm or Worm River is a river in central [Essos](Essos). Its headwaters begin in the hills north of [Ghiscar](Ghiscar) and the city of [Astapor](Astapor) lies near the river's mouth, where it flows into [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay).

The Jade Gates.summary: The Jade Gates is a narrow strait which connects the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) and the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea), separating the great city of [Qarth](Qarth) on the southern coast of [Essos](Essos) from the island of [Great Moraq](Great_Moraq). The [Cinnamon Straits](Cinnamon_Straits) is a similar passageway south of Great Moraq. Located in the east of the strait is the small island of [Qal](Qal), which is fortified at each end with Qartheen harbor cities.
