Location of Sothoryos in the known world
The known lands of Sothoryos
Sothoryos.summary: Sothoryos or Sothoros is one of the three known continents of the [known world](Known_world). It lies to the southeast of [Westeros](Westeros) and is south of [Essos](Essos) across the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea). East of Sothoryos is the southern [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea).

The Green Hell.summary: The Green Hell is a region in [Sothoryos](Sothoryos) that lies beyond the forests south of the ruins of [Yeen](Yeen). It is said to be the home of beasts even more fearsome than those found in the northern area of the continent. There are reports of creatures such as pale white vampire bats that can drain the blood of a man in minutes, [tattooed lizards](Walking_lizard) that run down their prey and rip them apart with long curved claws on their hind legs, snakes fifty feet long, spotted spiders, and [wyverns](Wyvern).

Lake Zamoyos.summary: The Zamoyos is a river in [Sothoryos](Sothoryos) which flows into the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) at a large delta. It is known for its green waters, quicksands, and rotting, half-submerged trees. The river contains crocodiles, schools of carnivorous fish, and worms which lay eggs in swimmers.

Leviathan Sound.summary: Leviathan Sound is a large bay of the eastern [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea) off the coast of northern [Essos](Essos). It contains a few islands. The [Howling Hills](Howling_Hills) are to the southwest and the [Plains of the Jogos Nhai](Plains_of_the_Jogos_Nhai) are to the south. [Leviathans](Leviathan) mate and birth their young in Leviathan Sound.

captions: A woman of the Thousand Islands, by René Aigner ©
The Thousand Islands.summary: The Thousand Islands are an extensive archipelago in the eastern [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea) off the northern coast of [Essos](Essos). To the southwest are the [Plains of the Jogos Nhai](Plains_of_the_Jogos_Nhai), to the south are [Nefer](Nefer) and [N'Ghai](N'ghai), and to the southeast is [Mossovy](Mossovy).

captions: Jogos Nhai astride zorses on the plains - by Marc Simonetti ©
The Plains of the Jogos Nhai.summary: The plains of the Jogos Nhai are in [Essos](Essos), east of the [Great Sand Sea](Great_Sand_Sea) and the [Howling Hills](Howling_Hills), north of [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti) and the [Shrinking Sea](Shrinking_Sea), and west of [N'Ghai](N'ghai) and the [Bleeding Sea](Bleeding_Sea). To the north is [Leviathan Sound](Leviathan_Sound) and the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea).

Nefer.summary: Nefer, referred to by travelers as the Secret City, is the capital of [N'ghai](N'ghai), and the kingdom's last remaining city. Nefer enjoys a sinister reputation as a haunt of [necromancers](Necromancy) and torturers.

N'Ghai.summary: N'ghai is a small kingdom in the [Further East](Further_East) of [Essos](Essos).

Mossovy.summary: Mossovy, also known as Far Mossovy, is a broad, forested region of northeastern [Essos](Essos) along the shore of the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). It is at the edge of the [known world](Known_world), east of [N'Ghai](N'ghai) and north of the [Cannibal Sands](Cannibal_Sands) and the [Grey Waste](Grey_Waste). The [Thousand Islands](Thousand_Islands) are found north of the grim, grey forest.

Cannibal Sands.summary: The Cannibal Sands are a pair of small deserts bordering the [Grey Waste](Grey_Waste) in the [Further East](Further_East) of [Essos](Essos).

The Grey Waste.summary: The Grey Waste is a vast desert in the [Further East](Further_East) of [Essos](Essos).

The Great Sand Sea.summary:
The Great Sand Sea is a massive desert valley and canyon in [Essos](Essos), just east of the [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains) and southeast of the [Krazaaj Zasqa](Krazaaj_Zasqa). The [Steel Road](Steel_Road) skirts around the north of the Great Sand Sea, while farther to the north are the [Howling Hills](Howling_Hills). Some [maesters](Maesters) believe it to be an ancient inland sea, since dried, and become baking hot in the south and progressively colder to the north.

Cities between the Great Sand Sea and the Bone Mountains include [Kayakayanaya](Kayakayanaya) just to the northwest, [Samyriana](Shamyriana) in the central region, and [Bayasabhad](Bayasabhad) to the southwest. On the other side of the Great Sand Sea are [Tiqui](Tiqui) to the southeast and [Trader Town](Trader_Town) between its center and the [Shrinking Sea](Shrinking_Sea), on the opposite side as Samyriana. A number of these settlements were within the [Patrimony of Hyrkoon](Patrimony_of_Hyrkoon), an ancient nation that flourished east of the Bone Mountains and had its heartland in the once fertile Great Sand Sea.

The Shrinking Sea.summary: The Shrinking Sea is in eastern [Essos](Essos). It is east of the [Great Sand Sea](Great_Sand_Sea), north of [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti), and south of the [plains of the Jogos Nhai](Plains_of_the_Jogos_Nhai). [Trader Town](Trader_Town) is to the west of the Shrinking Sea. The landlocked Shrinking Sea has drained over time and now is only a few lakes.

Trader Town.summary:
Trader Town is a rude, sprawling garrison city of northern [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti) in eastern [Essos](Essos). The city lies east of the [Great Sand Sea](Great_Sand_Sea), and west of the [Shrinking Sea](Shrinking_Sea). The vast [plains of the Jogos Nhai](Plains_of_the_Jogos_Nhai) are north of Trader Town. From [Kayakayanaya](Kayakayanaya), the [Steel Road](Steel_Road) skirts the topmost northern edge of the Great Sand Sea, and turns south to Trader Town. The city is connected to [Tiqui](Tiqui) and [Bayasabhad](Bayasabhad) by the [Sand Road](Sand_Road).

Trader Town is the seat of General [Pol Qo](Pol_Qo), Hammer of the [Jogos Nhai](Jogos_Nhai), the self-proclaimed first [orange emperor](Orange_emperors).

Tiqui.summary: Tiqui is a city in [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti), located in the western hills of the region.

The Bleeding Sea.summary: The Bleeding Sea is a large inland sea in eastern [Essos](Essos). It is named for its blood-red waters, which are caused by a blooming plant.

The Five Forts.summary: The Five Forts are massive fortresses along the northeastern boundaries of the [Golden Empire of Yi Ti](Golden_Empire_of_Yi_Ti), situated between the [Bleeding Sea](Bleeding_Sea) and the [Mountains of the Morn](Mountains_of_the_Morn). Northeast of the Five Forts are the [Land of the Shrykes](Land_of_the_Shrykes), [K'Dath](K'Dath), [Bonetown](Bonetown), the [Grey Waste](Grey_Waste), and the [Cannibal Sands](Cannibal_Sands).

K'Dath.summary: K'Dath is a semi-legendary city supposedly located in a plain located in the [Further East](Further_East) of [Essos](Essos).

The Land of the Shrykes.summary:
The Land of the Shrykes is a plain in the [Further East](Further_East) of [Essos](Essos). It is bordered by the [Bleeding Sea](Bleeding_Sea) to the west, the [Five Forts](Five_Forts) and the [Mountains of the Morn](Mountains_of_the_Morn) to the south, [Bonetown](Bonetown) and the [Dry Deep](Dry_Deep) to the east, and [K'Dath](K'Dath) to the north.

The land is said to be a dangerous place populated by [shrieking monsters](Shrykes).

Bonetown.summary: Bonetown is a rumored town in the [Further East](Further_East) of [Essos](Essos).

The Dry Deep.summary: The Dry Deep is an "L"-shaped canyon in far eastern [Essos](Essos), south of the [Cannibal Sands](Cannibal_Sands) and the [Grey Waste](Grey_Waste). The Dry Deep broadly runs east to west, with the [Land of the Shrykes](Land_of_the_Shrykes) and [K'Dath](K'Dath) to the northwest. Just north of the Dry Deep is [Bonetown](Bonetown), where strange, aged bones from the valley are traded. At its western end, the canyon narrowly runs south along the eastern side of the [Mountains of the Morn](Mountains_of_the_Morn). Southeast of the Dry Deep are the [Cities of the Bloodless Men](Cities_of_the_Bloodless_Men). It is said the valley is entirely devoid of water and life.

The Cities of the Bloodless Men.summary: Cities of the Bloodless Men are said to exist in the [Further East](Further_East) of [Essos](Essos). Their inhabitants are said to be a race of bloodless men.

The Mountains of the Morn.summary: The Mountains of the Morn are a mountain range in the [Further East](Further_East) of [Essos](Essos).

The City of the Winged Men.summary: The City of the Winged Men is a legendary city in [far eastern](Further_East) [Essos](Essos).

The Hidden Sea.summary: The Hidden Sea is a legendary sea nestled in the southeastern stretches of the [Mountains of the Morn](Mountains_of_the_Morn) in far eastern [Essos](Essos). The [City of the Winged Men](City_of_the_Winged_Men) is located along the northwestern shore of the Hidden Sea, while [Carcosa](Carcosa) is situated at the southeastern corner. Southwest of the Hidden Sea are the [Shadow Lands](Shadow_Lands).

Carcosa.summary: Carcosa is a legendary city in far eastern [Essos](Essos). It is located on the southeastern shore of the [Hidden Sea](Hidden_Sea) within the [Mountains of the Morn](Mountains_of_the_Morn); the [City of the Winged Men](City_of_the_Winged_Men) is situated on the northwestern shore. The [sorceror lord](Sorcerer_lord) claiming to be the 69th [yellow](Yellow_emperors) [emperor](God-emperor) of [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti) lives in exile at Carcosa.

The Golden Empire of Yi Ti.summary: The Golden Empire of Yi Ti is a realm located in the [eponymous region](Yi_Ti) of the [Further East](Further_East) of [Essos](Essos). It is the supposed successor to the mythic [Great Empire of the Dawn](Great_Empire_of_the_Dawn), which, according to legend, fell during the [Long Night](Long_Night). It is ruled by a [God-Emperor](God-emperor), who is worshiped as divine, though in the present day the God-Emperor has little actual power beyond the limits of the capital city.

captions: Yin, capital of Yi Ti, by Henrik Zahringer
A YiTish man, by Douglas Wheatley for The World of Ice & Fire
The Jungles of Yi Ti.summary:
Yi Ti is a nation and region in [Essos](Essos), east of [Qarth](Qarth) and the [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains) and bordered by the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea) to the south. Nearby islands in the Jade Sea are [Leng](Leng) and the [Isle of Whips](Isle_of_Whips). North of Yi Ti are the [Great Sand Sea](Great_Sand_Sea), the [Shrinking Sea](Shrinking_Sea), and the [Bleeding Sea](Bleeding_Sea); a great river runs south from the Bleeding Sea through Yi Ti to the Jade Sea. East of Yi Ti are the [Mountains of the Morn](Mountains_of_the_Morn), the [Shadow Lands](Shadow_Lands), and the city of [Asshai](Asshai). In the [Common Tongue](Common_Tongue), things relating to Yi Ti are known as "YiTish".

The realm of the YiTish civilization is the [Golden Empire of Yi Ti](Golden_Empire_of_Yi_Ti), which was, according to legend, preceded by the [Great Empire of the Dawn](Great_Empire_of_the_Dawn). Maester [Yandel](Yandel) speculates that the YiTish civilization was contemporary with the [realm](Fisher_Queens) of the [Fisher Queens](Fisher_Queens), whereas the YiTish priests insist that mankind's first towns and cities arose along the shores of the Jade Sea, dismissing the rival claims of the [Sarnori](Tall_Men) and [Ghiscari](Ghiscari) as the boasts of savages and children.

captions: Yin, artwork by Henrik Zahringer.
Yin.summary:
Yin is the great port city of [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti) on the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea). It is connected by a trade route to [Asabhad](Asabhad) to the northwest. A river from the forests of Yi Ti leads south to Yin.

The dynasties of the [grey](Grey_emperors), [indigo](Indigo_emperors), and [pearl-white emperors](Pearl-white_emperors) ruled the [Golden Empire of Yi Ti](Golden_Empire_of_Yi_Ti) from their seats at Yin, and, in the present, the [azure emperors](Azure_emperors) have done the same.

Si Qo.summary: Si Qo, known as Si Qo the Glorious, was a city of the [Golden Empire](Golden_Empire_of_Yi_Ti) of [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti), located in the heart of Yi Ti's jungle. Though now long fallen and overgrown, Si Qo was the capital of the Empire during the rule of the [scarlet emperors](Scarlet_emperors), who raised it to be their capital.

Jinqi.summary:
Jinqi is a city in [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti) in southern [Essos](Essos). It is located near a delta along the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea), north of [Leng](Leng). The nearby river flows from the [Bleeding Sea](Bleeding_Sea) to the north.

The dynasty of the [maroon emperors](Maroon_emperors) kept their martial court at this city, to better guard the eastern frontiers of the [empire](Golden_Empire_of_Yi_Ti) against reavers from the [Shadow Lands](Shadow_Lands).

Leng.summary: Leng is a large island in the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea), off the southern coast of [Essos](Essos). To the north is the city of [Jinqi](Jinqi) in [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti). East of Leng are the [Shadow Lands](Shadow_Lands), while to the south are the [Manticore Isles](Manticore_Isles). The island of [Marahai](Marahai) is to the southwest. Leng is ruled by [god-empresses](Empress_of_Leng).

Leng Yi.summary: Leng Yi is a city on the island [Leng](Leng) in the eastern [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea). It is located on the northern shore of the forested island, southwest of [Jinqi](Jinqi) in [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti).

Leng Ma.summary:
Leng Ma is a city on the island [Leng](Leng) in the eastern [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea). It is located on the western shore of the forested island, near the mouth of a river.

Leng Ma and [Leng Yi](Leng_Yi) are reminiscent of [YiTish](Yi_Ti) cities like [Yin](Yin) and [Jinqi](Jinqi).

Turrani.summary: Turrani is a city on the island [Leng](Leng) in the eastern [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea). It is located on the southern shore of the forested island, near the mouth of a river and north of the [Manticore Isles](Manticore_Isles). Unlike [Leng Yi](Leng_Yi) and [Leng Ma](Leng_Ma) in the north, which were founded by men of [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti), Turrani was founded by the original inhabitants of the island, the [Lengii](Lengii). It is a wealthy city rich in [spices](Spices) and [gems](Gemstone).

Marahai.summary:
Marahai is a crescent-shaped island in the central [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea), off the southern coast of [Essos](Essos). West of Marahai are [Great Moraq](Great_Moraq), the [Isle of Whips](Isle_of_Whips), and the [Isle of Elephants](Isle_of_Elephants). Additionally, [Leng](Leng) and the [Manticore Isles](Manticore_Isles) are east of Marahai. The city of [Yin](Yin) in [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti) is to the north across the Jade Sea.

Marahai is called a paradise isle. Within its curvature are two small volcanic isles which often emit smoke and flame.

The Manticore Isles.summary: The Manticore Isles are a group of seven small islands in the eastern [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea), off the southern coast of [Essos](Essos). The islands of [Leng](Leng) and [Marahai](Marahai) are to the north and west, respectively. East of the Manticore Isles are [Asshai](Asshai) and the [Shadow Lands](Shadow_Lands). The islands are named after the [manticores](Manticore) that are said to be populous there.

The Jade Sea.summary: The Jade Sea is a large body of water in the [Further East](Further_East) of the [known world](Known_world), beyond the [Jade Gates](Jade_Gates), which separate it from the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea).

Ulos.summary: Ulos is a mountainous isle in the [Saffron Straits](Saffron_Straits) between the [Shadow Lands](Shadow_Lands) and [Ulthos](Ulthos). An unnamed ruined city lies in the northern part of the isle. It is the easternmost island in the [known world](Known_world).

Asshai-by-the-Shadow.summary: Asshai is a mysterious port city in the far southeast of the known part of [Essos](Essos), where the [Ash river](Ash_%28river%29) meets the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea) at its eastern exit, the [Saffron Straits](Saffron_Straits). Asshai is on the southernmost edge of a mountainous peninsula known as the [Shadow Lands](Shadow_Lands), thus the city is often called Asshai by the Shadow or Asshai-by-the-Shadow. To go to Asshai can be described as to "pass beneath the shadow", and the area of the Shadow Lands and Asshai are sometimes referred to simply as the Shadow.

Stygai.summary: Stygai, also known as the City of the Night, is a ruined city in the mountainous [Shadow Lands](Shadow_Lands) of eastern [Essos](Essos).

The Shadow Lands.summary: The Shadow Lands, also called the Shadow, is a mountainous area in the [far east](Further_East) of [Essos](Essos).

The Saffron Straits.summary:
The Saffron Straits are the eastern exit of the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea), dividing [Essos](Essos) and [Ulthos](Ulthos). The city of [Asshai](Asshai) is on the north side of its western entrance. North of the straits are the [Shadow Lands](Shadow_Lands), and Ulthos is to the south. The Saffron Straits widen to the east, and in them is the island of [Ulos](Ulos); then they run off east outside the [known world](Known_world).

According to a semi-canon source, the straits are named after the [saffron](Saffron_%28spice%29) carried over the water by traders.

captions: Location of Ulthos in the known world
Ulthos.summary: Ulthos is a landmass in the far east of the [known world](Known_world).

The Vale of Shadows.summary: The Vale of Shadows is a river valley in the [Shadow Lands](Shadow_Lands) northeast of [Asshai](Asshai). The valley is a narrow cleft in the mountains through which the river [Ash](Ash_%28river%29) passes on its way from the [Mountains of the Morn](Mountains_of_the_Morn) to the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea). The mountain cliffs are so high and steep that it is said no light falls within the valley except at noon. [Demons](Demons) and [dragons](Dragon) and worse things are said to live in caves in the cliffs. At the heart of the valley is the ruined city of [Stygai](Stygai).

The Straits of Leng.summary: Leng is a large island in the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea), off the southern coast of [Essos](Essos). To the north is the city of [Jinqi](Jinqi) in [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti). East of Leng are the [Shadow Lands](Shadow_Lands), while to the south are the [Manticore Isles](Manticore_Isles). The island of [Marahai](Marahai) is to the southwest. Leng is ruled by [god-empresses](Empress_of_Leng).

King's Landing.summary:
King's Landing is the capital of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), located in the [crownlands](Crownlands) on the east coast of [Westeros](Westeros). It is situated along the [kingsroad](Kingsroad) at the mouth of the [Blackwater Rush](Blackwater_Rush) and overlooks [Blackwater Bay](Blackwater_Bay). King's Landing is the site of the [Iron Throne](Iron_Throne) and the [Red Keep](Red_Keep), which is the seat of the king, [Robert I](Robert_I_Baratheon) from [House Baratheon of King's Landing](House_Baratheon_of_King's_Landing).

The main city is surrounded by a wall, manned by the [City Watch of King's Landing](City_Watch_of_King's_Landing), also known as the gold cloaks. King's Landing is the most populous city in Westeros, but unsightly and dirty compared to other cities. Poorer [smallfolk](Smallfolk) build shanty settlements outside the city. The stench of the city's waste can be smelled far beyond its walls.

King's Landing's [harbor](Harbor_of_King's_Landing), the principal port of the Seven Kingdoms, is rivaled only by [Oldtown](Oldtown), which is larger in area but less populous. Nearby towns include [Rosby](Rosby) and [Duskendale](Duskendale) to the northeast and [Tumbleton](Tumbleton) to the southwest, while the [kingswood](Kingswood) is found south of the capital across the Blackwater. [Driftmark](Driftmark) and [Dragonstone](Dragonstone_%28island%29) in the [Gullet](Gullet) protect the bay from the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea).

The demonym used for its inhabitants is "Kingslander".

Winterfell.summary: Winterfell is the ancestral castle and seat of power of [House Stark](House_Stark) and is considered to be the capital of the [north](North). It is in the center of the northernmost province of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), on the [kingsroad](Kingsroad) that runs from [Storm's End](Storm's_End) to the [Wall](Wall). The castle is situated at the eastern edge of the [wolfswood](Wolfswood), north of the western branch of the [White Knife](White_Knife) and [Castle Cerwyn](Castle_Cerwyn). Winterfell is south of the [northern mountains](Northern_mountains) and southwest of [Long Lake](Long_Lake), one hundred leagues (three hundred miles) southeast of [Deepwood Motte](Deepwood_Motte).

Ice River Clans.summary: The ice-river clans or ice river clans are clans of [free folk](Free_folk) who live near the great ice rivers [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall), north of the [Frozen Shore](Frozen_Shore) and south of the [Lands of Always Winter](Land_of_Always_Winter). They are said to feast on [human flesh](Cannibalism).

Cave-dwellers.summary: Cave dwellers or cave-dwellers are clans of [free folk](Free_folk) that live in the caverns of the [Frostfangs](Frostfangs), surrounding [Thenn](Thenn_%28valley%29).

captions: A member of the Nightrunners
Nightrunner Tribes.summary: The Nightrunners are a clan of [free folk](Free_folk) who live [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall).

Hornfoot Tribes.summary: The Hornfoots are a clan of [free folk](Free_folk) who live [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall) near the [Frostfangs](Frostfangs).

Forktop.summary: Forktop is one of the largest mountains in the [Frostfangs](Frostfangs). It is called Forktop due to its twin peaks.

captions: The Antler River, by Cris Urdiales ©
The Antler.summary: The Antler River is a river found [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall). It is formed by at least two branches whose sources are in the northeast of the [haunted forest](Haunted_forest). It flows southeast into the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea).

Storrord's Point.summary: Storrold's Point is a peninsula [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall) on the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea). At its tip is [Hardhome](Hardhome), a ruined [free folk](Free_folk) settlement. [Crab](Crab) gods are worshiped by some tribes who live along Storrold's Point.

Kingshouse.summary: Kingshouse is the seat of [House Magnar](House_Magnar) on the island [Skagos](Skagos) in the [north](North).

Goldgrass.summary: Goldgrass is the seat of [House Stout](House_Stout) in the [north](North).

captions: Artos Stark and the head of Raymun Redbeard
The Long Lake.summary: Long Lake is a large lake in the [north](North).

Broken Branch.summary:
The Broken Branch is a river in the southeastern lands of the [north](North). The headwaters of the Broken Branch lie in the [Sheepshead Hills](Sheepshead_Hills), while [Ramsgate](Ramsgate) sits at its mouth, near where the [Bite](Bite) meets the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea) and the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea).

According to a semi-canon source, the Broken Branch is within the dominion of [House Manderly](House_Manderly). There is ice fishing on the northern rivers.

Fevre River.summary: The Fever River is a river in the southern regions of the [north](North).

captions: Breakwater Castle
Breakwater.summary: Breakwater, also called Breakwater Castle, is a castle which defends the town of [Sisterton](Sisterton) in the [Three Sisters](Three_Sisters), which are ruled by the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). The castle is the residence of [House Borrell](House_Borrell), Lords of [Sweetsister](Sweetsister) and [Masters of Breakwater Castle](Master_of_Breakwater_Castle).

Pebble.summary: Pebble is an island in the [Bite](Bite) north of the [Fingers](Fingers). It is the seat of [House Pryor](House_Pryor), sworn to the [Eyrie](Eyrie).

captions: Sealskin Point is located at the northern coast of Great Wyk, northwest of Old Wyk.
Sealskin Point.summary: Sealskin Point is the seat of [House Farwynd of Sealskin Point](House_Farwynd_of_Sealskin_Point) on [Great Wyk](Great_Wyk).

Volmark.summary: Volmark is the seat of [House Volmark](House_Volmark) on [Harlaw](Harlaw) in the [Iron Islands](Iron_Islands).

Straits of Fair Isle.summary: The Straits of Fair Isle lie between the island of [Fair Isle](Fair_Isle) and the mainland [westerlands](Westerlands).

Nunn's Deep.summary: Nunn's Deep is the site of a [gold](Gold) mine in the [westerlands](Westerlands). Its exact location has not been published.

Oxcross.summary: Oxcross is a village not three days ride from [Lannisport](Lannisport) in the [westerlands](Westerlands). It is located near the pass beneath the [Golden Tooth](Golden_Tooth), at a fording of the [Oxcross](Oxcross_%28river%29).

Red Lake.summary: Red Lake is the seat of [House Crane](House_Crane) in the [Reach](Reach). The castle is located on the northeastern shore of a lake of the same name in the northwest of the Reach, near the region's border with the [westerlands](Westerlands). Red Lake is northwest of [Goldengrove](Goldengrove), northeast of [Old Oak](Old_Oak), and southeast of [Cornfield](Cornfield).

captions: Coldmoat, by Mike S. Miller
Coldmoat.summary: Coldmoat, also called Coldmoat Castle, is a castle of [House Webber](House_Webber) and [House Osgrey](House_Osgrey) in the north-west of the [Reach](Reach). It is located a few leagues west of [Standfast](Standfast), with the [west way](West_way) running between the two.

Horseshoe Hills.summary: The Horseshoe Hills are a series of hills in the northwestern [Reach](Reach). They are part of [House Webber](House_Webber)'s holdings. They once belonged to [House Osgrey](House_Osgrey), after Ser [Eustace Osgrey](Eustace_Osgrey) married Lady [Rohanne Webber](Rohanne_Webber) they may or may not belong to House Osgrey once again. They are coveted by [Lord Stackhouse](Lord_Stackhouse).

Brandybottom.summary: Brandybottom is a village in the [Reach](Reach) near [Coldmoat](Coldmoat) and [Standfast](Standfast). It was once under the dominion of [House Osgrey](House_Osgrey), but the power of the house diminished and the control of Brandybottom fell to others.

Dosk.summary: Dosk is a trading village near [Standfast](Standfast) in the [Reach](Reach). It once fell under the dominion of [House Osgrey](House_Osgrey), but the power of the house diminished over the years and the incomes of the village were given to someone else.

Little Dosk.summary: Little Dosk was a village in the [Reach](Reach). During the reign of King [Aerys I Targaryen](Aerys_I_Targaryen), it was raided by [ironmen](Ironborn) and half of the village was destroyed. It was once controlled by [House Osgrey](House_Osgrey), but the power of the house diminished over the years, and the village eventually came under the power of someone else.

Cobble Cove.summary: Cobble Cove is a place in the [Reach](Reach). It was once the extent of [House Osgrey](House_Osgrey) lands.

captions: Oakenshield port by Folko Streese © Fantasy Flight Games
Hewett's Town.summary: Lord Hewett's Town is a large town on the island of [Oakenshield](Oakenshield) in the [Reach](Reach). It is the seat of [House Hewett](House_Hewett).

Leafy Lake.summary: Leafy Lake is a lake in the [Reach](Reach). It lies within the lands of [House Webber](House_Webber). The mouth of the [Chequy Water](Chequy_Water) flows into it.

captions: Egg and Maester cross the Chequy Water by Gary Gianni
Chequy Water.summary: The Chequy Water is a stream that runs between the lands of [House Osgrey](House_Osgrey) and [House Webber](House_Webber) in the north-western [Reach](Reach). It rises in the [Horseshoe Hills](Horseshoe_Hills) and ends in [Leafy Lake](Leafy_Lake). Its underbrush has thorny vines, nettles, and tangles of briarwhite and young willow. The [west way](West_way) crosses the stream.

Grimston.summary: Grimston is a castle on the island of [Greyshield](Greyshield) in [the Reach](Reach) and is the seat of [House Grimm](House_Grimm).

Hag's Mire.summary: Hag's Mire is a village in the northern [riverlands](Riverlands) and the seat of [House Nayland](House_Nayland). If one intends to go around the [Blue Fork](Blue_Fork), one must pass through [Sevenstreams](Sevenstreams) and Hag's Mire, which is considered full of bogs and bad roads. Hag's Mire is full of green pools and soft ground.

Jenny of Oldstones by Rae Lavergne ©
Oldstones.summary: Oldstones is the name given by [smallfolk](Smallfolk) to a ruined [castle](Castle) in the northern [riverlands](Riverlands). Once the seat of [House Mudd](House_Mudd), its original name has long been lost.

Sevenstreams.summary: Sevenstreams is a village in the northern [riverlands](Riverlands) under the jurisdiction of [House Frey](House_Frey). If one intends to go around the [Blue Fork](Blue_Fork), one must pass through Sevenstreams and [Hag's Mire](Hag's_Mire), which is considered full of bogs and bad roads. The Blue Fork dissolves into smaller waterways such as rills and brooks beyond Sevenstreams. [Tom Sevenstrings](Tom_of_Sevenstreams) and Ser [Pate of the Blue Fork](Pate_of_the_Blue_Fork) are cousins from the village.

Ramsford.summary: Ramsford is a village on the [Blue Fork](Blue_Fork) of the [Trident](Trident).

Wendish Town.summary: Wendish Town is a town with in the [riverlands](Riverlands). The location of Wendish Town has not yet been revealed by [George R. R. Martin](George_R._R._Martin). The town may be under the dominion of [House Darry](House_Darry) as Ser [Raymun Darry](Raymun_Darry) reports on its status to the [Iron Throne](Iron_Throne). The television adaptations [Game of Thrones](Game_of_Thrones) and [House of the Dragon](House_of_the_Dragon) place Wendish Town north of [Raventree Hall](Raventree_Hall) and south of the source of the [Blue Fork](Blue_Fork).

Mudgrave.summary: Mudgrave is a market town held by [House Blackwood](House_Blackwood) in the [riverlands](Riverlands).

Pennytree.summary: Pennytree is a large village in the [riverlands](Riverlands), located north of the [Red Fork](Red_Fork) in the disputed border area between [Stone Hedge](Stone_Hedge) and [Raventree Hall](Raventree_Hall). The surrounding lands have frequently changed hands in the ongoing conflict between [House Bracken](House_Bracken) and [House Blackwood](House_Blackwood).

Lem brings duck for dinner, by mustamirri ©
Inn of the Kneeling Man.summary: The Inn of the Kneeling Man is an inn in the [riverlands](Riverlands) located near the spot where [Torrhen Stark](Torrhen_Stark), [King in the North](King_in_the_North), is said to have bent the knee to [Aegon I Targaryen](Aegon_I_Targaryen) during [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest).

Sallydance.summary: Sallydance is a small village on the [Red Fork](Red_Fork) in the [riverlands](Riverlands). Its [sept](Sept) has windows of leaded glass.

Nutten.summary: Nutten is a settlement near the [crossroads inn](Inn_at_the_crossroads) in the [riverlands](Riverlands). [Jon O' Nutten](Jon_o'_Nutten) comes from the town.

Riverbend.summary: Riverbend is a village near the [crossroads inn](Inn_at_the_crossroads) in the [riverlands](Riverlands).

Harroway.summary: Lord Harroway's Town, called Harroway town or Harroway for short, is a town in the [riverlands](Riverlands) that sits along the [Trident](Trident), upriver of the [ruby ford](Ruby_ford). It is the seat of [House Roote](House_Roote) but is named after extinct [House Harroway](House_Harroway).

Crossing the ruby ford © Fantasy Flight Games
Ruby Ford.summary: The ruby ford or Ruby Ford is a crossing of the [Trident](Trident) in the eastern [riverlands](Riverlands). It is so named for the [rubies](Ruby) that were knocked from Prince [Rhaegar Targaryen](Rhaegar_Targaryen)'s breastplate during the [Battle of the Trident](Battle_of_the_Trident). The [inn at the crossroads](Inn_at_the_crossroads) lies near the ford. There is no crossing of the [Green Fork](Green_Fork) north of it until the [Twins](Twins).

Lambswold.summary: Lambswold is a village in the [riverlands](Riverlands). It lies near the [Inn of the Kneeling Man](Inn_of_the_Kneeling_Man).

Willow Wood.summary: Willow Wood is the seat of [House Ryger](House_Ryger) in the [riverlands](Riverlands).

Stone Mill.summary: Stone Mill, also called the Stone Mill, is a crossing of the [Red Fork](Red_Fork) of the [Trident](Trident) in the western [riverlands](Riverlands). The location of Stone Mill has not yet been published on maps, although it may be north of [Pinkmaiden Castle](Pinkmaiden_Castle).

Lychester.summary: Lord Lychester's keep is the seat of [House Lychester](House_Lychester) in the [riverlands](Riverlands). It is three days travel from the [hidden village](Hidden_village) of the [Lady of the Leaves](Lady_of_the_Leaves), and four days travel from [Sallydance](Sallydance).

Atranta.summary: Atranta is the seat of [House Vance of Atranta](House_Vance_of_Atranta). It is situated in the [riverlands](Riverlands).

Sherrer.summary: Sherrer is a village in the [riverlands](Riverlands), downriver from [Mummer's Ford](Mummer's_Ford) on the [Red Fork](Red_Fork). The village may be under the dominion of [House Vance of Wayfarer's Rest](House_Vance_of_Wayfarer's_Rest), as Ser [Karyl Vance](Karyl_Vance) reports on its status to the [Iron Throne](Iron_Throne).

captions: The brotherhood without banners atop High Heart
High Heart.summary: High Heart is a tall hill sacred to the [children of the forest](Children_of_the_forest) in the [riverlands](Riverlands). Around its crown stands a ring of thirty-one [weirwood](Weirwood) stumps. The hill is considered a safe place due to its relative height compared to the flat surrounding land, making it nearly impossible to be approached unseen.

captions: Arya Stark and Ravella Smallwood at Acorn Hall, by Amuelia ©
A view of Acorn Hall
Acorn Hall.summary: Acorn Hall is the seat of [House Smallwood](House_Smallwood) in the [riverlands](Riverlands). It is located southeast of [Riverrun](Riverrun), northeast of [Pinkmaiden](Pinkmaiden_Castle), and north of [Stoney Sept](Stoney_Sept). [High Heart](High_Heart) and [Blackbottom Bend](Blackbottom_Bend) are nearby.

Wayfarer's Rest.summary: Wayfarer's Rest is the seat of [House Vance of Wayfarer's Rest](House_Vance_of_Wayfarer's_Rest) in the [riverlands](Riverlands), probably located in the western part of the region near the [Red Fork](Red_Fork) and the border with the [westerlands](Westerlands).

captions: Crossing the Mummer's Ford, by Juan Carlos Barquet © Fantasy Flight Games
Mummer's Ford.summary: The Mummer's Ford is a crossing of the river [Trident](Trident), along the [Red Fork](Red_Fork), in the western [riverlands](Riverlands). Upriver of [Sherrer](Sherrer), it has a town along its banks. The location of the Mummer's Ford has not yet been published on maps, although it may be north of [Pinkmaiden Castle](Pinkmaiden_Castle).

Rushing Falls.summary: Rushing Falls is the site of one of Lord [Beric Dondarrion](Beric_Dondarrion)'s many reported deaths. It is located near the [Gods Eye](Gods_Eye) in the [riverlands](Riverlands).

Crossed Elms.summary: Crossed Elms is a village located west of the [Gods Eye](Gods_Eye) in the [riverlands](Riverlands). It was the site of a skirmish during the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons).

Briarwhite.summary: Briarwhite is a [holdfast](Holdfast) in the southeastern [riverlands](Riverlands). It is located west of the [kingsroad](Kingsroad) and east of the [Gods Eye river](Gods_Eye_river). Briarwhite shares its name with a type of plant that grows along the [Chequy Water](Chequy_Water) in the [Reach](Reach).

Tumbler's Falls.summary: Tumbler's Falls is a town in the southern [riverlands](Riverlands). It lies on the [Blackwater Rush](Blackwater_Rush).

Widow's Ford.summary: The Widow's Ford is a ford in the [riverlands](Riverlands), possibly near [Darry](Darry).

Saltpans.summary: Saltpans is a town in the [riverlands](Riverlands) that sits on the [Bay of Crabs](Bay_of_Crabs). It is the seat of [House Cox](House_Cox), although semi-canon sources indicate that [House Hawick](House_Hawick) is also from the town.

captions: Brienne of Tarth and the Elder Brother discuss Brienne's mission- by Pojypojy ©
Quiet Isle.summary: The Quiet Isle is an upthrust island that sits at the mouth of the [Trident](Trident) where it flows into the [Bay of Crabs](Bay_of_Crabs), southeast of [Saltpans](Saltpans) and northwest of [Maidenpool](Maidenpool). Its [septry](Septry) is a refuge for those sworn to the [Faith of the Seven](Faith_of_the_Seven). Septon [Meribald](Meribald) has often visited the isle.

Gods Eye River.summary: The Gods Eye river is a river in the southern [riverlands](Riverlands) and western [crownlands](Crownlands). The river's name is not published in [A Clash of Kings](A_Clash_of_Kings).

captions: Men burned alive by the dragons, supplemental art from Game of Thrones
Loren the Last bends the knee, as depicted in Game of Thrones: Histories & Lore.
Field of Fire.summary: The Field of Fire was a major battle during [Aegon I Targaryen](Aegon_I_Targaryen)'s [war of conquest](Aegon's_Conquest). According to semi-canon sources the field is located in the northern part of the [Reach](Reach).
facts: Northern [Reach](Reach), south of the [Blackwater Rush](Blackwater_Rush) and near the [Goldroad](Goldroad)
[Targaryen](House_Targaryen) victory, Extinction of [House Gardener](House_Gardener), Submission of [House Lannister](House_Lannister)

Redgrass Field.summary:
The Redgrass Field is the site of the [Battle of the Redgrass Field](Battle_of_the_Redgrass_Field). It was an unnamed field before the battle. It was renamed the Redgrass Field after the battle for the color grass had been stained by the blood.

While its exact location has not yet been confirmed, the Redgrass Field is known to be located somewhere near [King's Landing](King's_Landing).

The Northmarch.summary: Marshal of the Northmarch is a title once held by the head of [House Osgrey](House_Osgrey); the Osgreys defended the northern regions of the [Kingdom of the Reach](King_of_the_Reach).

New Barrel.summary: New Barrel is the seat of [House Fossoway of New Barrel](House_Fossoway_of_New_Barrel). The castle is located in the [Reach](Reach). Its name suggests it may be involved in the production of [cider](Cider), like [Cider Hall](Cider_Hall) is for the [elder branch](House_Fossoway_of_Cider_Hall) of the family.

Appleton.summary: Appleton is the seat of [House Appleton](House_Appleton) in [the Reach](Reach).

Cider Hall.summary: Cider Hall is the seat of [House Fossoway of Cider Hall](House_Fossoway_of_Cider_Hall) in the [Reach](Reach). It is located near the confluence of the [Cockleswhent](Cockleswent) and the [Mander](Mander). The castle is named after the [alcoholic beverage](Cider).

Grassfield Keep.summary: Grassfield Keep is the castle of [House Meadows](House_Meadows) in or near the town of [Grassy Vale](Grassy_Vale) in [the Reach](Reach).

Grassy Vale.summary: Grassy Vale is a town controlled by [House Meadows](House_Meadows) in the [Reach](Reach). It sits along the northern shore of the [Blueburn](Blueburn) river, close to the border with the [stormlands](Stormlands). [Grassfield Keep](Grassfield_Keep), the castle of Lord [Elwood Meadows](Elwood_Meadows), is located in or near Grassy Vale.

captions: Griffin's Roost by Juan Carlos Barquet © Fantasy Flight Games
Griffin's Roost.summary: Griffin's Roost, or simply the Roost, is the seat of [House Connington](House_Connington) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). The [castle](Castle) is located between [Storm's End](Storm's_End) and [Crow's Nest](Crow's_Nest) in northwestern [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath). It is ruled by Ser [Ronnet Connington](Ronnet_Connington), the [Knight of Griffin's Roost](Knight_of_Griffin's_Roost).

captions: The Gates of the Moon is found at the foot of the Giant's Lance; art by Ted Nasmith ©
Artwork by Paolo Puggioni ©
Gates of the Moon.summary: The Gates of the Moon, also known as the Gates, is a castle at the base of the [Giant's Lance](Giant's_Lance) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). It is held by Lord [Nestor Royce](Nestor_Royce), [High Steward of the Vale](High_Steward_of_the_Vale) and [Keeper of the Gates of the Moon](Keeper_of_the_Gates_of_the_Moon), on behalf of [House Arryn](House_Arryn).
houses: House Royce of the Gates of the Moon
House Royce of the Gates of the Moon

captions: The sky cells, by Thomas Denmark © Fantasy Flight Games
The Gates of the Moon and the Eyrie, by Paolo Puggioni ©
The Giant's Lance, with the Eyrie and it´s waycastles. By eemuium
Giant's Lance.summary: The Giant's Lance is the tallest peak of the [Mountains of the Moon](Mountains_of_the_Moon) within the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn), extending three and a half miles above [the valley](Vale_of_Arryn_%28valley%29) below.

Heart's Home.summary: Heart's Home is a [castle](Castle) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn) and is the seat of [House Corbray](House_Corbray), a vassal house holding fealty to [House Arryn](House_Arryn) of the [Eyrie](Eyrie). It is located on the northern shore where a glacial river flows into a narrow bay of the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea). Upriver to the west is [Strongsong](Strongsong), while directly north is a forest. [Snakewood](Snakewood) is located to the northeast along the bay, while the [Eyrie](Eyrie) is south across a mountain range.

Crackclaw Point.summary:
Crackclaw Point, also called Crackclaw or the Point, is a peninsula in the [crownlands](Crownlands) jutting out into the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea). To the north lies the [Bay of Crabs](Bay_of_Crabs), to the south [Blackwater Bay](Blackwater_Bay). [Maidenpool](Maidenpool) and [Rook's Rest](Rook's_Rest) are west of the forested peninsula, while [Dragonstone](Dragonstone) and [Claw Isle](Claw_Isle) are to the south and east, respectively.

Noble houses from Crackclaw Point include [House Boggs](House_Boggs), [House Brune](House_Brune_of_Brownhollow) of [Brownhollow](Brownhollow), [House Brune](House_Brune_of_the_Dyre_Den) of the [Dyre Den](Dyre_Den), [House Cave](House_Cave), [House Crabb](House_Crabb) (formerly of the [Whispers](Whispers)), [House Hardy](House_Hardy), and [House Pyne](House_Pyne).

captions: The ruins at The Whispers
The Whispers.summary: The Whispers is a ruined [castle](Castle) of [House Crabb](House_Crabb) on [Crackclaw Point](Crackclaw_Point) in the northeastern [crownlands](Crownlands).

captions: Marilda of Hull with her shipwright father and her two sons, Addam and Alyn, by Dragonsaria ©
Hull and Castle Driftmark
Hull.summary: Hull is a town on the island of [Driftmark](Driftmark) in the [crownlands](Crownlands). It is located beneath the walls of [Castle Driftmark](Castle_Driftmark) on the north side of the isle, opposite [Spicetown](Spicetown) on the south side. "Hull" took its name from the rows of ship hulls at anchor below the castle.

captions: Spicetown and High Tide
Spicetown.summary: Spicetown or Spice-town was a town on the island of [Driftmark](Driftmark) in the [crownlands](Crownlands). It was located near [High Tide](High_Tide), athwart the [Gullet](Gullet).
facts: [130 AC](130_AC), during the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons)

captions: High Tide and Spicetown
High Tide.summary: High Tide is one of the castles of [House Velaryon](House_Velaryon) on the island of [Driftmark](Driftmark) in the [crownlands](Crownlands).

Sweetport.summary: Sweetport Sound is the seat of [House Sunglass](House_Sunglass) in the [crownlands](Crownlands). Sweetport Sound is sworn to [Dragonstone](Dragonstone), although its location along [Blackwater Bay](Blackwater_Bay) or the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea) has not been revealed. Ser [Triston of Tally Hill](Triston_of_Tally_Hill) is sworn to Lord [Guncer Sunglass](Guncer_Sunglass), so [Tally Hill](Tally_Hill) may be located near Sweetport Sound.

Rambton.summary: House Rambton is a noble house from the [crownlands](Crownlands). They blazon their arms with a white [ram](Sheep)'s head with golden horns on red.
facts: A white ram's head with golden horns on red, (Gules, a ram's head cabossed argent attired or)

captions: Evenfall Hall by Jordi Gonzalez ©.
Evenfall Hall.summary: Evenfall Hall, or simply Evenfall, is the seat of [House Tarth](House_Tarth) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). It is located on the western coast of the island of [Tarth](Tarth) along [Shipbreaker Bay](Shipbreaker_Bay).

Wickenden.summary: Wickenden is the seat of [House Waxley](House_Waxley) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). The town is on the northern shore of the [Bay of Crabs](Bay_of_Crabs), northwest of [Crackclaw Point](Crackclaw_Point). It is famous for making scented [beeswax](Bee) candles.

Bandallon.summary: Bandallon is the seat of [House Blackbar](House_Blackbar) in the [Reach](Reach). It is located on the shores of the [Sunset Sea](Sunset_Sea), west of [Brightwater Keep](Brightwater_Keep), northwest of [Oldtown](Oldtown), and southwest of the [Shield Islands](Shield_Islands).

captions: Brightwater Keep, by Yoann Boissonnet © Fantasy Flight Games
Brightwater Keep.summary: Brightwater Keep, also known as Brightwater, is the seat of [House Florent](House_Florent) in the [Reach](Reach). It sits near the source of the [Honeywine](Honeywine), north of [Honeyholt](Honeyholt), east of [Bandallon](Bandallon), and southwest of the [Mander](Mander).

Honeyholt.summary: Honeyholt is the seat of [House Beesbury](House_Beesbury) in the [Reach](Reach). It is situated along the eastern bank of the [Honeywine](Honeywine) river between [Brightwater Keep](Brightwater_Keep) and [Oldtown](Oldtown).

Uplands.summary: Uplands is the seat of [House Mullendore](House_Mullendore) in [the Reach](Reach). It is located east of [Oldtown](Oldtown) and west of the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains), along a river which flows west to the [Honeywine](Honeywine).

Blackcrown.summary:
Blackcrown is the seat of [House Bulwer](House_Bulwer) in the southwestern [Reach](Reach). It is located on the northern shore of [Whispering Sound](Whispering_Sound) near [Oldtown](Oldtown) and [Three Towers](Three_Towers).

The cliffs near Blackcrown are called singing cliffs for the whistle heard from the twisted towers and wind-carved stones standing above the waves.

Blackcrown's maester is [Normund](Normund_Tyrell).

Three Towers.summary: Three Towers is the seat of [House Costayne](House_Costayne) in the [Reach](Reach). It sits on a cliff on the southern shore of [Whispering Sound](Whispering_Sound), almost where the sound meets the [Redwyne Straits](Redwyne_Straits).

captions: A House Tyrell pleasure barge, by Sergey Glushakov © Fantasy Flight Games
A skiff sails the Mander on a sunny day, by Jorge Carrero Roig © Fantasy Flight Games
The shores of the Mander, by David Lecossu © Fantasy Flight Games
Men of the Mander, by Tomasz Jedruszek © Fantasy Flight Games
Mouth of the Mander.summary: The Mander is a river in the [Reach](Reach) which flows past [Highgarden](Highgarden), the seat of [House Tyrell](House_Tyrell). It is the longest and broadest river in the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms). The Tyrells include [Lord Paramount of the Mander](Lord_Paramount_of_the_Mander) among their titles.

Mermaid's Palace.summary: Mermaid's Palace is a small isle off the coast of the [Arbor](Arbor).

Starfish Harbor.summary: Starfish Harbor is a town with a port that sits along the [Redwyne Straits](Redwyne_Straits) in the [Arbor](Arbor).

Ryamsport.summary:
Ryamsport is a town with a port on the [Arbor](Arbor).

It is possibly named after [Ryam Redwyne](Ryam_Redwyne), famed [Lord Commander](Lord_Commander_of_the_Kingsguard) of the [Kingsguard](Kingsguard) under kings [Jaehaerys I](Jaehaerys_I_Targaryen) and [Viserys I Targaryen](Viserys_I_Targaryen).

Vinetown.summary: Vinetown is a town with a port that sits along the [Redwyne Straits](Redwyne_Straits) on the [Arbor](Arbor).

Isle of Pigs.summary: The Isle of Pigs is a small isle off the coast of the [Arbor](Arbor), possibly the seat of [House Farrow](House_Farrow).

Cuy.summary: Cuy is a town which lies outside the walls of [Sunhouse](Sunhouse) in [the Reach](Reach). Cuy and Sunhouse are located along the southern shore of the Reach and are ruled by [House Cuy](House_Cuy).

Dunstonbury.summary: Dunstonbury is a [castle](Castle) in the [Reach](Reach). Its current ruling house has not been published.

captions: Horn Hill by Logan Feliciano © Fantasy Flight Games
Horn Hill.summary: Horn Hill is the seat of [House Tarly](House_Tarly) in the [Reach](Reach). Located on an eponymous hill, the castle lies south of [Highgarden](Highgarden) and a hundred leagues northeast of [Oldtown](Oldtown) among the thickly-wooded foothills of the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains). The Tarlys are [marcher lords](Marcher_lords) of the [Dornish Marches](Dornish_Marches).
facts: [Age of Heroes](Age_of_Heroes) by [Herndon of the Horn](Herndon_of_the_Horn) and [Harlon the Hunter](Harlon_the_Hunter)

captions: Ashford Castle by Gary Gianni
Ashford.summary: Ashford, also called Ashford Castle, is the seat of [House Ashford](House_Ashford) in the [Reach](Reach). The castle and its town sit on the northern shore of a fording of the [Cockleswent](Cockleswent), north of the [Dornish Marches](Dornish_Marches).

Ashford Meadow.summary: Ashford Meadow is a grassy field on the southern shore of the [Cockleswent](Cockleswent) in the [Reach](Reach), across the river from [Ashford](Ashford). In normal times the meadow serves as a commons for [smallfolk](Smallfolk).

Whitegrove.summary: Whitegrove is a [castle](Castle) in the [Reach](Reach). Its current ruling house has not been published.

Starpike.summary: Starpike is the seat of [House Peake](House_Peake) in the [Reach](Reach). The castle may be located in the [Dornish Marches](Dornish_Marches).

Harvest Hall.summary: Harvest Hall is the seat of [House Selmy](House_Selmy) in the [Dornish Marches](Dornish_Marches), in the [stormlands](Stormlands). According to a semi-canon source, it is located near the eastern border of the [Reach](Reach), northeast of [Nightsong](Nightsong), northwest of [Blackhaven](Blackhaven) and south of the [Cockleswhent](Cockleswent).

Vulture's Roost.summary: Vulture's Roost is a ruined castle in northern [Dorne](Dorne). It lies near the source of the [Wyl](Wyl_%28river%29) river deep in the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains).

captions: High Hermitage by Eric Wilkerson © Fantasy Flight Games
High Hermitage.summary: High Hermitage is the seat of [House Dayne of High Hermitage](House_Dayne_of_High_Hermitage). It is located in the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains) of [Dorne](Dorne), northeast of [Starfall](Starfall).

captions: The Torrentine near High Hermitage, by Eric Wilkerson © Fantasy Flight Games
Torrentine.summary: The Torrentine or Torentine is a river in western [Dorne](Dorne).

Hellgate Hall.summary: Hellgate Hall was the seat of [House Dryland](House_Dryland), who ruled as [Kings](King_of_the_Brimstone) of the [Brimstone](Brimstone) in [Dorne](Dorne) prior to [Nymeria's War](Nymeria's_War). It is unknown what happened to the castle after the defeat of King [Lucifer Dryland](Lucifer_Dryland), as he was the last of his line.

Slayne.summary: The Slayne is a river in [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). Known for its rapids, pools, and waterfalls, the Slayne flows south from the northeastern [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains) to the [Sea of Dorne](Sea_of_Dorne).

King's Mountain.summary: King's Mountain is a place in the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms); its location has not been revealed.

captions: Crow's Nest Castle
Crow's Nest.summary: Crow's Nest is the seat of [House Morrigen](House_Morrigen) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). It is located in mountainous terrain between [Griffin's Roost](Griffin's_Roost) and [Stonehelm](Stonehelm), along the western edge of [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath) and the [rainwood](Rainwood).

Stonehelm.summary: Stonehelm is a castle in the [stormlands](Stormlands) and is the ancient seat of [House Swann](House_Swann). The castle is situated in the [Red Watch](Red_Watch) region of the eastern [Dornish Marches](Dornish_Marches), on [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath) along the coast of the [Sea of Dorne](Sea_of_Dorne).

The Red Watch.summary: The Red Watch is the region around [Stonehelm](Stonehelm) in the southern [stormlands](Stormlands), where the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains) meet [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath). It is part of the eastern [Dornish Marches](Dornish_Marches) and is ruled by [House Swann](House_Swann), [marcher lords](Marcher_lords) who historically defended against incursions from [Dorne](Dorne) or the [Reach](Reach).

Fawnton.summary: Fawnton is the seat of [House Cafferen](House_Cafferen) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). The precise location of Fawnton is unknown.

Mistwood.summary: Mistwood or Mistfall is the seat of [House Mertyns](House_Mertyns) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). It is located in the southern [rainwood](Rainwood) in [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath).

Weeping Town.summary:
The Weeping Town is a market town in the [stormlands](Stormlands). Lying on the southern shore of [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath), along the [Sea of Dorne](Sea_of_Dorne), it has a thriving port which handles much of the stormlands' trade. It contains a seat, possibly known as the Weeping Tower. It is ruled by [House Whitehead](House_Whitehead).

The town has stout wooden walls, peaked roofs, and crooked alleys. It is large enough to support three inns: the [Broken Shield](Broken_Shield), the [Loon](Loon), and the [Drunken Dornishman](Drunken_Dornishman).

captions: Griffin's Roost by Juan Carlos Barquet © Fantasy Flight Games
Roost.summary: Griffin's Roost, or simply the Roost, is the seat of [House Connington](House_Connington) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). The [castle](Castle) is located between [Storm's End](Storm's_End) and [Crow's Nest](Crow's_Nest) in northwestern [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath). It is ruled by Ser [Ronnet Connington](Ronnet_Connington), the [Knight of Griffin's Roost](Knight_of_Griffin's_Roost).

Rain House.summary: Rain House, also called the Rain House, is the seat of [House Wylde](House_Wylde) in the [stormlands](Stormlands). It sits in the eastern [rainwood](Rainwood) along the southern shore of [Shipbreaker Bay](Shipbreaker_Bay) near the northeastern tip of [Cape Wrath](Cape_Wrath).
houses: House Wylde of the Rain House

Greenstone.summary: Greenstone is the seat of [House Estermont](House_Estermont) on the island of [Estermont](Estermont) in the [stormlands](Stormlands).

captions: A Martell guard at the Water Gardens, art by Aaron Riley © Fantasy Flight Games
The Water Gardens by Cris Urdiales
Water Gardens.summary: The Water Gardens is a palace with gardens and waterworks that serves as a private retreat to [House Martell](House_Martell), the rulers of [Dorne](Dorne).

Last Lament.summary: Last Lament is a town in northwestern [Walano](Walano) in the [Summer Isles](Summer_Isles). To the north of it is the island [Stone Head](Stone_Head).

captions: The priests of the Blind God among the mazes of Lorath. Art by Jordi Gonzalez ©
The Nine Free Cities:
Lorath Island.summary: Lorath is one of the Nine [Free Cities](Free_Cities). It is in a group of islands in the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea), near the northern coast of [Essos](Essos).

The Tree of Crowns.summary: The Tree of Crowns is located in the [Disputed Lands](Disputed_Lands). In [258 AC](Years_after_Aegon's_Conquest#Year_258_After_the_Conquest), nine [outlaws](Outlaws), exiles, [pirates](Pirates), and [sellsword](Mercenary#Sellsword) captains—remembered by history as the "[Band of Nine](Band_of_Nine)"—met beneath the Tree of Crowns as to form an alliance, swearing to aid each other in conquering kingdoms for each of the nine members.

Kyth.summary: Kyth is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) in the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea), in the [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor). It was located near where the [Sarne](Sarne) turned north. Kyth and [Hornoth](Hornoth) were destroyed by rival [Dothraki](Dothraki) [khals](Khal) after the fall of [Sallosh](Vaes_Athjikhari).

Vaes Gorqoyi.summary: Vaes Gorqoyi is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) in the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea), in the [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor). Named Mardosh by the [Tall Men](Tall_Men), it was known as the "City of Soldiers" and Mardosh the Unconquerable.

Hornoth.summary: Hornoth is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) in the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea), in the [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor). It was located near where the [Sarne](Sarne) turned north. Hornoth and [Kyth](Kyth) were destroyed by rival [Dothraki](Dothraki) [khals](Khal) after the fall of [Sallosh](Vaes_Athjikhari).

Rathylar.summary: Rathylar is a ruined city in [Essos](Essos) in the [Dothraki sea](Dothraki_sea), in the [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor). It was located near where the [Sarne](Sarne) turned north. As [Saath](Saath) is the only Sarnori city to have survived the [Century of Blood](Century_of_Blood), Rathylar was presumably destroyed by the [Dothraki](Dothraki) as well.

The Sarne.summary: The Sarne is a river in northern [Essos](Essos) located east of the [Forest of Qohor](Forest_of_Qohor) and north of the [Painted Mountains](Painted_Mountains).

captions: The Qhoyne - by Stu Barnes. © FFG
The Qhoyne.summary:
The Qhoyne is a river in northwestern [Essos](Essos). The [Rhoynar](Rhoynar) consider it a daughter of the [Rhoyne](Rhoyne) and nickname it the Darkling Daughter. Its headwaters lie in the [Forest of Qohor](Forest_of_Qohor), where it runs through the Free City of [Qohor](Qohor). It then flows southwest past the forest and meets its tributary, the south-flowing [Darkwash](Darkwash), just north of the ruined city of [Ar Noy](Ar_Noy). The Qhoyne then continues southwest past Ar Noy and meets the Rhoyne at [Dagger Lake](Dagger_Lake).

Pine-cones from the Forest of Qohor and gold and amber from the Axe flow into Dagger Lake by way of the Qhoyne and the Darkwash, respectively. Timber from the forest is shipped to the southern Rhoyne via the Qhoyne and Dagger Lake.

Barter Beach.summary: Barter Beach is a market of sorts on [Talon](Talon_%28island%29), one of the [Basilisk Isles](Basilisk_Isles). It is where the [corsairs](Pirates) of the isles go to trade among themselves.

Talon.summary: Talon is a warship in service to the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch) at [Eastwatch-by-the-Sea](Eastwatch-by-the-Sea). The galley's rowers sit on an open deck. Its captain is Ser [Maynard Holt](Maynard_Holt).

captions:
The battle before the gates of Sathar, by Paolo Puggioni,
featured in The World of Ice & Fire
Field of Crows.summary: The Field of Crows was the largest battle between the [Dothraki](Dothraki) and the [Tall Men](Tall_Men) during the [Century of Blood](Century_of_Blood). The victory of the horselords allowed them to conquer the rest of the [Kingdom of Sarnor](Kingdom_of_Sarnor).

captions: The Lonely Hills, by Andrew Bosely © Fantasy Flight Games
Lonely Hill.summary: The Lonely Hills are a series of hills controlled by [House Umber](House_Umber) in the [north](North). They lie east of [Long Lake](Long_Lake), south of the [Last River](Last_River) and the [Last Hearth](Last_Hearth), and northwest of the [Dreadfort](Dreadfort).

Howling Mountain.summary: The Howling Mountain is one of the [Basilisk Isles](Basilisk_Isles), which are off the northern coast of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos).

Lower Zamoyos.summary: The Zamoyos is a river in [Sothoryos](Sothoryos) which flows into the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) at a large delta. It is known for its green waters, quicksands, and rotting, half-submerged trees. The river contains crocodiles, schools of carnivorous fish, and worms which lay eggs in swimmers.

Upper Zamoyos.summary: The Zamoyos is a river in [Sothoryos](Sothoryos) which flows into the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) at a large delta. It is known for its green waters, quicksands, and rotting, half-submerged trees. The river contains crocodiles, schools of carnivorous fish, and worms which lay eggs in swimmers.

Marahai Bay.summary:
Marahai is a crescent-shaped island in the central [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea), off the southern coast of [Essos](Essos). West of Marahai are [Great Moraq](Great_Moraq), the [Isle of Whips](Isle_of_Whips), and the [Isle of Elephants](Isle_of_Elephants). Additionally, [Leng](Leng) and the [Manticore Isles](Manticore_Isles) are east of Marahai. The city of [Yin](Yin) in [Yi Ti](Yi_Ti) is to the north across the Jade Sea.

Marahai is called a paradise isle. Within its curvature are two small volcanic isles which often emit smoke and flame.

Ash.summary: Ash is one of the [children of the forest](Children_of_the_forest) in service to the [last greenseer](Three-eyed_crow). Their true name is too long for the human tongue, according to [Leaf](Leaf).

Westeros.summary: Westeros is one of the three known continents in the [known world](Known_world), the others being [Essos](Essos) and [Sothoryos](Sothoryos). Most of the area of Westeros is covered by a political entity known as the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms), while the far north [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall) includes the [free folk](Free_folk). The closest foreign nations to Westeros are the [Free Cities](Free_Cities), a collection of independent city-states across the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea) in western [Essos](Essos). To the south of Westeros lie the [Summer Isles](Summer_Isles).

Essos.summary:
Essos, often simply called the east, is the largest of the three known continents in the [world](Known_world). It lies east of [Westeros](Westeros) and north of [Sothoryos](Sothoryos) and [Ulthos](Ulthos), stretching from the [Shivering Sea](Shivering_Sea) in the north to the [Summer Sea](Summer_Sea) in the south, and from the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea) in the west to the lands surrounding the [Jade Sea](Jade_Sea) in the east, if not farther. Essos is populated by many different peoples and has a vast and varied geography.

In the novels of [A Song of Ice and Fire](A_Song_of_Ice_and_Fire), the continent is simply called the eastern continent, beyond the narrow sea, or the east; [George R. R. Martin](George_R._R._Martin) first referred to it as Essos in mid-2008 in an interview, and later officially confirmed it. The [Appendix](A_Dance_with_Dragons-Appendix) of [A Dance with Dragons](A_Dance_with_Dragons) officially refers to the continent east of the narrow sea as Essos.

The Valyrian Road.summary: Valyrian roads, also called dragon roads, are broad stone highways built when the [Valyrian Freehold](Valyrian_Freehold) dominated [Essos](Essos). They are straight and usually run from one economic center to another, allowing swift transport of goods.

The Steel Road.summary: The Steel Road is a mountain pass in central [Essos](Essos). It runs east from [Vaes Dothrak](Vaes_Dothrak), then travels through the [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains) and the [Krazaaj Zasqa](Krazaaj_Zasqa) to the city of [Kayakayanaya](Kayakayanaya), which lies on the eastern side of the mountain range. It then travels around the [Great Sand Sea](Great_Sand_Sea) and south to [Trader Town](Trader_Town), west of the [Shrinking Sea](Shrinking_Sea). The Steel Road is named after the many battles which have occurred in its vicinity.

The High Road.summary: The high road, also called the eastern road and the mountain road, is the sole pass through the [Mountains of the Moon](Mountains_of_the_Moon) to the [Bloody Gate](Bloody_Gate) and on to the [Eyrie](Eyrie) in the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn). The path is steep and stony and can be closed by snow.
