The Rosby road is a road in the [crownlands](Crownlands) running from the [Iron Gate](Iron_Gate) at [King's Landing](King's_Landing) through [Rosby](Rosby) to [Duskendale](Duskendale). After Rosby, the road to Duskendale passes [apple](Apple) orchards and fields of barley and becomes rutted. The [Duskendale road](Duskendale_road) then heads north to [Maidenpool](Maidenpool).

The Stone Road.summary: The Stone Road is a mountain pass in central [Essos](Essos). Originating in [Vaes Dothrak](Vaes_Dothrak), it runs from the ruined city [Vaes Jini](Vaes_Jini) (Yinishar) through the northern [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains) to [Samyriana](Shamyriana), which lies on the eastern side of the mountain range. It then possibly heads north to [Kayakayanaya](Kayakayanaya) and south to [Bayasabhad](Bayasabhad) between the Bone Mountains and the [Great Sand Sea](Great_Sand_Sea).

The Sand Road.summary: The Sand Road is a mountain pass in the southern [Bone Mountains](Bone_Mountains) of central [Essos](Essos). It travels north from [Qarth](Qarth) through the desert of the [red waste](Red_waste), and next heads east through the [Dry Bones](Dry_Bones) to the fortress city of [Bayasabhad](Bayasabhad), which lies on the eastern side of the mountain range. It then travels around the [Great Sand Sea](Great_Sand_Sea) to [Tiqui](Tiqui). The Sand and [Steel Roads](Steel_Road) meet at [Trader Town](Trader_Town), west of the [Shrinking Sea](Shrinking_Sea).

Battle of Oxcross.summary: The Battle of Oxcross is a battle during the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings). The [Stark](House_Stark) army of King [Robb Stark](Robb_Stark) routs and scatters the [Lannister](House_Lannister) army of Ser [Stafford Lannister](Stafford_Lannister), who is killed.

Battle of Ashford.summary: The Battle of Ashford was a battle fought during [Robert's Rebellion](Robert's_Rebellion) between royal and rebel forces at [Ashford](Ashford), the seat of [House Ashford](House_Ashford) in the [Reach](Reach). The van under Lord [Randyll Tarly](Randyll_Tarly) won most of the loyalist victory, although Lord [Mace Tyrell](Mace_Tyrell), [Warden of the South](Warden_of_the_South), took the credit.

Battle of Bronzegate.summary: The Battle of Bronzegate was one of the greatest victories of [House Durrandon](House_Durrandon) during the [coming of the Andals](Coming_of_the_Andals) to the [stormlands](Stormlands). At [Bronzegate](Bronzegate), King [Monfryd V Durrandon](Monfryd_V_Durrandon) defeated the [Holy Brotherhood of the Andals](Holy_Brotherhood_of_the_Andals), an alliance of seven [Andal](Andals) warlords and petty kings, but at the cost of his own life.

Battle at Acorn Hall.summary: A battle at Acorn Hall occurred in [130 AC](130_AC) during the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons).

Battle at Duskendale.summary: A battle at Duskendale is one of the final battles of the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings). Its lasting effect is to bleed [Robb Stark](Robb_Stark)'s forces further and to weaken the noble houses of the [north](North).

Battle at Fairmarket.summary: A battle at Fairmarket was fought during the campaign of [Harwyn Hoare](Harwyn_Hoare), [King of the Iron Islands](King_of_the_Iron_Islands), in the [riverlands](Riverlands), which were then ruled by the [Storm Kings](Storm_King) of [House Durrandon](House_Durrandon).

Battle at Rook's Rest.summary: A battle at Rook's Rest took place in the [crownlands](Crownlands) during the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons).

Battle at Pyke.summary: A battle at Pyke was the the final conflict of [Greyjoy's Rebellion](Greyjoy's_Rebellion).

Battle at Lordsport.summary: A battle at Lordsport took place during [Greyjoy's Rebellion](Greyjoy's_Rebellion).

Battle at Kayce.summary: A battle at Kayce occurred during [Dalton Greyjoy](Dalton_Greyjoy)'s war against the [westerlands](Westerlands).
facts: Aftermath of the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons)

Battle at Stonebridge.summary: The battle at Stonebridge was one of the first major battles against the [Faith Militant](Faith_Militant) during the [Faith Militant uprising](Faith_Militant_uprising).
facts: Victory for the royal forces, Capture of [Wat the Hewer](Wat_the_Hewer)

Fighting at Bitterbridge.summary: Fighting at Bitterbridge occurs during the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings) in the aftermath of the death of King [Renly Baratheon](Renly_Baratheon) and the [fall](Siege_of_Storm's_End_%28299%29) of [Storm's End](Storm's_End) to King [Stannis Baratheon](Stannis_Baratheon).

Fighting at Sow's Horn.summary: Fighting at Sow’s Horn takes place between [House Karstark](House_Karstark) and [House Hogg](House_Hogg) in [299 AC](299_AC), during the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings).

Fight at Torrhen's Square.summary: The fight at Torrhen's Square occurs during the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings). Forces of [House Greyjoy](House_Greyjoy) led by [Dagmer Cleftjaw](Dagmer) are defeated at [Torrhen's Square](Torrhen's_Square) by a [northern](North) army led by Ser [Rodrik Cassel](Rodrik_Cassel).

Fight by Deepwood Motte.summary: The fight by Deepwood Motte occurs in the late stages of the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings). [Stannis Baratheon](Stannis_Baratheon) attempts to gain the [northmen](Northmen)'s allegiance by driving the invading [ironborn](Ironborn) of [Asha Greyjoy](Asha_Greyjoy) out of [Deepwood Motte](Deepwood_Motte) and the [wolfswood](Wolfswood).
facts: [House Baratheon of Dragonstone](House_Baratheon_of_Dragonstone) victory, Deepwood returned to [House Glover](House_Glover), [Asha Greyjoy](Asha_Greyjoy) captured, Houses [Glover](House_Glover) and [Mormont](House_Mormont) join [Stannis Baratheon](Stannis_Baratheon)'s army, Men once sworn to the [Hornwoods](House_Hornwood), [Cerwyns](House_Cerwyn) and [Tallharts](House_Tallhart) join Stannis Baratheon's army

Fight at the Fist.summary: The fight at the Fist is a lopsided loss for the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch). Taking place on the [Fist of the First Men](Fist_of_the_First_Men) in the lands [beyond the Wall](Beyond_the_Wall), the Night's Watch is unable to defend against the [wights](Wights) sent against them.

Fight at the Bridge of Skulls.wiki: Fight at the Bridge of Skulls
Fight at the Bridge of Skulls.summary: The fight at the Bridge of Skulls is a costly victory for the [Night's Watch](Night's_Watch) over [wildlings](Free_folk) during the [conflict beyond the Wall](Conflict_beyond_the_Wall). It is fought on the [Bridge of Skulls](Bridge_of_Skulls) and near the [Gorge](Gorge).
facts: either late [299 AC](299_AC) or early [300 AC](300_AC)

Fighting in the Hornwood.summary: Fighting in the Hornwood takes place in [299 AC](299_AC) in the [Hornwood](House_Hornwood) lands of the [north](North) during the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings). Fighting occurs between [House Bolton](House_Bolton), led by the Bastard of the [Dreadfort](Dreadfort), [Ramsay Snow](Ramsay_Snow), on the one side, and Hornwood men loyal to Lady [Donella Hornwood](Donella_Hornwood) and [Manderly](House_Manderly) men led by Lord [Wyman Manderly](Wyman_Manderly) of [White Harbor](White_Harbor) on the other side.
facts: House Manderly captures Hornwood but later withdraws, resulting in a Bolton victory, Ramsay Snow believed dead after intervention of Winterfell

First Battle of Tumbleton.summary: The Battle of Tumbleton, First Battle of Tumbleton, or simply First Tumbleton was a battle fought between the [greens](Greens) and the [blacks](Blacks) at [Tumbleton](Tumbleton) in the [Reach](Reach) during the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons). It was known for the Treasons of Tumbleton, in which the [Two Betrayers](Two_Betrayers) burnt the town with [dragonfire](Dragonflame), and the ensuing sack of Tumbleton by the victors. It was followed by another battle, the [Second Battle of Tumbleton](Second_Battle_of_Tumbleton).

Attack on Old Wyk.summary: The attack on Old Wyk by forces loyal to King [Robert I Baratheon](Robert_I_Baratheon) occurred during [Greyjoy's Rebellion](Greyjoy's_Rebellion). The invasion of the isle of [Old Wyk](Old_Wyk) was led by Ser [Barristan Selmy](Barristan_Selmy), [Lord Commander of the Kingsguard](Lord_Commander_of_the_Kingsguard).

Battles at Summerhall.summary: Three battles at Summerhall were fought in one day in the [stormlands](Stormlands) during [Robert's Rebellion](Robert's_Rebellion).
facts: Rebel victory - Robert wins three battles in a single day.

Combat at the Tower of Joy.wiki: Combat at the tower of joy
Combat at the Tower of Joy.summary: Combat at the tower of joy occurred at the end of [Robert's Rebellion](Robert's_Rebellion), according to a fever dream of Lord [Eddard "Ned" Stark](Eddard_Stark). The encounter took place at the [tower of joy](Tower_of_joy) in the [Red Mountains](Red_Mountains) of northern [Dorne](Dorne).

Battle in the hills below the Golden Too.wiki: Battle in the hills below the Golden Tooth
Battle in the hills below the Golden Too.summary: A battle in the hills below the Golden Tooth is the opening battle of the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings) and the [Lannister](House_Lannister) campaign in the [riverlands](Riverlands).

Battle of the Bells.summary: The Battle of the Bells was a battle fought during [Robert's Rebellion](Robert's_Rebellion) between royalist and rebel forces at [Stoney Sept](Stoney_Sept) in the southwestern [riverlands](Riverlands). It is so-named because at the beginning of the battle the town's sept tolled its bells to warn the citizens of the battle and to persuade them to stay inside their houses. The battle was won by the rebel army, although the royalists were able to retreat in good order.

Battle of the Burning Mill.summary: The Battle of the Burning Mill took place near the start of [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons). As the preceding [fall of Harrenhal](Assault_on_Harrenhal) had been bloodless, it was the first true battle in the civil war between opposing armies in the field.

Battle of the Camps.summary: The Battle of the Camps is an early battle in the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings). It is a great victory for [House Stark](House_Stark) and [House Tully](House_Tully), who smash the [House Lannister](House_Lannister) force that encircles [Riverrun](Riverrun), thereby allowing the [riverlords](Riverlands#People) to join their forces with those of the [north](North).
facts: Northmen and rivermen victory, [Robb Stark](Robb_Stark) proclaimed [King in the North](King_in_the_North) and [King of the Trident](King_of_the_Trident)

Battle under the walls of Riverrun.wiki: Battle under the walls of Riverrun
Battle under the walls of Riverrun.summary: A battle under the walls of Riverrun is the second major battle of the conflict known as the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings).

Battle of the Blackwater.summary: The Battle of the Blackwater, the largest battle in the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings), is fought between the forces loyal to [Joffrey I Baratheon](Joffrey_Baratheon), the king holding the [Iron Throne](Iron_Throne), and those loyal to his uncle, [Stannis Baratheon](Stannis_Baratheon), who controls the [narrow sea](Narrow_sea). After [eliminating](Siege_of_Storm's_End_%28299%29#Regicide) his younger brother [Renly](Renly_Baratheon), a rival claimant to the Iron Throne, Stannis gains the loyalty of nearly all lords from the [stormlands](Stormlands) and many from the [Reach](Reach). Stannis advances on [King's Landing](King's_Landing) by land and sea, intent on seizing the city and taking control of the Iron Throne.
facts: mouth of the [Blackwater Rush](Blackwater_Rush) and [King's Landing](King's_Landing)
Decisive victory for [House Baratheon of King's Landing](House_Baratheon_of_King's_Landing)

Battle of the Trident.summary: The Battle of the Trident was the battle that ultimately determined the outcome of [Robert's Rebellion](Robert's_Rebellion). The battle was fought between rebel and royal troops at the [Trident](Trident), across what would thereafter be known as the [ruby ford](Ruby_ford). It ended in a victory for the rebels.

Battle of the Fords.summary: The Battle of the Fords is a series of engagements fought between the forces of [House Tully](House_Tully) and [House Lannister](House_Lannister) during the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings). The fighting takes place on the fords of the [Red Fork](Red_Fork) of the [Trident](Trident).

Fighting at the fords of the Trident.wiki: Fighting at the fords of the Trident
Fighting at the fords of the Trident.summary: The fighting at the fords of the Trident is one of the final actions of [Robb Stark](Robb_Stark)'s campaign in the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings). The rearguard of Lord [Roose Bolton](Roose_Bolton)'s [northern](North) army is attacked while crossing the [Trident](Trident) by [Lannister](House_Lannister) forces led by Ser [Gregor Clegane](Gregor_Clegane).

Attack on Castle Black.summary: The attack on Castle Black is a battle which takes place at [Castle Black](Castle_Black) on the south side of the [Wall](Wall) in the [north](North) during the [conflict beyond the Wall](Conflict_beyond_the_Wall). The [Thenn](Thenns) [Styr](Styr) leads nearly a hundred-and-twenty warriors over the Wall, hoping to take Castle Black unaware from the south and open the gate to let [Mance Rayder](Mance_Rayder) and his main force through the Wall.

Battle beneath the Wall.summary: The battle beneath the Wall (also called the battle for the Wall and the battle by the Wall) is between the forces of the Night's Watch residing at [Castle Black](Castle_Black) and [Eastwatch-by-the-Sea](Eastwatch-by-the-Sea), the main host of [Mance Rayder](Mance_Rayder), and the forces of [Stannis Baratheon](Stannis_Baratheon).
facts: [Conflict beyond the Wall](Conflict_beyond_the_Wall), [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings)

Battle in the ice.summary:
The battle in the ice is an upcoming battle between the forces of [Stannis Baratheon](Stannis_Baratheon) and the forces of [Roose Bolton](Roose_Bolton). It is set to take place at the start of [The Winds of Winter](The_Winds_of_Winter), the as-yet-unpublished sixth book of [A Song of Ice and Fire](A_Song_of_Ice_and_Fire).

Although it is not called so in the books, this battle has often been referred to as the Battle of Ice by the fandom, just like the [upcoming battle](Second_siege_of_Meereen) in [Meereen](Meereen) has been referred to as the "Battle of Fire".

Battle outside the gates of Winterfell.wiki: Battle outside the gates of Winterfell
Battle outside the gates of Winterfell.summary: The battle outside the gates of Winterfell occurs in the [winter town](Winter_town) by the gates of [Winterfell](Winterfell), determining the outcome of the [north](North) during the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings). Forces loyal to [House Stark](House_Stark) besiege Winterfell, which is held by [House Greyjoy](House_Greyjoy). [House Bolton](House_Bolton), though sworn to the Starks, betrays the Stark army. Following the battle, the Boltons have the castle and its winter town burned in the [sack of Winterfell](Sack_of_Winterfell).

Battle near Yunkai.summary: A battle near Yunkai occurs between the forces of [Daenerys Targaryen](Daenerys_Targaryen) and [Yunkai](Yunkai) in [Slaver's Bay](Slaver's_Bay).

Battle in the waters off Gulltown.wiki: Battle in the waters off Gulltown
Battle in the waters off Gulltown.summary: A battle in the waters off Gulltown was a major naval battle during [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest). It resulted in the failure of the invasion of the [Vale of Arryn](Vale_of_Arryn) and the destruction of both [Arryn](House_Arryn) and [Targaryen](House_Targaryen) fleets.
facts: [Targaryen](House_Targaryen) invasion of the [Vale](Vale_of_Arryn) halted, Both fleets destroyed

Battle of the Gullet.summary: The Battle of the Gullet, also called the Battle in the Gullet, was a battle that took place in the [Gullet](Gullet) in [130 AC](130_AC) during the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons). It remains among the bloodiest sea battles in all of history.
facts: 5th day of the 1st moon of [130 AC](130_AC)
Sack of [Driftmark](Driftmark), [Triarchy](Triarchy)'s involvement with the war ends

Fight above Shipbreaker Bay.summary: The fight above Shipbreaker Bay was a struggle between Princes [Lucerys Velaryon](Lucerys_Velaryon) and [Aemond Targaryen](Aemond_Targaryen) during the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons). The two princes met in the sky above [Shipbreaker Bay](Shipbreaker_Bay) on their [dragons](Dragon), and the fight that followed resulted in the deaths of Lucerys and his dragon [Arrax](Arrax).
facts: Death of [Lucerys Velaryon](Lucerys_Velaryon) and [Arrax](Arrax), [House Baratheon](House_Baratheon) declares for the [greens](Greens)

Battle on Whispering Sound.summary: A battle on Whispering Sound takes place in [300 AC](300_AC) during the second phase of the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings), and is part of the [ironborn](Ironborn) campaign in the [Reach](Reach). Following the [taking of the Shields](Taking_of_the_Shields), the new [King of the Isles and the North](King_of_the_Isles_and_the_North), [Euron Greyjoy](Euron_Greyjoy), sends his ships to raid up [Whispering Sound](Whispering_Sound) as well as other parts of the Reach. With much of the Reach's armies and navies fighting in the War of the Five Kings in the [stormlands](Stormlands), [crownlands](Crownlands), and [riverlands](Riverlands), the Reach is poorly defended.
facts: Unknown, Villages and fields along Whispering Sound are burnt

Battle in the Howling Hills.summary: The Battle in the Howling Hills was fought in the [Howling Hills](Howling_Hills) of eastern [Essos](Essos). The last of the [Jhogwin](Jhogwin) are said to have been slain in the battle by [Gharak Squint-Eye](Gharak_Squint-Eye) of the [Jogos Nhai](Jogos_Nhai).

Battle of the Seven Stars.summary: The Battle of the Seven Stars, or Battle of Seven Stars, was a massive battle that took place at the foot of the [Giant's Lance](Giant's_Lance) during the [Andal invasion](Coming_of_the_Andals) of [the Vale](Vale_of_Arryn). Septon [Mallow](Mallow) wrote an account of the battle. The [First Men](First_Men) of the Vale were defeated, and dominion over the Vale was claimed by [House Arryn](House_Arryn) and their [Andal](Andals) supporters.
facts: [Andal](Andals) victory, Extinction of fourteen First Men houses, Elevation of Ser [Artys Arryn](Artys_I_Arryn) to [King of Mountain and Vale](King_of_Mountain_and_Vale), Andal dominion over the Vale secured

Battle on the river Slayne.summary: A battle on the river Slayne was fought during the [coming of the Andals](Coming_of_the_Andals) to the [stormlands](Stormlands). An unlikely alliance between King [Cleoden I Durrandon](Cleoden_I_Durrandon) and three [Dornish](Dornishmen) kings won a major victory over the [Andals](Andals) of [Drox the Corpse-Maker](Drox_the_Corpse-Maker) on the river [Slayne](Slayne) near [Stonehelm](Stonehelm).

Battle by the Bloody Pool.summary: The Battle by the Bloody Pool was fought in the [stormlands](Stormlands). The [Storm King](Storm_King) [Durran the Young](Durran_Durrandon_%28the_Young%29) was said to have dammed the river [Slayne](Slayne) with [Dornish](Dorne) corpses after turning back [Yoren Yronwood](Yoren_Yronwood) and [Wylla of Wyl](Wylla_of_Wyl).

Battle at the Mander.summary: A battle at the Mander occurred in [283 AC](283_AC) near the end of [Robert's Rebellion](Robert's_Rebellion). [House Greyjoy](House_Greyjoy) achieved a negligible victory over the [Shield Islanders](Shield_Islands) at the mouth of the [Mander](Mander).

Battle of the Honeywine.summary: The Battle of the Honeywine was one of many battles fought during the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons), the civil war between the [greens](Greens) of King [Aegon II Targaryen](Aegon_II_Targaryen) and the [blacks](Blacks) of Queen [Rhaenyra Targaryen](Rhaenyra_Targaryen) for control of the [Iron Throne](Iron_Throne) of the [Seven Kingdoms](Seven_Kingdoms) after the death of their father, King [Viserys I Targaryen](Viserys_I_Targaryen).

Battle of the Weeping Water.summary: The Battle of the Weeping Water was a battle fought near the [Weeping Water](Weeping_Water) in the [North](North) during the [Andal invasion](Coming_of_the_Andals) of [Westeros](Westeros). King [Theon Stark](Theon_Stark) allied with the [Boltons](House_Bolton) to crush [Argos Sevenstar](Argos_Sevenstar) and his [Andals](Andals).

Battle at the Red Fork.summary: The Battle at the Red Fork was a battle at a crossing of the [Red Fork](Red_Fork) in the western [riverlands](Riverlands), in [130 AC](130_AC) during the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons).

Battle at the Great Fork.summary: A battle at the Great Fork of the [Blackwater Rush](Blackwater_Rush) was one of many battles fought between King [Maegor I Targaryen](Maegor_I_Targaryen) and the [Faith Militant](Faith_Militant) during the [Faith Militant uprising](Faith_Militant_uprising).

Ambush on the Wendwater.summary: An ambush on the Wendwater occurred during [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest) when [stormlords](Stormlands) attacked the host of [House Targaryen](House_Targaryen).

Battle at Long Lake.summary: A battle at Long Lake was fought between [free folk](Free_folk) and the [northern](North) forces of Houses [Stark](House_Stark) and [Umber](House_Umber) in [226 AC](Years_after_Aegon's_Conquest#Year_226_After_the_Conquest).

Battle Above the Gods Eye.summary: The Battle Above the Gods Eye was an aerial duel that took place in the skies above [Harrenhal](Harrenhal) and the [Gods Eye](Gods_Eye) between two of the most powerful [dragons](Dragon), [Vhagar](Vhagar) and [Caraxes](Caraxes), and their riders, Prince [Aemond Targaryen](Aemond_Targaryen) and Prince [Daemon Targaryen](Daemon_Targaryen), during the civil war called the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons).

Battle Beneath the Gods Eye.summary: The Battle Beneath the Gods Eye took place near the [Gods Eye](Gods_Eye) in the latter part of [43 AC](43_AC), a fight for the [Iron Throne](Iron_Throne) between King [Maegor I Targaryen](Maegor_I_Targaryen) and his nephew [Aegon the Uncrowned](Aegon_Targaryen_%28son_of_Aenys_I%29), the [Prince of Dragonstone](Prince_of_Dragonstone).

Battle by the Lakeshore.summary: The Battle by the Lakeshore, called the Fishfeed by its participants, was a major battle along the shores of the [Gods Eye](Gods_Eye) in the [riverlands](Riverlands) during the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons). It was the bloodiest land battle of the entire war.

Battle of the Reeds.summary: The Battle of the Reeds was fought on the southern shore of the [Gods Eye](Gods_Eye) during [Aegon's Conquest](Aegon's_Conquest). [Aegon the Conqueror](Aegon_I_Targaryen) defeated an attack by men of [Harren Hoare](Harren_Hoare), but the [Targaryens](House_Targaryen) then suffered heavy losses at the [Wailing Willows](Wailing_Willows).

Butcher's Ball.summary: The Butcher's Ball was a battle fought south of the [Gods Eye](Gods_Eye) during the [Dance of the Dragons](Dance_of_the_Dragons).

Battle on the Green Fork.summary: The battle on the Green Fork is an early battle in the [War of the Five Kings](War_of_the_Five_Kings) and is the first to involve forces of [House Stark](House_Stark). The battle occurs along the [Green Fork](Green_Fork) of the [Trident](Trident) in the [riverlands](Riverlands).
facts: Eastern bank of the [Green Fork](Green_Fork), between the [Twins](Twins) and the [inn at the crossroads](Inn_at_the_crossroads)
